attractions.name: The Grand Palace
attractions.description: Historic royal complex that served as the official residence of the Kings of Siam since 1782.

attractions.name: Wat Phra Kaew (Temple of the Emerald Buddha)
attractions.description: Sacred Buddhist temple within the Grand Palace grounds housing the revered Emerald Buddha statue.

attractions.name: Wat Pho (Temple of the Reclining Buddha)
attractions.description: First-class royal temple famous for its giant 46-meter gold-plated Reclining Buddha and traditional massage school.
attractions.descriptionDe: Königlicher Tempel ersten Ranges, berühmt für den 46 Meter langen vergoldeten liegenden Buddha und seine traditionelle Massageschule.

attractions.name: Wat Arun (Temple of Dawn)
attractions.description: Iconic riverside Buddhist temple decorated with colorful porcelain and seashells along the Chao Phraya River.

attractions.name: Wat Saket (The Golden Mount)
attractions.description: Hilltop temple crowned with a gleaming golden chedi offering panoramic views of historic Rattanakosin Island.
attractions.descriptionDe: Tempel auf einem Hügel mit goldener Chedi und Panoramablick über die historische Insel Rattanakosin.

attractions.name: Wat Traimit (Temple of the Golden Buddha)
attractions.description: Chinatown temple housing the world's largest solid gold Buddha statue weighing 5.5 tons.

attractions.name: Wat Benchamabophit (The Marble Temple)
attractions.description: Ornate royal temple built with imported Italian Carrara marble combining Thai and European architecture.

attractions.name: Wat Suthat and the Giant Swing
attractions.description: Historic first-grade royal temple featuring sweeping murals and the towering red teak Giant Swing at its entrance.

attractions.name: Wat Paknam Phasi Charoen
attractions.description: Thonburi temple renowned for its 69-meter giant outdoor Buddha statue and psychedelic glass stupa.

attractions.name: Wat Ratchanatdaram (Loha Prasat)
attractions.description: Unique Buddhist temple featuring a 36-meter multi-tiered metal castle spire.

attractions.name: Wat Mahathat Yuwaratrangsarit
attractions.description: One of Bangkok's oldest royal temples and an important center for VIPassana meditation and Buddhist study.

attractions.name: Wat Bowonniwet Vihara
attractions.description: Major royal temple of the Dhammayuttika Nikaya order with deep ties to the Thai monarchy.

attractions.name: Wat Kalayanamit Vihara
attractions.description: Riverside temple in Thonburi housing a monumental seated Buddha image inside a towering vihara.

attractions.name: Wat Prayurawongsawas
attractions.description: UNESCO-awarded riverside temple known for its large white bell-shaped chedi and turtle pond mound.

attractions.name: Wat Intharawihan
attractions.description: Historic temple famous for its 32-meter-tall standing Buddha statue covered in gold mosaic.

attractions.name: Wat Mangkon Kamalawat
attractions.description: The largest and most important Chinese Buddhist temple in Bangkok, located in the heart of Chinatown.
attractions.descriptionDe: Der größte und wichtigste chinesisch-buddhistische Tempel Bangkoks, mitten in Chinatown.

attractions.name: Jim Thompson House Museum
attractions.description: Preserved complex of six traditional teakwood Thai houses displaying Southeast Asian art and silk history.
attractions.descriptionDe: Erhaltenes Ensemble aus sechs traditionellen thailändischen Teakholzhäusern mit südostasiatischer Kunst und Seidengeschichte.

attractions.name: Bangkok National Museum
attractions.description: Thailand's largest museum showcasing royal artifacts, archaeological treasures, and traditional Thai art.

attractions.name: Museum of Siam
attractions.description: Interactive discovery museum housed in a neoclassical building exploring Thai national identity and history.

attractions.name: Bangkok Art and Culture Centre (BACC)
attractions.description: Contemporary arts center with curved spiral walkways hosting rotating exhibitions of Thai and international art.

attractions.name: Museum of Contemporary Art (MOCA Bangkok)
attractions.description: Five-story private museum exhibiting a vast collection of modern Thai paintings and sculptures.

attractions.name: National Gallery of Thailand
attractions.description: Historic former royal mint building displaying traditional and modern works by Thai national artists.

attractions.name: Royal Barges National Museum
attractions.description: Canal-side boathouse displaying the intricately carved ceremonial barges used in royal river processions.

attractions.name: Erawan Shrine
attractions.description: Famous Hindu shrine in downtown Bangkok housing a four-faced golden statue of Phra Phrom.

attractions.name: Lumphini Park
attractions.description: Sprawling 142-acre inner-city park featuring artificial lakes, walking paths, and native monitor lizards.

attractions.name: Benchakitti Forest Park
attractions.description: Modern urban wetland park with elevated skywalks, mangroves, and skyline views around a central lake.
attractions.descriptionDe: Moderner Feuchtgebietspark mit Hochwegen, Mangroven und Blick auf die Skyline rund um einen zentralen See.

attractions.name: Chatuchak Park

attractions.descriptionDe: Einer der ältesten Parks Bangkoks mit gepflegten Rasenflächen, Lagunen und schattigen Wegen.

attractions.name: Suan Luang Rama IX Park
attractions.description: The largest public park and botanical garden in Bangkok, featuring international garden pavilions and a large lake.

attractions.name: Queen Sirikit Park

attractions.descriptionDe: Botanischer Garten im Norden Bangkoks mit Lotusteichen, Palmensammlungen und vielen Vogelarten.

attractions.name: Santichai Prakan Park
attractions.description: Scenic riverside park built around the historic white Phra Sumen Fort with views of the Rama VIII Bridge.

attractions.name: Saranrom Palace Park
attractions.description: Nineteenth-century royal garden near the Grand Palace featuring historic pavilions and marble monuments.
attractions.descriptionDe: Königlicher Garten aus dem 19. Jahrhundert nahe dem Großen Palast mit historischen Pavillons und Marmordenkmälern.

attractions.description: Sixteenth-century formal palace gardens featuring the Medici Fountain, orchards, statues, and the Luxembourg Palace.

attractions.name: Jardin des Tuileries
attractions.description: Historic 17th-century royal garden designed by Andre Le Notre stretching between the Louvre and Place de la Concorde.

attractions.name: Pantheon
attractions.description: Neoclassical domed mausoleum in the Latin Quarter holding the tombs of Voltaire, Rousseau, Victor Hugo, and Marie Curie.

attractions.name: Palais Garnier (Opera National de Paris)
attractions.description: Opulent 19th-century Second Empire opera house famous for its Grand Staircase and Marc Chagall ceiling painting.

attractions.name: Place de la Concorde & Luxor Obelisk
attractions.description: Paris's largest public square featuring monumental fountains and a 3,300-year-old Egyptian pink granite obelisk.

attractions.name: Les Invalides (Musee de l'Armee & Dome des Invalides)
attractions.description: Seventeenth-century military hospital complex housing France's national military museum and Napoleon Bonaparte's tomb.

attractions.name: Musee de l'Orangerie
attractions.description: Art gallery in the Tuileries Garden famous for its two oval rooms purpose-built for Claude Monet's Water Lilies murals.

attractions.name: Musee Rodin
attractions.description: Eighteenth-century Hotel Biron and its sculpture gardens displaying Auguste Rodin's 'The Thinker' and 'The Gates of Hell'.

attractions.name: Conciergerie
attractions.description: Medieval royal palace and French Revolution prison on the Ile de la Cite where Marie Antoinette was imprisoned.

attractions.name: Catacombes de Paris
attractions.description: Underground ossuary network in former limestone quarries holding the remains of more than six million people.

attractions.name: Cimetiere du Pere-Lachaise
attractions.description: World's most visited necropolis, a 110-acre landscaped garden cemetery holding the graves of Chopin, Wilde, and Piaf.

attractions.name: Place des Vosges
attractions.description: The oldest planned square in Paris (1612) in the Marais district, surrounded by symmetrical red-brick and stone pavilions.

attractions.name: Musee Picasso Paris
attractions.description: Seventeenth-century Hotel Sale in the Marais housing over 5,000 works and personal archives of Pablo Picasso.

attractions.name: Bourse de Commerce — Pinault Collection
attractions.description: Restored 18th-century circular grain exchange redesigned by Tadao Ando as a contemporary art museum.

attractions.name: Fondation Louis Vuitton
attractions.description: Sail-shaped glass contemporary art museum designed by Frank Gehry on the edge of the Bois de Boulogne.

attractions.name: Musee Carnavalet
attractions.description: The oldest municipal museum in Paris, occupying two neighboring mansions and chronicling the history of the city.

attractions.name: Musee de Cluny (Musee National du Moyen Age)
attractions.description: Medieval museum combining 3rd-century Gallo-Roman thermal baths and a 15th-century Gothic abbot's mansion, home to the Lady and the Unicorn tapestries.

attractions.name: Musee du Quai Branly — Jacques Chirac
attractions.description: Museum designed by Jean Nouvel near the Eiffel Tower dedicated to the indigenous art and cultures of Africa, Asia, Oceania, and the Americas.

attractions.name: Petit Palais (Musee des Beaux-Arts de la Ville de Paris)
attractions.description: 1900 Exposition Universelle architectural gem with a semicircular courtyard garden housing fine art from antiquity to 1914.

attractions.name: Grand Palais
attractions.description: Monumental 1900 Beaux-Arts exhibition hall crowned by the largest glass-and-iron barrel-vaulted roof in Europe.

attractions.name: Tour Montparnasse Observation Deck
attractions.description: Open-air 59th-floor rooftop terrace at 210 meters offering direct views of the Eiffel Tower against the Paris skyline.

attractions.name: Pont Alexandre III
attractions.description: Ornate Beaux-Arts deck arch bridge spanning the Seine, decorated with gilded bronze winged horses and Art Nouveau lamps.

attractions.name: Pont Neuf
attractions.description: The oldest standing bridge across the River Seine in Paris, completed in 1607 under King Henry IV.

attractions.name: Jardin des Plantes & Grande Galerie de l'Evolution
attractions.description: France's main botanical garden founded in 1626, home to the National Museum of Natural History and Victorian glasshouses.

attractions.name: Parc des Buttes-Chaumont
attractions.description: Dramatic 19th-century Haussmannian park built on quarries with cliffs, a suspension bridge, waterfalls, and the Temple de la Sibylle.

attractions.name: Parc Monceau
attractions.description: Romantic 18th-century English-style park in the 8th arrondissement featuring a Corinthian colonnade around an oval pond.

attractions.name: Parc de la Villette & Cite des Sciences et de l'Industrie
attractions.description: Modern cultural park housing Europe's largest science museum and the mirrored Geode dome.

attractions.name: Philharmonie de Paris & Musee de la Musique
attractions.description: Aluminum-clad concert hall by Jean Nouvel accompanied by a museum displaying over 1,000 historic musical instruments.

attractions.name: Bois de Vincennes & Chateau de Vincennes
attractions.description: Paris's largest public park anchored by a massive 14th-century royal fortress with the tallest medieval fortified keep in Europe.

attractions.name: Bois de Boulogne & Parc de Bagatelle
attractions.description: Vast western woodland park containing the 18th-century Chateau de Bagatelle and its famous rose garden containing 10,000 rosebushes.

attractions.name: Musee Jacquemart-Andre
attractions.description: Opulent Second Empire private mansion on Boulevard Haussmann displaying Italian Renaissance and French 18th-century masterpieces.

attractions.name: Musee Marmottan Monet
attractions.description: Sixteenth-arrondissement villa housing the world's largest collection of works by Claude Monet, including 'Impression, Sunrise'.

attractions.name: Musee des Arts et Metiers
attractions.description: Industrial design and scientific invention museum housed in a medieval priory, featuring Foucault's original pendulum.

attractions.name: Musee des Arts Decoratifs (MAD)
attractions.description: Decorative arts, interior design, and fashion museum occupying the Rohan and Marsan wings of the Palais du Louvre.

attractions.name: Palais de Tokyo & Musee d'Art Moderne de Paris
attractions.description: Monumental 1937 Art Deco building facing the Seine dedicated to modern and experimental contemporary art.

attractions.name: Atelier des Lumieres
attractions.description: Digital art center inside a 19th-century iron foundry projecting floor-to-ceiling animated exhibitions.
attractions.descriptionDe: Zentrum für digitale Kunst in einer Eisengießerei aus dem 19. Jahrhundert mit raumfüllenden animierten Projektionen.

attractions.name: Eglise Saint-Sulpice
attractions.description: Paris's second-largest church, featuring Eugène Delacroix frescoes, a gnomon astronomical line, and a monumental pipe organ.

attractions.name: Eglise de la Madeleine
attractions.description: Neoclassical church designed in the form of a colossal Roman temple surrounded by 52 Corinthian columns.

attractions.name: Eglise Saint-Germain-des-Pres
attractions.description: The oldest surviving church in Paris, founded in 543 AD with a Romanesque bell tower and painted polychrome nave.
attractions.descriptionDe: Die älteste erhaltene Kirche von Paris, 543 gegründet, mit romanischem Glockenturm und farbig bemaltem Kirchenschiff.

attractions.name: Eglise Saint-Eustache
attractions.description: Monumental 16th-century church in Les Halles blending Gothic structure with Renaissance details and France's largest pipe organ.

attractions.name: Grande Mosquee de Paris
attractions.description: Hispano-Moorish mosque built in 1926 in the 5th arrondissement featuring zellige tilework, courtyards, and lush gardens.

attractions.name: Promenade Plantee (Coulee Verte Rene-Dumont)
attractions.description: The world's first elevated linear park (1993), stretching 4.7 kilometers atop a historic brick railway viaduct.

cities.name: Singapore
cities.source_note: Singapore Tourism Board (STB), Euromonitor Top 100 City Destinations Index, & Mastercard GDCI (#5)

attractions.name: Gardens by the Bay (Supertree Grove)
attractions.description: Futuristic 101-hectare nature park on reclaimed land featuring 18 vertical garden Supertrees up to 50 meters tall.

attractions.name: Cloud Forest & Flower Dome (Gardens by the Bay)
attractions.description: Twin Guinness record-breaking cooled glass conservatories housing a 35-meter indoor waterfall and Mediterranean flora.

attractions.name: Marina Bay Sands SkyPark Observation Deck
attractions.description: Cantilevered ship-like rooftop observation deck perched 57 stories above Marina Bay.

attractions.name: Merlion Park
attractions.description: Waterfront plaza home to Singapore's iconic 8.6-meter half-lion, half-fish statue spouting water into Marina Bay.

attractions.name: Singapore Botanic Gardens & National Orchid Garden
attractions.description: 165-year-old UNESCO World Heritage tropical garden housing over 1,000 orchid species and 2,000 hybrids.

attractions.name: Jewel Changi Rain Vortex & Shiseido Forest Valley
attractions.description: Glass torus dome designed by Moshe Safdie featuring the world's tallest indoor waterfall at 40 meters surrounded by terraced forest.

attractions.name: National Gallery Singapore
attractions.description: Visual arts institution housed in the restored former Supreme Court and City Hall buildings, holding the world's largest public collection of Southeast Asian art.

attractions.name: National Museum of Singapore
attractions.description: The nation's oldest museum (founded 1887), combining a Neoclassical rotunda with immersive galleries on Singapore's 700-year history.

attractions.name: ArtScience Museum
attractions.description: Lotus-inspired museum at Marina Bay exploring the intersection of art, science, culture, and digital technology.
attractions.descriptionDe: Lotusförmiges Museum an der Marina Bay an der Schnittstelle von Kunst, Wissenschaft, Kultur und digitaler Technik.

attractions.name: Asian Civilisations Museum (ACM)
attractions.description: Neoclassical Empress Place building on the Singapore River exploring the artistic heritage of Asia and historic maritime trade.

attractions.name: Buddha Tooth Relic Temple and Museum
attractions.description: Four-story Tang-dynasty style Buddhist temple in Chinatown housing a sacred tooth relic in a solid-gold stupa.
attractions.descriptionDe: Vierstöckiger buddhistischer Tempel im Tang-Stil in Chinatown, der in einem Stupa aus massivem Gold eine Zahnreliquie bewahrt.

attractions.name: Sri Mariamman Temple
attractions.description: Singapore's oldest Hindu temple (founded 1827), a National Monument in Chinatown crowned with a six-tiered gopuram tower.

attractions.name: Sultan Mosque (Masjid Sultan)
attractions.description: Landmark 1928 mosque in historic Kampong Gelam famous for its massive golden domes and glass-bottle base rings.

attractions.name: Thian Hock Keng Temple
attractions.description: Built in 1842 without a single nail, Singapore's oldest Hokkien temple dedicated to Mazu, Goddess of the Sea.

attractions.name: Fort Canning Park & Battlebox
attractions.description: Historic hilltop park where Malay kings once ruled and British commanders surrendered in 1942 inside the underground Battlebox bunker.

attractions.name: Singapore Zoo
attractions.description: World-famous 'open concept' rainforest zoo in Mandai housing over 4,200 animals in naturalistic landscaped habitats.

attractions.name: Night Safari
attractions.description: The world's first nocturnal wildlife park, featuring guided tram rides and walking trails through seven geographical zones.
attractions.descriptionDe: Der weltweit erste Nachtzoo, mit geführten Bahnfahrten und Wegen durch sieben Weltregionen.

attractions.name: River Wonders
attractions.description: Freshwater wildlife park and aquarium inspired by the world's iconic rivers, home to giant pandas and manatees.
attractions.descriptionDe: Süßwasser-Tierpark und Aquarium nach dem Vorbild der großen Flüsse der Welt, Heimat von Großen Pandas und Seekühen.

attractions.name: Bird Paradise (Mandai)
attractions.description: Asia's largest bird park featuring eight walk-through geographic aviaries housing 3,500 birds across 400 species.

attractions.name: Singapore Flyer
attractions.description: Giant 165-meter observation wheel on Marina Promenade offering views across the Singapore Strait to Indonesia and Malaysia.

attractions.name: Helix Bridge
attractions.description: Pedestrian stainless-steel bridge modeled on the structure of DNA linking Marina Centre with Marina South.

attractions.name: Esplanade — Theatres on the Bay
attractions.description: Waterfront performing arts center famous for its twin spiked aluminum sunshade domes nicknamed 'The Durian'.

attractions.name: Peranakan Museum
attractions.description: Restored 1912 Tao Nan School building dedicated to the rich hybrid culture of Peranakan communities in Southeast Asia.
attractions.descriptionDe: Restauriertes Schulgebäude von 1912, das der hybriden Kultur der Peranakan-Gemeinschaften Südostasiens gewidmet ist.

attractions.name: Chinatown Heritage Centre
attractions.description: Three restored shophouses on Pagoda Street recreating the living quarters of early 20th-century Chinese immigrants.
attractions.descriptionDe: Drei restaurierte Ladenhäuser in der Pagoda Street, die die Wohnräume chinesischer Einwanderer im frühen 20. Jahrhundert zeigen.

attractions.name: Indian Heritage Centre
attractions.description: Modern glass-faceted museum in Little India tracing the history of South Asian communities in Southeast Asia.
attractions.descriptionDe: Modernes Museum mit Glasfassade in Little India über die Geschichte der südasiatischen Gemeinschaften in Südostasien.

attractions.name: Malay Heritage Centre (Istana Kampong Gelam)
attractions.description: 1840s former royal palace of the Malay Sultanate in Singapore set in landscaped compound grounds.
attractions.descriptionDe: Ehemaliger Palast des malaiischen Sultans aus den 1840er-Jahren, umgeben von einer gepflegten Gartenanlage.

attractions.name: Changi Chapel and Museum
attractions.description: Commemorative museum telling the story of prisoners of war and civilians interned in Changi during World War II.
attractions.descriptionDe: Gedenkmuseum über Kriegsgefangene und Zivilisten, die im Zweiten Weltkrieg in Changi interniert waren.

attractions.name: Reflections at Bukit Chandu
attractions.description: Restored colonial bungalow on Opium Hill honoring the heroic Malay Regiment in the 1942 Battle of Pasir Panjang.
attractions.descriptionDe: Restauriertes Kolonialhaus auf dem Opium Hill zu Ehren des Malaiischen Regiments in der Schlacht von Pasir Panjang 1942.

attractions.name: Fort Siloso & Skywalk (Sentosa)
attractions.description: Singapore's only preserved coastal artillery battery from World War II, accessed via an 11-story treetop skywalk.

attractions.name: S.E.A. Aquarium (Sentosa)
attractions.description: Major marine aquarium on Sentosa Island housing over 100,000 marine animals across 45 diverse habitats.

attractions.name: Palawan Beach & Southernmost Point of Continental Asia
attractions.description: Sentosa beach connected by a suspension footbridge to a small islet with wooden viewing towers.

attractions.name: Siloso Beach & Tanjong Beach
attractions.description: Palm-fringed white-sand beaches along the southern coast of Sentosa Island.

attractions.name: Southern Ridges & Henderson Waves
attractions.description: Ten-kilometer elevated trail connecting hills and parks via Singapore's highest pedestrian bridge at 36 meters.

attractions.name: Mount Faber Park
attractions.description: One of the oldest hilltop parks in Singapore offering cable-car rides and panoramic views of the harbor and Sentosa.
attractions.descriptionDe: Einer der ältesten Hügelparks Singapurs mit Seilbahn und Panoramablick auf den Hafen und Sentosa.

attractions.name: MacRitchie Reservoir Park & TreeTop Walk
attractions.description: Nature reserve around Singapore's oldest reservoir featuring a 250-meter free-standing suspension bridge over the forest canopy.

attractions.name: Bukit Timah Nature Reserve
attractions.description: ASEAN Heritage Park protecting primary equatorial rainforest on Singapore's highest natural hill (163.6 meters).

attractions.name: Sungei Buloh Wetland Reserve
attractions.description: ASEAN Heritage Park of mangroves and mudflats on the northwestern coast, a major stopover for migratory shorebirds.

attractions.name: Pulau Ubin & Chek Jawa Wetlands
attractions.description: Granite island off northeastern Singapore preserving traditional 1960s kampong villages and rich intertidal marine ecosystems.

attractions.name: East Coast Park
attractions.description: Fifteen-kilometer scenic beachfront park along the southeastern coast popular for cycling and sea views.
attractions.descriptionDe: 15 Kilometer langer Strandpark an der Südostküste, beliebt zum Radfahren und für den Blick aufs Meer.

attractions.name: Labrador Nature Reserve
attractions.description: Coastal cliffside reserve containing Singapore's only publicly accessible rocky sea-cliff and WWII machine-gun pillboxes.
attractions.descriptionDe: Naturschutzgebiet an der Küste mit Singapurs einziger öffentlich zugänglicher Felsenklippe und Bunkern aus dem Zweiten Weltkrieg.

attractions.name: Haw Par Villa
attractions.description: Eclectic 1937 hillside cultural park containing over 1,000 colorful statues and 150 giant dioramas from Chinese folklore.

attractions.name: CHIJMES
attractions.description: Restored 19th-century Catholic convent complex centered around a white Neo-Gothic chapel with stained glass.

attractions.name: St. Andrew's Cathedral
attractions.description: Singapore's largest cathedral, built in 1856 in English Gothic Revival style with gleaming white Madras chunam plaster walls.

attractions.name: Armenian Church of Saint Gregory the Illuminator
attractions.description: The oldest surviving Christian church in Singapore, designed by George Drumgoole Coleman in 1835.
attractions.descriptionDe: Die älteste erhaltene christliche Kirche Singapurs, 1835 von George Drumgoole Coleman entworfen.

attractions.name: Sri Veeramakaliamman Temple
attractions.description: Vibrant 1881 Hindu temple in the heart of Little India dedicated to the goddess Kali.
attractions.descriptionDe: Farbenfroher Hindu-Tempel von 1881 im Herzen von Little India, der Göttin Kali geweiht.

attractions.name: Sakya Muni Buddha Gaya Temple (Temple of 1,000 Lights)
attractions.description: 1927 Buddhist temple on Race Course Road famous for its 15-meter seated Buddha surrounded by a halo of lightbulbs.
attractions.descriptionDe: Buddhistischer Tempel von 1927 an der Race Course Road, bekannt für seinen 15 Meter hohen sitzenden Buddha mit Lichterkranz.

attractions.name: Lian Shan Shuang Lin Monastery
attractions.description: Founded in 1898 in Toa Payoh, the oldest Buddhist monastery in Singapore and a gazetted National Monument.
attractions.descriptionDe: 1898 in Toa Payoh gegründet, das älteste buddhistische Kloster Singapurs und ein Nationaldenkmal.

attractions.name: Lee Kong Chian Natural History Museum
attractions.description: Biodiversity museum at the National University of Singapore displaying three genuine diplodocid sauropod dinosaur skeletons.
attractions.descriptionDe: Naturkundemuseum der National University of Singapore mit drei echten Dinosaurierskeletten (Diplodociden).

attractions.name: Singapore Art Museum (SAM at Tanjong Pagar Distripark)
attractions.description: Contemporary art museum showcasing cutting-edge installations by Southeast Asian and international artists.

attractions.name: Marina Barrage & Sustainable Singapore Gallery
attractions.description: Dam spanning the Marina Channel with a sweeping green grass roof popular for kite-flying against the city skyline.

cities.name: Tokyo
cities.source_note: Japan National Tourism Organization (JNTO), Tokyo Metropolitan Government, & Euromonitor Top 100 City Destinations Index (#3 Overall Index)

attractions.name: Senso-ji Temple & Kaminarimon Gate
attractions.description: Tokyo's oldest Buddhist temple (founded 645 AD) in Asakusa, approached via the giant red lantern of Thunder Gate.

attractions.name: Meiji Jingu Shrine
attractions.description: Shinto shrine dedicated to Emperor Meiji and Empress Shoken set within a tranquil 170-acre evergreen forest in Shibuya.

attractions.name: Tokyo Skytree
attractions.description: The world's tallest freestanding broadcasting tower at 634 meters with Tembo Deck and Tembo Galleria observatories.

attractions.name: Tokyo Tower
attractions.description: Iconic 333-meter red-and-white lattice communications and observation tower built in 1958 in Minato.

attractions.name: Shibuya Crossing & Hachiko Memorial Statue
attractions.description: The world's busiest pedestrian scramble intersection alongside the bronze statue of loyal Akita dog Hachiko.

attractions.name: Shibuya Sky Observation Deck
attractions.description: Open-air 229-meter rooftop observatory atop Shibuya Scramble Square overlooking Shibuya Crossing and Mount Fuji.

attractions.name: Shinjuku Gyoen National Garden
attractions.description: 144-acre former feudal lord's estate blending French Formal, English Landscape, and traditional Japanese gardens.

attractions.name: Tokyo Imperial Palace & East Gardens
attractions.description: Primary residence of the Emperor of Japan built on the site of Edo Castle, with public gardens and stone keeps.

attractions.name: Ueno Park (Ueno Onshi Koen)
attractions.description: Sprawling public park established in 1873, famous for over 1,000 cherry trees, Shinobazu Pond, and major national museums.
attractions.descriptionDe: Großer Stadtpark von 1873, berühmt für über 1.000 Kirschbäume, den Shinobazu-Teich und bedeutende Nationalmuseen.

attractions.name: Tokyo National Museum
attractions.description: Japan's oldest and largest art museum (1872) in Ueno Park, holding the largest collection of Japanese National Treasures.

attractions.name: National Museum of Nature and Science
attractions.description: Comprehensive natural history and science museum in Ueno Park featuring Japanese archipelago fossils and space tech.

attractions.name: National Museum of Western Art
attractions.description: UNESCO World Heritage building designed by Le Corbusier in Ueno Park displaying Rodin sculptures and European masterworks.

attractions.name: Tokyo Metropolitan Art Museum
attractions.description: Major public art gallery in Ueno Park hosting blockbuster international exhibitions and Japanese calligraphy shows.

attractions.name: Ueno Zoological Gardens
attractions.description: Japan's oldest zoo (opened 1882) located inside Ueno Park, home to giant pandas and a five-story 1639 pagoda.

attractions.name: teamLab Planets TOKYO (Toyosu)
attractions.description: Immersive barefoot digital art museum where visitors walk through water and crystal light installations.
attractions.descriptionDe: Immersives digitales Kunstmuseum, das man barfuß erkundet, durch Wasser und Lichtinstallationen.

attractions.name: teamLab Borderless (Azabudai Hills)
attractions.description: Interactive digital art museum of boundary-free projection rooms created by art collective teamLab.
attractions.descriptionDe: Interaktives Museum für digitale Kunst des Kollektivs teamLab mit grenzenlosen Projektionsräumen.

attractions.name: The National Art Center, Tokyo (NACT)
attractions.description: Undulating glass-facade exhibition space in Roppongi designed by Kisho Kurokawa.

attractions.name: Mori Art Museum & Tokyo City View
attractions.description: Contemporary art museum and 52nd-floor indoor observation deck atop Roppongi Hills Mori Tower.

attractions.name: Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building Observatories
attractions.description: Twin 243-meter towers in Shinjuku designed by Kenzo Tange with free 45th-floor panoramic observation rooms.

attractions.name: Hamarikyu Gardens
attractions.description: Seventeenth-century Tokugawa shogunate tidal pond garden surrounded by the Shiodome skyscraper skyline on Tokyo Bay.

attractions.name: Rikugien Gardens
attractions.description: Edo-period stroll garden built around 1700 reproducing 88 poetic scenes from classical Waka literature.

attractions.name: Koishikawa Korakuen Gardens
attractions.description: One of Tokyo's oldest surviving feudal Japanese gardens, begun in 1629 by the Mito Tokugawa clan.

attractions.name: Kiyosumi Gardens
attractions.description: Meiji-era traditional stroll garden famous for stepping stones (iso-watari) and decorative rocks gathered from across Japan.

attractions.name: Nezu Museum
attractions.description: Museum in Minami-Aoyama designed by Kengo Kuma displaying pre-modern Japanese and East Asian art alongside a mossy bamboo garden.

attractions.name: Edo-Tokyo Open Air Architectural Museum
attractions.description: Open-air museum in Koganei Park preserving 30 relocated historic Tokyo buildings from the Edo to Showa eras.

attractions.name: Sumida Hokusai Museum
attractions.description: Angular aluminum-panel museum in Ryogoku dedicated to ukiyo-e woodblock master Katsushika Hokusai.

attractions.name: Edo-Tokyo Museum
attractions.description: Monumental stilted museum in Ryogoku dedicated to the social and urban history of Edo and modern Tokyo.

attractions.name: Zojo-ji Temple
attractions.description: Head temple of Jodo Buddhism in the Kanto region and mausoleum of six Tokugawa shoguns, framed directly by Tokyo Tower.

attractions.name: Kanda Myojin Shrine
attractions.description: Nearly 1,300-year-old Shinto shrine near Akihabara revered by merchants and tech workers.

attractions.name: Yushima Tenmangu (Yushima Tenjin)
attractions.description: Ancient Shinto shrine founded in 458 AD dedicated to the deity of scholarship and famous for 300 plum trees.

attractions.name: Hie Shrine
attractions.description: Hilltop Shinto shrine in Nagatacho famous for its tunnel of vermilion torii gates climbing the forested slope.

attractions.name: Nezu Shrine
attractions.description: 1706 Shinto shrine in Bunkyo featuring Edo-era lacquered buildings, a torii gate path, and a 3,000-plant azalea hillside.

attractions.name: Gotoku-ji Temple
attractions.description: Seventeenth-century Buddhist temple in Setagaya legendary as the birthplace of the Maneki-neko (beckoning cat) figurines.

attractions.name: Sengaku-ji Temple
attractions.description: Soto Zen temple in Minato famous as the burial site of the loyal 47 Ronin and their master Asano Naganori.

attractions.name: Yasukuni Shrine & Yushukan Museum
attractions.description: 1869 Shinto shrine in Chiyoda famous for Tokyo's benchmark cherry blossom tree and massive bronze torii gate.

attractions.name: Yanaka Ginza & Yanaka Cemetery Historic Walk
attractions.description: Preserved pre-war Shitamachi neighborhood and cherry-tree-lined historic cemetery holding the grave of the last shogun, Tokugawa Yoshinobu.

attractions.name: Odaiba Marine Park & Statue of Liberty Replica
attractions.description: Waterfront beach park on Tokyo Bay offering views of the Rainbow Bridge and a bronze replica of the French Statue of Liberty.

attractions.name: Rainbow Bridge
attractions.description: 798-meter suspension bridge spanning northern Tokyo Bay between Shibaura Pier and the Odaiba waterfront.

attractions.name: Miraikan (National Museum of Emerging Science and Innovation)
attractions.description: Futuristic science museum in Odaiba showcasing robotics, space exploration, and a giant suspended Geo-Cosmos LED globe.

attractions.name: Small Worlds Miniature Museum
attractions.description: Indoor miniature theme park in Ariake displaying moving 1:80 scale worlds with aircraft and space shuttles.
attractions.descriptionDe: Miniatur-Themenpark in Ariake mit beweglichen Welten im Maßstab 1:80, darunter Flugzeuge und Raumfähren.

attractions.name: Inokashira Park
attractions.description: Scenic park in Musashino and Mitaka centered around Inokashira Pond and a historic Benzaiten island shrine.

attractions.name: Ghibli Museum (Mitaka)
attractions.description: Whimsical animation museum in Inokashira Park designed by Hayao Miyazaki showcasing the art of Studio Ghibli.
attractions.descriptionDe: Verspieltes Animationsmuseum im Inokashira-Park, entworfen von Hayao Miyazaki, über die Kunst von Studio Ghibli.

attractions.name: Yoyogi Park
attractions.description: Expansive 134-acre urban park adjacent to Harajuku and Meiji Shrine, formerly the 1964 Tokyo Olympic Village.

attractions.name: Chidorigafuchi Moat & Park
attractions.description: Northwestern moat of the Imperial Palace where hundreds of weeping cherry trees hang over rowboats in spring.
attractions.descriptionDe: Nordwestlicher Wassergraben des Kaiserpalasts, über dem im Frühling Hunderte Hängekirschen über Ruderbooten hängen.

attractions.name: Kabukiza Theatre & Gallery
attractions.description: Principal theater in Ginza for traditional Kabuki drama featuring a Japanese baroque castle-style facade and rooftop garden.

attractions.name: Tokyo Station Marunouchi Building & Tokyo Station Gallery
attractions.description: Restored 1914 Queen Anne-style red-brick railway station designed by Tatsuno Kingo.

attractions.name: State Guest House, Akasaka Palace
attractions.description: 1909 Neo-Baroque former Crown Prince's Palace modeled after Buckingham Palace and Versailles, a National Treasure.

attractions.name: Suntory Museum of Art
attractions.description: Art museum in Tokyo Midtown designed by Kengo Kuma focusing on traditional Japanese 'Art in Life' lacquerware, glass, and paintings.

attractions.name: 21_21 DESIGN SIGHT
attractions.description: Subterranean concrete-and-steel design museum in Midtown Garden created by architect Tadao Ando and designer Issey Miyake.
attractions.descriptionDe: Unterirdisches Designmuseum aus Beton und Stahl im Midtown Garden, geschaffen von Tadao Ando und Issey Miyake.

attractions.name: Mount Takao (Takaosan)
attractions.description: Sacred 599-meter forested mountain within western Tokyo limits featuring Yakuo-in Temple and views of Mount Fuji.
attractions.descriptionDe: Heiliger, 599 Meter hoher bewaldeter Berg im Westen Tokios mit dem Yakuo-in-Tempel und Blick auf den Fuji.

cities.name: New York City
cities.source_note: Mastercard GDCI (#7 Global Arrivals), New York City Tourism + Conventions, & Euromonitor Top 100 City Destinations Index (#6 Overall Index)

attractions.name: Statue of Liberty National Monument
attractions.description: Colossal 1886 copper neoclassical sculpture gifted by France on Liberty Island in New York Harbor.

attractions.name: Ellis Island National Museum of Immigration
attractions.description: Restored historic immigration station that processed over 12 million immigrants entering the United States between 1892 and 1954.
attractions.descriptionDe: Restaurierte historische Einwanderungsstation, die zwischen 1892 und 1954 über 12 Millionen Einwanderer abfertigte.

attractions.name: Central Park
attractions.description: Iconic 843-acre landscaped urban park in Manhattan designed by Frederick Law Olmsted and Calvert Vaux.

attractions.name: Empire State Building
attractions.description: World-famous 102-story Art Deco skyscraper completed in 1931 with 86th- and 102nd-floor observatories.

attractions.name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art (The Met)
attractions.description: The largest art museum in the Americas, spanning 5,000 years of world art along the Fifth Avenue Museum Mile.

attractions.name: Times Square
attractions.description: Illuminated commercial intersection and entertainment hub at the junction of Broadway and Seventh Avenue.

attractions.name: Brooklyn Bridge
attractions.description: Historic 1883 hybrid cable-stayed/suspension bridge with stone Neo-Gothic towers spanning the East River.

attractions.name: 9/11 Memorial & Museum
attractions.description: Twin reflecting waterfall pools in the footprints of the original World Trade Center towers alongside an underground museum.

attractions.name: One World Observatory (One World Trade Center)
attractions.description: Observation deck on floors 100–102 of the tallest building in the Western Hemisphere (1,776 feet).

attractions.name: Top of the Rock (Rockefeller Center)
attractions.description: Three-tiered indoor and outdoor observation deck atop 30 Rockefeller Plaza with direct views of Central Park and the Empire State Building.

attractions.name: The High Line
attractions.description: 1.45-mile elevated linear park and public art trail built on a historic freight rail viaduct on Manhattan's West Side.

attractions.name: The Museum of Modern Art (MoMA)
attractions.description: Influential modern and contemporary art museum in Midtown housing Van Gogh's 'The Starry Night' and Picasso's 'Les Demoiselles d'Avignon'.

attractions.name: American Museum of Natural History
attractions.description: Sprawling scientific museum on the Upper West Side famous for its dinosaur fossil halls, Rose Center planetarium, and blue whale model.

attractions.name: Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum
attractions.description: UNESCO World Heritage cylindrical spiral museum designed by Frank Lloyd Wright on the Upper East Side.

attractions.name: Grand Central Terminal
attractions.description: 1913 Beaux-Arts commuter rail terminal famous for its celestial ceiling mural in the Main Concourse and four-faced brass clock.

attractions.name: SUMMIT One Vanderbilt
attractions.description: Multi-sensory mirrored glass observation experience perched 1,100 feet above Midtown Manhattan next to Grand Central.

attractions.name: Edge at Hudson Yards
attractions.description: The highest outdoor sky deck in the Western Hemisphere, jutting 100 stories into the air with an angled glass floor.

attractions.name: Vessel (Hudson Yards)
attractions.description: 150-foot honeycomb-like copper-clad structure of 154 interconnecting flights of stairs designed by Thomas Heatherwick.

attractions.name: Little Island
attractions.description: Public park piers resting on 132 concrete 'tulip' pots floating over the Hudson River at Pier 55.

attractions.name: St. Patrick's Cathedral
attractions.description: Monumental Neo-Gothic Roman Catholic cathedral with 330-foot spires occupying a full city block on Fifth Avenue.

attractions.name: New York Public Library (Stephen A. Schwarzman Building)
attractions.description: 1911 Beaux-Arts marble landmark guarded by the stone lions Patience and Fortitude and housing the Rose Main Reading Room.
attractions.descriptionDe: Beaux-Arts-Wahrzeichen aus Marmor von 1911, bewacht von den Steinlöwen Patience und Fortitude, mit dem Rose Main Reading Room.

attractions.name: Bryant Park
attractions.description: French-style 9.6-acre public park behind the New York Public Library surrounded by Midtown skyscrapers.

attractions.name: Flatiron Building
attractions.description: Iconic 1902 triangular 22-story steel-frame Renaissance Revival landmark at 23rd Street and Fifth Avenue.

attractions.name: Washington Square Park & Arch
attractions.description: Greenwich Village public park anchored by the 1892 marble Washington Square Arch modeled on the Arc de Triomphe.

attractions.name: Whitney Museum of American Art
attractions.description: Museum in the Meatpacking District designed by Renzo Piano dedicated to 20th- and 21st-century American art.

attractions.name: The Frick Collection
attractions.description: Gilded Age mansion on Fifth Avenue housing Old Master paintings by Bellini, Vermeer, Rembrandt, and Titian.

attractions.name: The Met Cloisters
attractions.description: Branch of The Met in Fort Tryon Park built from reconstructed French and Spanish medieval abbey cloisters, housing the Unicorn Tapestries.

attractions.name: Intrepid Museum
attractions.description: Military and maritime history museum aboard the WWII aircraft carrier USS Intrepid at Pier 86, featuring the Space Shuttle Enterprise.

attractions.name: Tenement Museum
attractions.description: National Historic Site on the Lower East Side preserving restored 19th- and 20th-century immigrant apartments.

attractions.name: Morgan Library & Museum
attractions.description: Financier J. Pierpont Morgan's ornate Italian Renaissance-style library and study joined by a Renzo Piano glass pavilion.

attractions.name: Cooper Hewitt, Smithsonian Design Museum
attractions.description: The only museum in the United States devoted exclusively to historical and contemporary design, housed in the Andrew Carnegie Mansion.
attractions.descriptionDe: Das einzige Museum der USA, das sich ganz historischem und zeitgenössischem Design widmet, in der Villa von Andrew Carnegie.

attractions.name: Museum of the City of New York
attractions.description: Neo-Georgian museum at the top of Museum Mile celebrating the history, art, and popular culture of New York City.

attractions.name: Brooklyn Museum
attractions.description: New York City's second-largest art museum in a 560,000-square-foot Beaux-Arts building next to Prospect Park.

attractions.name: Brooklyn Botanic Garden
attractions.description: 52-acre urban botanical garden founded in 1910 famous for its Cherry Esplanade and Japanese Hill-and-Pond Garden.
attractions.descriptionDe: 21 Hektar großer botanischer Garten von 1910, berühmt für die Kirschbaumallee und den japanischen Hügel- und Teichgarten.

attractions.name: Brooklyn Bridge Park & DUMBO Waterfront
attractions.description: 85-acre sustainable waterfront park along the East River offering postcard views of the Lower Manhattan skyline.

attractions.name: Prospect Park
attractions.description: 526-acre Brooklyn masterpiece designed by Olmsted and Vaux featuring the 90-acre Long Meadow and historic boathouse.

attractions.name: New York Botanical Garden (Bronx)
attractions.description: 250-acre National Historic Landmark garden in the Bronx featuring the 1902 Victorian glass Enid A. Haupt Conservatory and an old-growth forest.

attractions.name: Bronx Zoo
attractions.description: One of the largest metropolitan wildlife conservation parks in the world, spanning 265 acres along the Bronx River.

attractions.name: Radio City Music Hall
attractions.description: 1932 Art Deco entertainment palace at Rockefeller Center nicknamed the 'Showplace of the Nation'.

attractions.name: Carnegie Hall
attractions.description: Historic 1891 Italian Renaissance-style concert venue in Midtown renowned for its acoustics.

attractions.name: Wall Street, Federal Hall & Charging Bull
attractions.description: Historic heart of the Financial District featuring the site of George Washington's 1789 inauguration and Arturo Di Modica's bronze bull.

attractions.name: Trinity Church
attractions.description: 1846 Gothic Revival parish church at Wall Street and Broadway, burial site of Alexander Hamilton.

attractions.name: Cathedral of St. John the Divine
attractions.description: Colossal Episcopal cathedral in Morningside Heights, one of the largest church buildings in the world.

attractions.name: Roosevelt Island Tramway & Four Freedoms Park
attractions.description: Aerial commuter tramway over the East River leading to Louis Kahn's granite memorial park for Franklin D. Roosevelt.

attractions.name: Governors Island
attractions.description: 172-acre car-free seasonal park and historic military fort island in New York Harbor 800 yards from Lower Manhattan.

attractions.name: Staten Island Ferry & Whitehall Terminal
attractions.description: Free historic commuter ferry route across Upper New York Bay offering close-up harbor views of the Statue of Liberty.

attractions.name: Coney Island Boardwalk & Luna Park
attractions.description: Historic 2.7-mile wooden seaside boardwalk in Brooklyn home to the 1927 Cyclone wooden roller coaster and Deno's Wonder Wheel.

attractions.name: Flushing Meadows–Corona Park & Unisphere
attractions.description: Queens' largest park, site of the 1939 and 1964 World's Fairs, anchored by the 140-foot stainless-steel Unisphere globe.

attractions.name: MoMA PS1
attractions.description: One of the largest and oldest contemporary art institutions in the United States, housed in a former Romanesque Revival school in Long Island City.

attractions.name: New-York Historical Society
attractions.description: New York's first museum (founded 1804), overlooking Central Park and displaying four centuries of American history and Tiffany lamps.

cities.name: Barcelona
cities.source_note: Observatori del Turisme a Barcelona, Euromonitor Top 100 City Destinations Index (#10 Overall Index), & Mastercard GDCI (#17)

attractions.name: Basílica de la Sagrada Família
attractions.description: Antoni Gaudí's unfinished UNESCO World Heritage basilica famous for its organic tree-like columns and towering sculpted facades.

attractions.name: Park Güell
attractions.description: Hillside public park designed by Antoni Gaudí featuring colorful trencadís mosaic salamanders, undulating benches, and gingerbread gatehouses.

attractions.name: Casa Batlló
attractions.description: Gaudí's 1904 Modernista remodel on Passeig de Gràcia known as the 'House of Bones' with a dragon-scale ceramic roof.

attractions.name: Casa Milà (La Pedrera)
attractions.description: UNESCO-listed 1912 Antoni Gaudí apartment building with an undulating limestone facade and surrealist chimney warriors on the roof.

attractions.name: Gothic Quarter (Barri Gòtic)
attractions.description: Medieval labyrinth of Roman walls, Gothic plazas, and narrow cobbled lanes in the historic center of Ciutat Vella.

attractions.name: Barcelona Cathedral (Catedral de la Santa Creu i Santa Eulàlia)
attractions.description: Fourteenth-century Catalan Gothic cathedral famous for its gargoyles, rooftop views, and cloister with 13 white geese.

attractions.name: Palau de la Música Catalana
attractions.description: 1908 Catalan Modernista concert hall designed by Lluís Domènech i Montaner, crowned by an inverted stained-glass skylight dome.

attractions.name: Picasso Museum (Museu Picasso)
attractions.description: Five contiguous medieval stone palaces in El Born housing 4,251 works from Pablo Picasso's formative years.

attractions.name: Casa Vicens
attractions.description: Antoni Gaudí's first residential house design (1883–1885), a colorful Moorish-inspired summer villa in Gràcia.

attractions.name: Palau Güell
attractions.description: Early Gaudí mansion off La Rambla built for industrialist Eusebi Güell, centered around a parabolic dome and mosaic roof chimneys.

attractions.name: Recinte Modernista de Sant Pau
attractions.description: The world's largest Art Nouveau architectural complex, a former 20th-century garden hospital of red-brick pavilions and underground tunnels.

attractions.name: Museu Nacional d'Art de Catalunya (MNAC)
attractions.description: Palau Nacional on Montjuïc Hill housing the world's finest collection of Romanesque church frescoes and Catalan Modernisme.

attractions.name: Fundació Joan Miró
attractions.description: White rationalist museum on Montjuïc designed by Josep Lluís Sert showcasing paintings, tapestries, and sculptures by Joan Miró.
attractions.descriptionDe: Weißes rationalistisches Museum auf dem Montjuïc von Josep Lluís Sert mit Gemälden, Wandteppichen und Skulpturen von Joan Miró.

attractions.name: Castell de Montjuïc
attractions.description: Seventeenth-century hilltop military fortress at 173 meters elevation offering 360-degree views of the Mediterranean Sea and city port.
attractions.descriptionDe: Militärfestung aus dem 17. Jahrhundert auf 173 Metern Höhe mit Rundumblick auf das Mittelmeer und den Hafen.

attractions.name: Magic Fountain of Montjuïc (Font Màgica)
attractions.description: Monumental 1929 International Exposition fountain below the Palau Nacional famous for choreographed water and light displays.

attractions.name: Parc de la Ciutadella
attractions.description: Nineteenth-century 70-acre oasis in Ciutat Vella featuring the Cascada Monumental fountain (co-designed by a young Gaudí), a boating lake, and the Catalan Parliament.

attractions.name: Arc de Triomf
attractions.description: Red-brick Neo-Mudéjar triumphal arch built by Josep Vilaseca as the main gateway to the 1888 Barcelona Universal Exposition.

attractions.name: Basílica de Santa Maria del Mar
attractions.description: Pure 14th-century Catalan Gothic church in the Ribera district built by the maritime guilds in just 55 years.

attractions.name: Basílica de Santa Maria del Pi
attractions.description: Fourteenth-century Gothic church with a single wide nave and one of the largest rose windows in Europe.
attractions.descriptionDe: Gotische Kirche aus dem 14. Jahrhundert mit einem einzigen breiten Schiff und einer der größten Fensterrosen Europas.

attractions.name: Temple Expiatori del Sagrat Cor (Tibidabo)
attractions.description: Neo-Gothic church crowned by a bronze Sacred Heart statue atop the 512-meter summit of Mount Tibidabo.
attractions.descriptionDe: Neugotische Kirche auf dem 512 Meter hohen Tibidabo, gekrönt von einer bronzenen Herz-Jesu-Statue.

attractions.name: Tibidabo Skywalk & Collserola Natural Park
attractions.description: Highest viewpoint in the Serra de Collserola mountain range overlooking the entire Barcelona coastline.

attractions.name: Torre de Collserola
attractions.description: 288-meter telecommunications tower designed by Norman Foster for the 1992 Olympics with a 10th-floor glass observation deck.

attractions.name: Bunkers del Carmel (Turó de la Rovira)
attractions.description: Hilltop site of Spanish Civil War anti-aircraft batteries at 262 meters offering unobstructed 360-degree city views.
attractions.descriptionDe: Ehemalige Flakstellungen aus dem Spanischen Bürgerkrieg auf 262 Metern Höhe mit freiem Rundumblick über die Stadt.

attractions.name: Torre Glòries (Mirador Torre Glòries)
attractions.description: 144-meter bullet-shaped glass skyscraper designed by Jean Nouvel with a 30th-floor dome observatory and cloud sculpture.

attractions.name: Columbus Monument (Mirador de Colom)
attractions.description: 60-meter cast-iron column built in 1888 at the foot of La Rambla with a lift inside leading to a harbor-view gallery.
attractions.descriptionDe: 60 Meter hohe gusseiserne Säule von 1888 am Ende der Rambla, mit Aufzug zu einer Aussichtsgalerie über dem Hafen.

attractions.name: Barceloneta Beach & Maritime Promenade
attractions.description: Historic seaside neighborhood beach stretching along the Mediterranean coast with Frank Gehry's Golden Fish sculpture nearby.

attractions.name: Poble Espanyol
attractions.description: 1929 open-air architectural museum on Montjuïc recreating 117 full-scale buildings, squares, and streets from across Spain's regions.

attractions.name: Anella Olímpica (Montjuïc Olympic Ring)
attractions.description: 1992 Summer Olympics park housing the Lluís Companys Olympic Stadium, Palau Sant Jordi, and Santiago Calatrava's telecommunications tower.
attractions.descriptionDe: Olympiapark der Spiele von 1992 mit dem Olympiastadion Lluís Companys, dem Palau Sant Jordi und Calatravas Fernmeldeturm.

attractions.name: Museu d'Història de Barcelona (MUHBA Plaça del Rei)
attractions.description: Medieval royal plaza museum where visitors descend underground to walk through 4,000 square meters of preserved Roman Barcino ruins.

attractions.name: MACBA (Museu d'Art Contemporani de Barcelona)
attractions.description: White modernist museum in El Raval designed by Richard Meier dedicated to post-1945 contemporary art.

attractions.name: CCCB (Centre de Cultura Contemporània de Barcelona)
attractions.description: Multidisciplinary arts and exhibition center housed in the restored 18th-century Casa de la Caritat with a tilted glass courtyard.
attractions.descriptionDe: Kunst- und Ausstellungszentrum in der restaurierten Casa de la Caritat aus dem 18. Jahrhundert mit geneigtem Glashof.

attractions.name: CosmoCaixa Barcelona
attractions.description: Interactive science museum in a 1904 Modernista building featuring a 1,000-square-meter flooded Amazonian Rainforest greenhouse.
attractions.descriptionDe: Interaktives Wissenschaftsmuseum in einem Modernisme-Bau von 1904 mit einem 1.000 Quadratmeter großen gefluteten Amazonas-Regenwald.

attractions.name: Museu Marítim de Barcelona (Drassanes Reials)
attractions.description: Maritime museum housed inside the monumental 13th-century Gothic Royal Shipyards displaying a full-scale 1571 royal galley.

attractions.name: El Born Centre de Cultura i Memòria
attractions.description: 1876 cast-iron market hall preserving excavated archaeological ruins of the neighborhood destroyed in the 1714 Siege of Barcelona.

attractions.name: Monestir de Pedralbes
attractions.description: Founded in 1327 by Queen Elisenda de Montcada, featuring a three-story Gothic cloister.

attractions.name: Parc del Laberint d'Horta
attractions.description: Barcelona's oldest conserved garden (1791), featuring a neoclassical cypress hedge maze and romantic waterfalls.

attractions.name: Jardí Botànic de Barcelona
attractions.description: 34-acre triangular terraced botanical garden on Montjuïc showcasing Mediterranean-climate flora from five continents.

attractions.name: Jardins de Mossèn Costa i Llobera
attractions.description: Cliffside botanical garden on Montjuïc facing the sea, home to one of Europe's largest collections of cacti and succulents.

attractions.name: Museu del Disseny de Barcelona (Design Hub)
attractions.description: Modern metal-clad museum at Plaça de les Glòries housing 70,000 decorative arts, industrial design, fashion, and graphic objects.

attractions.name: Fundació Antoni Tàpies
attractions.description: 1880s early Modernista publishing house topped by a tangled wire sculpture ('Cloud and Chair'), showcasing works by Antoni Tàpies.
attractions.descriptionDe: Modernisme-Verlagshaus aus den 1880er-Jahren mit einer Drahtskulptur auf dem Dach, Museum für die Werke von Antoni Tàpies.

attractions.name: Moco Museum Barcelona
attractions.description: Independent museum in the 16th-century Palau Cervelló exhibiting modern, contemporary, and street art including Banksy and Basquiat.

attractions.name: Museu Egipci de Barcelona (Egyptian Museum)
attractions.description: Private Egyptology museum in Eixample displaying over 1,200 pharaonic sarcophagi, mummies, and jewelry pieces.
attractions.descriptionDe: Privates Ägyptenmuseum im Eixample mit über 1.200 Objekten wie Sarkophagen, Mumien und Schmuck aus der Pharaonenzeit.

attractions.name: Palau de la Virreina
attractions.description: 1778 Baroque palace on La Rambla serving as the city's center for visual arts and photography exhibitions.

attractions.name: Casa Amatller
attractions.description: 1900 Modernista mansion by Josep Puig i Cadafalch next to Casa Batlló featuring a stepped Dutch-style ceramic gable.

attractions.name: Casa Lleó Morera
attractions.description: 1902 Lluís Domènech i Montaner floral Modernista landmark completing the famous 'Illes de la Discòrdia' block.

attractions.name: Bellesguard (Casa Figueras)
attractions.description: Neo-Gothic castle-like manor designed by Antoni Gaudí between 1900 and 1909 on the medieval ruins of King Martin I's palace.

attractions.name: Pavellons Güell
attractions.description: Early Gaudí gatehouse complex in Pedralbes famous for its wrought-iron mythical dragon gate targeting the Garden of the Hesperides.

attractions.name: Mies van der Rohe Pavilion (Barcelona Pavilion)
attractions.description: Iconic 1929 International Exposition modernist structure of glass, steel, travertine, and red onyx.

attractions.name: Plaça d'Espanya & Venetian Towers
attractions.description: Monumental circular plaza built for the 1929 Exposition, flanked by two 47-meter red-brick campanile towers and Las Arenas bullring.

attractions.name: Port Vell & Rambla de Mar
attractions.description: Historic harborfront connected by a wavy wooden swing footbridge leading out over the water.

cities.name: Rome
cities.source_note: Ente Bilaterale Turismo del Lazio (EBTL), ISTAT, & Euromonitor Top 100 City Destinations Index (#4 Overall Index)

attractions.name: The Colosseum (Flavian Amphitheatre)
attractions.description: The largest ancient amphitheater ever built (80 AD), an elliptical travertine and brick icon of Imperial Rome.

attractions.name: Roman Forum (Foro Romano)
attractions.description: Monumental archaeological plaza of ancient temples, basilicas, and triumphal arches that formed the heart of ancient Roman public life.

attractions.name: Palatine Hill (Monte Palatino)
attractions.description: The centermost of the Seven Hills of Rome, legendary birthplace of the city and site of imperial palaces overlooking the Circus Maximus.

attractions.name: Pantheon
attractions.description: Best-preserved monument of ancient Rome (125 AD), crowned by the world's largest unreinforced concrete dome and central oculus.

attractions.name: Trevi Fountain (Fontana di Trevi)
attractions.description: Monumental 1762 Late Baroque travertine fountain designed by Nicola Salvi depicting Oceanus in a shell chariot.

attractions.name: St. Peter's Basilica & Square
attractions.description: The world's largest Renaissance church, featuring Michelangelo's dome and Pietà and Bernini's quadruple colonnade in the Vatican enclave.

attractions.name: Vatican Museums & Sistine Chapel
attractions.description: Papal art galleries housing classical sculptures like Laocoön and Michelangelo's ceiling frescoes in the Sistine Chapel.

attractions.name: Spanish Steps & Piazza di Spagna
attractions.description: Monumental 135-step Rococo stairway built in 1725 linking the Trinità dei Monti church with Pietro Bernini's Barcaccia Fountain.

attractions.name: Piazza Navona & Fontana dei Quattro Fiumi
attractions.description: Baroque public square built over the 1st-century Stadium of Domitian, anchored by Bernini's Fountain of the Four Rivers.

attractions.name: Castel Sant'Angelo (Mausoleum of Hadrian)
attractions.description: Cylindrical 2nd-century Roman imperial mausoleum on the Tiber transformed into a medieval papal fortress and Renaissance museum.

attractions.name: Galleria Borghese
attractions.description: Seventeenth-century cardinal's villa displaying masterpieces of sculpture by Bernini and Canova alongside paintings by Caravaggio and Raphael.

attractions.name: Villa Borghese Gardens & Pincio Terrace
attractions.description: Rome's third-largest public park (197 acres) containing neoclassical temples, a lake, and the sunset viewpoint over Piazza del Popolo.

attractions.name: Piazza del Popolo
attractions.description: Neoclassical northern gateway plaza designed by Giuseppe Valadier featuring twin Baroque churches and an ancient Egyptian obelisk.

attractions.name: Capitoline Museums (Musei Capitolini)
attractions.description: The world's oldest public museum collection (founded 1471 by Pope Sixtus IV) in Michelangelo's Piazza del Campidoglio.

attractions.name: Altare della Patria (Victor Emmanuel II National Monument)
attractions.description: Colossal white marble monument on the Capitoline Hill featuring a rooftop panoramic terrace (Terrazza delle Quadrighe).

attractions.name: Baths of Caracalla (Terme di Caracalla)
attractions.description: Massive 3rd-century AD Roman public thermal bath ruins preserving towering brick vaults and mosaic floors.

attractions.name: Baths of Diocletian & Basilica of Santa Maria degli Angeli
attractions.description: Largest of the imperial Roman baths, with its frigidarium converted into a basilica by Michelangelo and Charterhouse museum.

attractions.name: Palazzo Massimo alle Terme (National Roman Museum)
attractions.description: Archaeological museum housing the world's finest collection of ancient Roman frescoes (Villa of Livia), mosaics, and bronze statues.

attractions.name: Palazzo Altemps (National Roman Museum)
attractions.description: Sixteenth-century Renaissance palace near Piazza Navona displaying aristocratic collections of Greek and Roman marble sculpture.
attractions.descriptionDe: Renaissancepalast aus dem 16. Jahrhundert nahe der Piazza Navona mit Adelssammlungen griechischer und römischer Marmorskulpturen.

attractions.name: Domus Aurea (Nero's Golden House)
attractions.description: Subterranean frescoed pavilion rooms of Emperor Nero's extravagant 1st-century palace beneath the Oppian Hill.

attractions.name: Trajan's Market & Trajan's Column
attractions.description: Semicircular 2nd-century Roman administrative complex alongside the 30-meter spiral relief column celebrating Emperor Trajan's Dacian victories.

attractions.name: Arch of Constantine
attractions.description: Triumphal triple arch erected in 315 AD between the Colosseum and Palatine Hill to commemorate Constantine I's victory at the Milvian Bridge.

attractions.name: Circus Maximus (Circo Massimo)
attractions.description: Ancient Roman chariot-racing stadium valley capable of seating 150,000 spectators beneath the imperial palaces of the Palatine.

attractions.name: Bocca della Verità & Basilica of Santa Maria in Cosmedin
attractions.description: Ancient marble drain-cover carving of a bearded river god in the portico of a medieval church featuring Cosmatesque floors.

attractions.name: Basilica of Santa Maria Maggiore
attractions.description: Fifth-century papal major basilica on the Esquiline Hill preserving shimmering early Christian 5th-century nave mosaics.

attractions.name: Archbasilica of St. John Lateran (San Giovanni in Laterano)
attractions.description: The official ecclesiastical seat (Cathedral) of the Bishop of Rome and the oldest public church in the city (founded 324 AD).

attractions.name: Basilica of Saint Paul Outside the Walls
attractions.description: Monumental papal basilica founded by Emperor Constantine over the burial place of Paul the Apostle with a golden mosaic facade.

attractions.name: Basilica of San Clemente al Laterano
attractions.description: Three-tiered archaeological complex stacking a 12th-century basilica over a 4th-century Christian church and a 1st-century pagan Mithraeum.

attractions.name: Basilica of Santa Maria in Trastevere
attractions.description: One of Rome's oldest churches, anchoring the heart of Trastevere with glittering 12th- and 13th-century golden mosaics by Pietro Cavallini.

attractions.name: San Pietro in Vincoli (Saint Peter in Chains)
attractions.description: Fifth-century basilica famous for housing Michelangelo's horned marble statue of Moses on the Tomb of Pope Julius II.

attractions.name: Church of St. Louis of the French (San Luigi dei Francesi)
attractions.description: National church of France near Piazza Navona housing Caravaggio's three famous paintings on the life of Saint Matthew.

attractions.name: Church of Sant'Ignazio di Loyola
attractions.description: Baroque Jesuit church celebrated for Andrea Pozzo's trompe-l'oeil illusionistic ceiling fresco and fake painted dome.

attractions.name: Galleria Doria Pamphilj
attractions.description: Private princely palace on Via del Corso displaying over 400 Old Master paintings in gilded Baroque gallery halls, including Velázquez's Portrait of Innocent X.

attractions.name: Palazzo Barberini (Galleria Nazionale d'Arte Antica)
attractions.description: Seventeenth-century Baroque palace designed by Maderno, Bernini, and Borromini housing paintings by Raphael, Caravaggio, and Holbein.

attractions.name: Palazzo Colonna
attractions.description: One of Rome's oldest and largest private noble palaces, famous for its 76-meter High Baroque Great Hall of frescoes and chandeliers.

attractions.name: Villa Farnesina
attractions.description: High Renaissance suburban villa in Trastevere decorated with frescoes by Raphael, including 'The Triumph of Galatea'.

attractions.name: MAXXI (National Museum of 21st Century Arts)
attractions.description: Fluid concrete-and-glass contemporary art and architecture museum in Flaminio designed by Zaha Hadid.

attractions.name: Galleria Nazionale d'Arte Moderna e Contemporanea (GNAM)
attractions.description: Neoclassical palace near Villa Borghese holding Italy's largest collection of 19th- and 20th-century art.

attractions.name: Ara Pacis Museum
attractions.description: Richard Meier glass pavilion on the Tiber housing Augustus's 9 BC white marble Altar of Augustan Peace.

attractions.name: Largo di Torre Argentina (Sacred Area)
attractions.description: Sunken square containing the ruins of four Republican Roman temples and the Pompey's Curia site where Julius Caesar was assassinated in 44 BC.

attractions.name: Theatre of Marcellus (Teatro di Marcello)
attractions.description: Open-air ancient Roman theater completed by Augustus in 13 BC whose travertine arcades inspired the Colosseum and now support a Renaissance palace.

attractions.name: Piazza del Campidoglio
attractions.description: Hilltop trapezoidal Renaissance square designed by Michelangelo atop the Capitoline Hill with a bronze equestrian statue of Marcus Aurelius.

attractions.name: Campo de' Fiori
attractions.description: Lively rectangular square centered around the 1889 hooded bronze monument to philosopher Giordano Bruno.

attractions.name: Janiculum Hill (Gianicolo)
attractions.description: Ridge above Trastevere offering one of the finest panoramic views of Rome's domes alongside the monumental Fontana dell'Acqua Paola.

attractions.name: Aventine Hill, Orange Garden (Giardino degli Aranci) & Keyhole
attractions.description: Walled bitter-orange garden overlooking the Tiber next to the Priory of the Knights of Malta keyhole framing St. Peter's dome.
attractions.descriptionDe: Ummauerter Orangengarten mit Blick über den Tiber, nebenan das berühmte Schlüsselloch des Malteserordens mit Blick auf die Peterskuppel.

attractions.name: Appian Way Regional Park (Via Appia Antica)
attractions.description: Preserved ancient Roman basalt-paved road (312 BC) lined with umbrella pines, Roman aqueducts, and ancient tombs.
attractions.descriptionDe: Erhaltene antike Römerstraße von 312 v. Chr. mit Basaltpflaster, gesäumt von Pinien, Aquädukten und antiken Gräbern.

attractions.name: Catacombs of St. Callixtus (Catacombe di San Callisto)
attractions.description: Four-level underground early Christian burial network along the Appian Way containing the Crypt of the Popes.

attractions.name: Capuchin Crypt (Museo e Cripta dei Cappuccini)
attractions.description: Museum and six subterranean chapels beneath Santa Maria della Concezione decorated with the skeletal remains of 3,700 Capuchin friars.
attractions.descriptionDe: Museum und sechs unterirdische Kapellen unter Santa Maria della Concezione, geschmückt mit den Gebeinen von 3.700 Kapuzinermönchen.

attractions.name: Pyramid of Cestius & Non-Catholic Cemetery
attractions.description: 36-meter white marble-faced Roman tomb built around 12 BC beside the peaceful garden cemetery holding the graves of John Keats and Percy Bysshe Shelley.

attractions.name: Orto Botanico di Roma (Botanical Garden of Rome)
attractions.description: 12-hectare hillside botanical garden in Trastevere behind Palazzo Corsini featuring 3,000 plant species, Japanese gardens, and monumental fountains.

cities.name: Milan
cities.source_note: Mastercard GDCI (#16 Global Arrivals), Euromonitor Top 100 City Destinations Index (#5 Overall Index), & Comune di Milano

attractions.name: Duomo di Milano (Milan Cathedral) & Rooftop Terraces
attractions.description: The largest Gothic cathedral in Italy, built in pink Candoglia marble and crowned by 135 spires and the golden Madonnina.

attractions.name: Convent of Santa Maria delle Grazie & The Last Supper
attractions.description: UNESCO World Heritage Dominican convent refectory housing Leonardo da Vinci's masterpiece mural 'The Last Supper'.

attractions.name: Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II
attractions.description: Italy's oldest active shopping and civic arcade (1877), topped by a soaring four-story iron-and-glass barrel vault and octagon dome.

attractions.name: Castello Sforzesco (Sforza Castle) & Civic Museums
attractions.description: Fifteenth-century red-brick fortress of the Dukes of Milan housing multiple museums and Michelangelo's unfinished Rondanini Pietà.

attractions.name: Teatro alla Scala & Museo Teatrale
attractions.description: World-renowned Neoclassical opera house inaugurated in 1778 with a museum of historic costumes, instruments, and composer portraits.

attractions.name: Pinacoteca di Brera
attractions.description: Milan's premier public art gallery in the 17th-century Palazzo Brera displaying masterpieces by Mantegna, Raphael, Bellini, and Caravaggio.

attractions.name: Parco Sempione
attractions.description: 116-acre English-style romantic park built in 1888 directly behind Sforza Castle featuring lakes, historic bridges, and lawns.

attractions.name: Arco della Pace (Arch of Peace)
attractions.description: 25-meter Neoclassical granite triumphal arch designed by Luigi Cagnola at the northwestern gateway of Parco Sempione.

attractions.name: Navigli District (Naviglio Grande & Naviglio Pavese)
attractions.description: Historic medieval canal system partially engineered by Leonardo da Vinci, lined with stone bridges, wash-houses, and artisan courtyards.
attractions.descriptionDe: Historisches Kanalsystem, teils von Leonardo da Vinci geplant, mit Steinbrücken, Waschhäusern und Handwerkerhöfen.

attractions.name: Pinacoteca Ambrosiana & Veneranda Biblioteca
attractions.description: Founded in 1609 by Cardinal Federico Borromeo, exhibiting Leonardo da Vinci's Codex Atlanticus, Caravaggio's Basket of Fruit, and Raphael's cartoon.

attractions.name: Museo Nazionale Scienza e Tecnologia Leonardo da Vinci
attractions.description: Italy's largest science and technology museum inside a 16th-century monastery, featuring wooden models of Leonardo's inventions and the Toti submarine.

attractions.name: Basilica di Sant'Ambrogio
attractions.description: Founded by St. Ambrose in 379 AD and rebuilt in 1099, the preeminent archetype of Lombard Romanesque red-brick architecture.

attractions.name: Chiesa di San Maurizio al Monastero Maggiore
attractions.description: Sixteenth-century former Benedictine convent church nicknamed the 'Sistine Chapel of Milan' for its floor-to-ceiling Renaissance frescoes by Bernardino Luini.

attractions.name: Fondazione Prada
attractions.description: Contemporary art and culture complex designed by Rem Koolhaas/OMA inside a 1910 gin distillery, featuring a 24-karat gold-leaf tower.

attractions.name: Museo del Novecento
attractions.description: Twentieth-century Italian art museum inside the Palazzo dell'Arengario on Piazza del Duomo, famous for Boccioni's Futurist works.

attractions.name: Bosco Verticale & Biblioteca degli Alberi (BAM)
attractions.description: Award-winning twin residential towers planted with 800 trees overlooking a contemporary geometric botanical park in Porta Nuova.
attractions.descriptionDe: Preisgekrönte Wohntürme mit 800 Bäumen auf den Balkonen, daneben ein moderner Park in Porta Nuova.

attractions.name: Torre Branca
attractions.description: 108.6-meter hexagonal steel observation tower in Parco Sempione designed by Gio Ponti in 1933.

attractions.name: Cimitero Monumentale di Milano
attractions.description: Open-air sculpture museum and civic necropolis opened in 1866 filled with elaborate artistic tombs and the Famedio pantheon.

attractions.name: Palazzo Reale di Milano
attractions.description: Former seat of Milanese government for centuries on Piazza del Duomo, now a grand exhibition palace with the Neoclassical Hall of Caryatids.

attractions.name: Museo Poldi Pezzoli
attractions.description: Nineteenth-century aristocratic house-museum displaying Northern Italian and Flemish Renaissance paintings, antique clocks, and armor.

attractions.name: Museo Bagatti Valsecchi
attractions.description: Historic Neo-Renaissance mansion in Montenapoleone preserving a 19th-century collection of 15th- and 16th-century Italian decorative arts.

attractions.name: Villa Necchi Campiglio
attractions.description: 1935 Art Deco and Rationalist suburban villa designed by Piero Portaluppi set inside a private walled garden with a heated pool.

attractions.name: Triennale Milano & Museo del Design Italiano
attractions.description: 1933 Palazzo dell'Arte in Parco Sempione celebrating Italian industrial design, architecture, and visual arts.

attractions.name: MUDEC (Museo delle Culture)
attractions.description: Ethnographic and world cultures museum designed by David Chipperfield inside the former Ansaldo industrial factories in Tortona.

attractions.name: Pirelli HangarBicocca
attractions.description: Monumental former locomotive factory converted into a 15,000-square-meter contemporary art space housing Anselm Kiefer's 'The Seven Heavenly Palaces'.

attractions.name: Gallerie d'Italia — Milano
attractions.description: Three interconnected historic noble palaces on Piazza della Scala displaying 19th-century Lombard sculpture and Canova reliefs.
attractions.descriptionDe: Drei verbundene historische Adelspaläste an der Piazza della Scala mit lombardischer Skulptur des 19. Jahrhunderts und Reliefs von Canova.

attractions.name: GAM (Galleria d'Arte Moderna) & Villa Reale
attractions.description: 1790 Neoclassical Villa Belgiojoso Bonaparte surrounded by an English garden, housing 19th-century Neoclassical and Divisionist art.

attractions.name: Giardini Pubblici Indro Montanelli
attractions.description: Milan's oldest public park (established 1784), containing centuries-old plane trees, artificial cliffs, and two major museums.
attractions.descriptionDe: Mailands ältester öffentlicher Park (1784) mit jahrhundertealten Platanen, künstlichen Felsen und zwei großen Museen.

attractions.name: Museo Civico di Storia Naturale di Milano
attractions.description: 1838 Natural History Museum in the Giardini Pubblici featuring over 100 life-sized wildlife dioramas and dinosaur skeletons.

attractions.name: Civico Planetario Ulrico Hoepli
attractions.description: 1930 neoclassical octagonal planetarium in the Giardini Pubblici, the largest planetarium in Italy.
attractions.descriptionDe: Achteckiges klassizistisches Planetarium von 1930 in den Giardini Pubblici, das größte Planetarium Italiens.

attractions.name: Orto Botanico di Brera
attractions.description: Walled 1774 botanical garden commissioned by Empress Maria Theresa of Austria hidden behind the Palazzo Brera.
attractions.descriptionDe: Ummauerter botanischer Garten von 1774, angelegt im Auftrag von Kaiserin Maria Theresia, versteckt hinter dem Palazzo Brera.

attractions.name: Piazza Mercanti
attractions.description: Preserved medieval civic square between the Duomo and Castello featuring the 1233 Palazzo della Ragione and Loggia degli Osii.
attractions.descriptionDe: Erhaltener mittelalterlicher Platz zwischen Dom und Castello mit dem Palazzo della Ragione von 1233 und der Loggia degli Osii.

attractions.name: Piazza della Scala & Leonardo da Vinci Monument
attractions.description: Pedestrian square linking La Scala and Palazzo Marino, centered on Pietro Magni's 1872 marble statue of Leonardo da Vinci.

attractions.name: Piazza Gae Aulenti
attractions.description: Elevated circular contemporary plaza in Porta Nuova surrounded by reflective infinity pools and Cesar Pelli's Unicredit Tower.
attractions.descriptionDe: Erhöhter runder Platz in Porta Nuova mit spiegelnden Wasserbecken und Cesar Pellis Unicredit Tower.

attractions.name: Basilica di San Lorenzo Maggiore & Colonne di San Lorenzo
attractions.description: Fourth-century early Christian octagonal basilica fronted by a colonnade of 16 ancient Roman Corinthian marble columns.

attractions.name: Basilica di Sant'Eustorgio & Portinari Chapel
attractions.description: Ancient paleo-Christian basilica housing the relics of the Three Magi and the jewel-like 1468 Renaissance Portinari Chapel.

attractions.name: Chiesa di Santa Maria presso San Satiro
attractions.description: Renaissance church famous for Donato Bramante's genius trompe-l'oeil fake choir apse carved in just 97 centimeters of depth.

attractions.name: Santuario di San Bernardino alle Ossa
attractions.description: Seventeenth-century church featuring an ossuary chapel whose walls are intricately decorated with human skulls and bones beneath a Sebastiano Ricci fresco.

attractions.name: Basilica di Santa Maria delle Grazie (Bramante Tribune)
attractions.description: Monumental red-brick and terracotta Renaissance domed cloister and apse designed by Donato Bramante.

attractions.name: Chiesa di San Vittore al Corpo & Leonardo Vineyard
attractions.description: Sixteenth-century Olivetan church adjacent to the Casa degli Atellani, where Leonardo da Vinci's original Renaissance grape vineyard has been replanted.

attractions.name: Civico Museo Archeologico di Milano
attractions.description: Archaeological museum housed in the Monastero Maggiore featuring an intact Roman circus tower and polygonal 3rd-century city wall.

attractions.name: Museo del Risorgimento (Palazzo Moriggia)
attractions.description: Eighteenth-century palace in Brera chronicling the history of Italian unification between 1796 and 1870.

attractions.name: Palazzo Morando (Costume Moda Immagine)
