attractions.description: Eighteenth-century noble residence showcasing period rooms, historical views of Milan, and rotating historical fashion exhibitions.
attractions.descriptionDe: Adelsresidenz aus dem 18. Jahrhundert mit historischen Räumen, alten Mailand-Ansichten und wechselnden Modeausstellungen.

attractions.name: Casa Museo Boschi Di Stefano
attractions.description: Art Deco apartment museum displaying over 300 masterpieces of 20th-century Italian art collected by Antonio Boschi and Marieda Di Stefano.
attractions.descriptionDe: Art-déco-Wohnung mit über 300 Meisterwerken italienischer Kunst des 20. Jahrhunderts aus der Sammlung von Antonio Boschi und Marieda Di Stefano.

attractions.name: ADI Design Museum (Compasso d'Oro)
attractions.description: Industrial heritage tram depot converted into the permanent home of the historic Compasso d'Oro Italian design awards.
attractions.descriptionDe: Ehemaliges Straßenbahndepot, heute ständiger Sitz des Designpreises Compasso d'Oro.

attractions.name: San Siro Stadium & Inter/Milan Museum
attractions.description: Iconic 80,000-seat football cathedral (Stadio Giuseppe Meazza) with spiraled concrete ramps and a historic football museum.

attractions.name: Acquario Civico di Milano
attractions.description: 1906 Viennese Secession/Art Nouveau building in Parco Sempione, the third-oldest public aquarium in Europe.
attractions.descriptionDe: Jugendstilbau von 1906 im Parco Sempione, das drittälteste öffentliche Aquarium Europas.

attractions.name: Darsena del Naviglio
attractions.description: Historic 17th-century Spanish port basin where the Naviglio Grande and Naviglio Pavese canals meet.

attractions.name: Chiesa di Santa Maria presso San Celso
attractions.description: Renaissance and Baroque sanctuary preceded by a classical 16th-century Marble Atrium and sculpted facade.

attractions.name: Abbazia di Chiaravalle
attractions.description: Twelfth-century Cistercian gothic-brick monastic abbey on the southern edge of Milan crowned by the multi-tiered 'Ciribiciaccola' lantern tower.

cities.name: Madrid
cities.source_note: Euromonitor Top 100 City Destinations Index (#2 Overall Index Globally), INE Spain, & Turismo Madrid

attractions.name: Museo Nacional del Prado
attractions.description: Spain's premier national art museum housing the world's finest collections of Velázquez, Goya, El Greco, Titian, and Bosch.

attractions.name: Royal Palace of Madrid (Palacio Real)
attractions.description: The largest functioning royal palace in Western Europe with 3,418 rooms, displaying Stradivarius instruments, royal armory, and Tiepolo frescoes.

attractions.name: Parque del Buen Retiro (El Retiro Park)
attractions.description: 350-acre UNESCO World Heritage former royal garden featuring the Grand Pond monument to Alfonso XII and the Rose Garden.

attractions.name: Museo Nacional Centro de Arte Reina Sofía
attractions.description: Spain's national museum of 20th-century modern art, permanent home to Pablo Picasso's monumental anti-war canvas 'Guernica'.

attractions.name: Museo Nacional Thyssen-Bornemisza
attractions.description: Villahermosa Palace museum completing the Golden Triangle of Art with eight centuries of European and American painting.

attractions.name: Plaza Mayor
attractions.description: Symmetrical 17th-century Habsburg arcaded rectangular plaza surrounded by red three-story residential buildings and the bronze statue of Philip III.

attractions.name: Puerta del Sol
attractions.description: Symbolic center of Madrid and 'Kilometer Zero' of Spain's radial highway network, home to the Bear and the Strawberry Tree statue.

attractions.name: Catedral de Santa María la Real de la Almudena
attractions.description: Eclectic Neoclassical, Neo-Gothic, and Neo-Romanesque cathedral facing the Royal Palace, consecrated by Pope John Paul II in 1993.

attractions.name: Temple of Debod (Templo de Debod)
attractions.description: Authentic 2nd-century BC ancient Egyptian Nubian temple gifted to Spain in 1968 and reconstructed in Parque del Oeste.

attractions.name: Palacio de Cristal (Crystal Palace)
attractions.description: 1887 wrought-iron and glass conservatory pavilion in El Retiro Park built beside an artificial lake with bald cypress trees.
attractions.descriptionDe: Pavillon aus Schmiedeeisen und Glas von 1887 im Retiro-Park, an einem künstlichen See mit Sumpfzypressen.

attractions.name: Galería de las Colecciones Reales (Royal Collections Gallery)
attractions.description: Award-winning museum opened in 2023 next to the Royal Palace displaying five centuries of Habsburg and Bourbon tapestries, carriages, and paintings.

attractions.name: Gran Vía & Metropolis Building
attractions.description: Madrid's early 20th-century showpiece boulevard of Beaux-Arts and Art Deco architecture crowned by the winged Victory dome of Edificio Metrópolis.

attractions.name: Plaza de Cibeles & Palacio de Cibeles
attractions.description: Iconic marble fountain depicting the Phrygian goddess Cybele in a lion-drawn chariot in front of the monumental 1919 City Hall palace.

attractions.name: Puerta de Alcalá
attractions.description: 1778 Neoclassical granite triumphal arch designed by Francesco Sabatini standing at the entrance to El Retiro Park.

attractions.name: Museo Arqueológico Nacional (MAN)
attractions.description: National Archaeological Museum housing the 4th-century BC Iberian bust 'Lady of Elche' and the Visigothic Treasure of Guarrazar.

attractions.name: Museo Sorolla
attractions.description: Preserved 1911 home, studio, and Andalusian-inspired garden of Valencian Impressionist painter Joaquín Sorolla.

attractions.name: Real Academia de Bellas Artes de San Fernando
attractions.description: Founded in 1752 in the Baroque Goyeneche Palace, exhibiting works by Goya, Zurbarán, Rubens, and Arcimboldo.

attractions.name: Museo Cerralbo
attractions.description: Opulent 19th-century aristocratic mansion preserving its original Neo-Baroque ballroom, armory, and 50,000 artworks intact.
attractions.descriptionDe: Prunkvolles Adelspalais aus dem 19. Jahrhundert mit original erhaltenem neobarockem Ballsaal, Waffenkammer und 50.000 Kunstwerken.

attractions.name: Museo del Romanticismo
attractions.description: 1776 palace recreating the furniture, paintings, and aristocratic daily life of 19th-century Romantic-era Spain.

attractions.name: Museo Lázaro Galdiano
attractions.description: Palatial Parque Florido residence housing financier José Lázaro Galdiano's 12,600-piece collection, including Goya's 'Witches' Sabbath'.
attractions.descriptionDe: Palastartige Villa im Parque Florido mit der 12.600 Stücke umfassenden Sammlung von José Lázaro Galdiano, darunter Goyas „Hexensabbat“.

attractions.name: CaixaForum Madrid
attractions.description: Converted 1899 electrical power station by Herzog & de Meuron featuring a levitating rusted cast-iron structure and Patrick Blanc vertical garden.

attractions.name: Real Jardín Botánico de Madrid
attractions.description: Eighteenth-century 20-acre botanical garden founded by King Charles III next to the Prado Museum.

attractions.name: Casa de Campo
attractions.description: Madrid's largest urban public park (4,250 acres, five times the size of Central Park), a former royal hunting estate with a lake and cable car.
attractions.descriptionDe: Madrids größter Stadtpark, ein ehemaliges königliches Jagdgebiet mit See und Seilbahn.

attractions.name: Madrid Río Park & Puente de Toledo
attractions.description: Ten-kilometer linear riverside park along the Manzanares River featuring modern bridges by Dominique Perrault and the 1732 Baroque Toledo Bridge.

attractions.name: Matadero Madrid
attractions.description: Vast early 20th-century Neo-Mudéjar former municipal slaughterhouse transformed into a sprawling contemporary arts and exhibition village.
attractions.descriptionDe: Riesiger ehemaliger Schlachthof im Neo-Mudéjar-Stil aus dem frühen 20. Jahrhundert, heute ein Zentrum für zeitgenössische Kunst.

attractions.name: Basílica de San Francisco el Grande
attractions.description: Eighteenth-century Neoclassical basilica crowned by one of Christendom's largest domes (33 meters diameter) and paintings by Goya and Zurbarán.
attractions.descriptionDe: Klassizistische Basilika aus dem 18. Jahrhundert mit einer der größten Kuppeln der Christenheit (33 Meter) und Gemälden von Goya und Zurbarán.

attractions.name: Monasterio de las Descalzas Reales
attractions.description: Sixteenth-century royal convent in a former palace of Charles V housing Brussels tapestries designed by Peter Paul Rubens.

attractions.name: Real Monasterio de la Encarnación
attractions.description: 1611 Augustinian Recollect convent founded by Queen Margaret of Austria, containing a renowned reliquary hall and Baroque art.

attractions.name: Ermita de San Antonio de la Florida
attractions.description: Neoclassical royal chapel whose dome and cupola were entirely frescoed by Francisco de Goya in 1798, and where Goya is buried.

attractions.name: Círculo de Bellas Artes Rooftop (Azotea del Círculo)
attractions.description: 1926 cultural center whose rooftop terrace crowned by a bronze Minerva statue offers the classic panoramic view down Gran Vía.

attractions.name: Faro de Moncloa
attractions.description: 110-meter futuristic observation tower built in 1992 with a glass panoramic lift overlooking the Royal Palace and Guadarrama Mountains.

attractions.name: Parque de El Capricho
attractions.description: Romantic 1784 eighteen-hectare garden created by the Duchess of Osuna featuring a labyrinth, temple of Bacchus, and a Spanish Civil War bunker.

attractions.name: Parque del Oeste & Rosaleda (Rose Garden)
attractions.description: Rolling hillside park overlooking the Manzanares valley famous for its award-winning 1955 formal rose garden.

attractions.name: Quinta de los Molinos
attractions.description: Historic 25-hectare Mediterranean park in San Blas famous for 1,500 blooming almond trees every spring.
attractions.descriptionDe: Historischer, 25 Hektar großer Park in San Blas, bekannt für 1.500 Mandelbäume, die jedes Frühjahr blühen.

attractions.name: Sabatini Gardens & Campo del Moro
attractions.description: Neoclassical symmetrical hedge gardens on the north side and romantic 50-acre English gardens on the west slope of the Royal Palace.

attractions.name: Plaza de Oriente
attractions.description: Monumental semi-circular garden square between the Royal Palace and Teatro Real lined with statues of 20 early Spanish kings.
attractions.descriptionDe: Halbrunder Gartenplatz zwischen Königspalast und Teatro Real mit Statuen von 20 frühen spanischen Königen.

attractions.name: Teatro Real (Royal Theatre)
attractions.description: 1850 hexagonal opera house facing the Royal Palace, one of Europe's greatest opera venues.

attractions.name: Plaza de la Villa
attractions.description: Madrid's best-preserved medieval and Renaissance square, bordered by the 15th-century Torre de los Lujanes and 17th-century Casa de la Villa.
attractions.descriptionDe: Madrids am besten erhaltener Platz aus Mittelalter und Renaissance, mit dem Torre de los Lujanes und der Casa de la Villa.

attractions.name: Plaza de España & Cervantes Monument
attractions.description: Renovated green civic plaza featuring a towering stone monument to Miguel de Cervantes with bronze statues of Don Quixote and Sancho Panza.

attractions.name: Las Ventas Bullring & Museo Taurino
attractions.description: Monumental 1929 Neo-Mudéjar brick-and-ceramic arena seating 23,798 spectators, the largest in Spain.

attractions.name: Museo de América
attractions.description: National museum in Moncloa exhibiting pre-Columbian archaeological treasures, including the Quimbaya Treasure and Mayan Madrid Codex.

attractions.name: Museo Naval de Madrid
attractions.description: Maritime museum displaying model ships and the 1500 map of Juan de la Cosa, the earliest surviving world map showing the Americas.

attractions.name: Museo del Ferrocarril (Railway Museum)
attractions.description: Historic 1880 hierro-and-glass Delicias Railway Station housing vintage steam locomotives and royal passenger carriages.

attractions.name: Museo Geominero (Geomineral Museum)
attractions.description: 1926 stained-glass-roofed gallery hall displaying minerals, gemstones, meteorites, and prehistoric megafauna fossils.
attractions.descriptionDe: Ausstellungshalle von 1926 mit Buntglasdach, in der Mineralien, Edelsteine, Meteoriten und Fossilien eiszeitlicher Großtiere zu sehen sind.

attractions.name: Museo de Historia de Madrid
attractions.description: Municipal museum famous for Pedro de Ribera's extravagant 1726 Churrigueresque carved stone portal and 1830 scale model of Madrid.

attractions.name: Casa-Museo Lope de Vega
attractions.description: Preserved 17th-century house and garden in the Literary Quarter (Barrio de las Letras) where Golden Age playwright Lope de Vega lived for 25 years.

attractions.name: Panteón de España (Panteón de Hombres Ilustres)
attractions.description: Neo-Byzantine cloister and basilica near Atocha housing ornate marble funerary monuments of 19th-century Spanish prime ministers.
attractions.descriptionDe: Neobyzantinischer Kreuzgang und Basilika nahe Atocha mit prunkvollen Marmorgrabmälern spanischer Ministerpräsidenten des 19. Jahrhunderts.

attractions.name: Estación de Atocha Tropical Garden & Monument
attractions.description: 1892 wrought-iron train terminal hall by Alberto de Palacio housing a lush indoor tropical palm conservatory.

attractions.name: Iglesia de San Jerónimo el Real (Los Jerónimos)
attractions.description: Early 16th-century Isabelline Gothic royal church next to the Prado Museum used for royal investitures and weddings.
attractions.descriptionDe: Königliche Kirche im isabellinischen gotischen Stil aus dem frühen 16. Jahrhundert neben dem Prado, Ort königlicher Zeremonien und Hochzeiten.

attractions.name: Santiago Bernabéu Stadium & Real Madrid Museum
attractions.description: Modernized retractable-steel football stadium in Chamartín housing the world's most decorated club football trophy museum.

cities.name: Athens
cities.source_note: Estimate: 'nearly 8 million' foreign visitors to Athens in 2024 (EXAAA hotel association/Athens Airport survey, via To Vima); rounded to 7.9M, no exact figure published.

attractions.name: Acropolis of Athens
attractions.description: Ancient hilltop citadel with the Parthenon, the Erechtheion and the Temple of Athena Nike, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and the defining symbol of classical Greece.

attractions.name: Acropolis Museum
attractions.description: Modern museum below the Acropolis displaying sculptures and artifacts found on the rock and its slopes.

attractions.name: Ancient Agora of Athens
attractions.description: Remains of the ancient marketplace and civic center where Socrates taught and Athenian democracy developed.

attractions.name: National Archaeological Museum
attractions.description: Greece's largest archaeological museum, holding major finds from prehistory to late antiquity.

attractions.name: Temple of Olympian Zeus
attractions.description: Ruins of a colossal temple with surviving Corinthian columns, completed under Emperor Hadrian.

attractions.name: Mount Lycabettus
attractions.description: Pine-covered hill and the highest point in central Athens, with panoramic views over the city and sea.

attractions.name: Plaka
attractions.description: Historic old neighborhood below the Acropolis with neoclassical houses and narrow pedestrian lanes.

attractions.name: Panathenaic Stadium (Kallimarmaro)
attractions.description: Ancient stadium rebuilt in marble for the first modern Olympic Games in 1896.

attractions.name: Theatre of Dionysus
attractions.description: Ancient theatre on the Acropolis south slope, regarded as the birthplace of Greek drama.

attractions.name: Roman Agora and Tower of the Winds
attractions.description: Roman-era marketplace featuring the octagonal Tower of the Winds, an ancient weather station and clock.

attractions.name: Areopagus Hill
attractions.description: Rocky hill beside the Acropolis where the ancient court met, offering sunset views over the Agora.

attractions.name: Philopappos Hill
attractions.description: Wooded hill with the Philopappos Monument and classic views of the Acropolis.

attractions.name: National Garden
attractions.description: Shady central park with ponds, palm trees and walking paths behind the Greek Parliament.

attractions.name: Hadrian's Arch
attractions.description: Marble gateway erected in 131 AD to mark the border between ancient and Roman Athens.

attractions.name: Tomb of the Unknown Soldier
attractions.description: Memorial at the Parliament in Syntagma Square, guarded by the ceremonially dressed Evzones.
attractions.descriptionDe: Gedenkstätte am Parlament am Syntagma-Platz, bewacht von den Evzonen in ihrer zeremoniellen Uniform.

attractions.name: Kerameikos
attractions.description: Ancient cemetery and potters' quarter containing the Sacred Gate, funerary monuments and a museum.

attractions.name: Benaki Museum of Greek Culture
attractions.description: Museum in a neoclassical mansion surveying Greek art and history from antiquity to the modern era.

attractions.name: National Historical Museum
attractions.description: Museum of Greek history from the Byzantine era to the twentieth century, housed in the Old Parliament building on Stadiou Street.

attractions.name: Museum of Cycladic Art
attractions.description: Museum known for its collection of Early Bronze Age Cycladic marble figurines.

attractions.name: Byzantine and Christian Museum
attractions.description: Museum of Byzantine icons, sculpture and manuscripts from the early Christian era onward.

attractions.name: Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation Museum
attractions.description: Modern and contemporary art museum with a Picasso, Matisse and Van Gogh collection in a restored 1960s building in Ilisia.

attractions.name: Hadrian's Library
attractions.description: Ruins of a second-century Roman library complex near Monastiraki Square.

attractions.name: Anafiotika
attractions.description: Small Cycladic-style neighborhood of whitewashed houses tucked under the Acropolis.

attractions.name: Metropolitan Cathedral of Athens
attractions.description: Nineteenth-century Greek Orthodox cathedral and seat of the Archbishop of Athens.

attractions.name: Church of Panagia Kapnikarea
attractions.description: Small Byzantine church from the eleventh century standing in the middle of Ermou Street.

attractions.name: Church of Agios Eleftherios (Little Metropolis)
attractions.description: Tiny twelfth-century Byzantine church beside the cathedral, decorated with reused ancient reliefs.

attractions.name: Cathedral Basilica of St. Dionysius the Areopagite
attractions.description: Neo-Renaissance Catholic cathedral on Panepistimiou Street, designed by Leo von Klenze and Lysandros Kaftanzoglou and opened in 1865.

attractions.name: Stavros Niarchos Park
attractions.description: Large landscaped park with a canal, gardens and walking paths beside the Stavros Niarchos Cultural Center.

attractions.name: Zappeion
attractions.description: Neoclassical exhibition hall surrounded by gardens next to the National Garden.

attractions.name: Pnyx
attractions.description: Hill where the citizens of ancient Athens gathered for their democratic assembly.

attractions.name: Benaki Museum of Islamic Art
attractions.description: Museum of Islamic art and ceramics from the seventh to nineteenth century, housed in Kerameikos.
attractions.descriptionDe: Museum für islamische Kunst und Keramik vom 7. bis 19. Jahrhundert im Viertel Kerameikos.

attractions.name: National Gallery of Athens
attractions.description: Greece's main art gallery, showing Greek painting and sculpture alongside European works.

attractions.name: War Museum of Athens
attractions.description: Museum covering Greek military history from antiquity to the twentieth century.

attractions.name: Jewish Museum of Greece
attractions.description: Museum documenting the history and culture of Greek Jewish communities over more than 2,000 years.

attractions.name: Goulandris Natural History Museum
attractions.description: Natural history museum in Kifissia with collections on Greek flora, fauna, minerals and fossils.

attractions.name: Museum of Greek Folk Art
attractions.description: Museum of traditional Greek costumes, embroidery, ceramics and folk crafts in Plaka.
attractions.descriptionDe: Museum für traditionelle griechische Trachten, Stickereien, Keramik und Volkskunst in der Plaka.

attractions.name: Frissiras Museum
attractions.description: Museum of contemporary European painting in two neoclassical houses in Plaka, opened in 2000 from the Frissiras collection.

attractions.name: Choragic Monument of Lysicrates
attractions.description: Fourth-century BC monument in Plaka, noted as an early example of exterior Corinthian columns.

attractions.name: Athens Neoclassical Trilogy
attractions.description: Group of nineteenth-century buildings on Panepistimiou Street: the Academy, University and National Library.

attractions.name: Mount Hymettus
attractions.description: Mountain ridge east of Athens with hiking trails, pine forest and views over the basin.

attractions.name: Lake Vouliagmeni
attractions.description: Brackish thermal lake in a rocky cove on the Athens Riviera, popular for swimming.

attractions.name: Pedion tou Areos Park
attractions.description: Large public park in central Athens with statues of heroes of the Greek War of Independence.

attractions.name: National Museum of Contemporary Art (EMST)
attractions.description: Museum of contemporary Greek and international art housed in the former Fix brewery.

attractions.name: Kaisariani Monastery
attractions.description: Eleventh-century Byzantine monastery on the slopes of Mount Hymettus, surrounded by forest.

attractions.name: Lyceum of Aristotle
attractions.description: Archaeological park marking the site of Aristotle's ancient school.

attractions.name: Plato's Academy
attractions.description: Archaeological park on the site of the ancient school founded by Plato, in a public park.

attractions.name: Diomedes Botanical Garden
attractions.description: Large botanical garden west of Athens in the Haidari area with Mediterranean plants and walking trails.
attractions.descriptionDe: Großer botanischer Garten westlich von Athen in Chaidari mit Mittelmeerpflanzen und Spazierwegen.

attractions.name: Numismatic Museum of Athens
attractions.description: Museum of ancient and later coins in the neoclassical Iliou Melathron mansion built for Heinrich Schliemann.

attractions.name: Archaeological Museum of Piraeus
attractions.description: Museum in the port of Piraeus with bronze statues and ancient finds from the area.

attractions.name: Hellenic Maritime Museum
attractions.description: Piraeus museum founded in 1949 with ship models, nautical instruments and naval history from antiquity to modern times.
attractions.descriptionDe: Museum in Piräus, 1949 gegründet, mit Schiffsmodellen, nautischen Instrumenten und Marinegeschichte von der Antike bis heute.

cities.name: Amsterdam
cities.source_note: CBS Statistics Netherlands, amsterdam&partners, & Euromonitor Top 100 City Destinations Index (#7 Overall Index)

attractions.name: Rijksmuseum
attractions.description: The Dutch national museum of art and history on Museumplein housing Rembrandt's 'The Night Watch' and Vermeer's 'The Milkmaid'.

attractions.name: Van Gogh Museum
attractions.description: Museum housing the world's largest collection of works by Vincent van Gogh, including 'Sunflowers', 'The Bedroom', and 'Almond Blossom'.

attractions.name: Anne Frank House
attractions.description: 17th-century canal house on the Prinsengracht preserving the Secret Annex where Anne Frank wrote her wartime diary.

attractions.name: Amsterdam Canal Ring (Grachtengordel)
attractions.description: UNESCO World Heritage 17th-century concentric semicircle of waterways (Herengracht, Keizersgracht, Prinsengracht) lined with gabled merchant houses.

attractions.name: Vondelpark
attractions.description: Amsterdam's flagship 120-acre English landscape park (opened 1865) featuring rose gardens, ponds, and an open-air theater.

attractions.name: Royal Palace Amsterdam (Koninklijk Paleis)
attractions.description: 1655 Dutch Classicist masterpiece built on 13,659 wooden piles on Dam Square as the Golden Age Town Hall.

attractions.name: Dam Square & National Monument
attractions.description: Historic heart of Amsterdam founded around a 13th-century dam on the Amstel River, anchored by the 22-meter white stone WWII memorial obelisk.

attractions.name: Stedelijk Museum Amsterdam
attractions.description: Premier museum of modern and contemporary art and design on Museumplein, famous for its bathtub-shaped white wing and De Stijl / Mondrian works.
attractions.descriptionDe: Führendes Museum für moderne und zeitgenössische Kunst und Design am Museumplein, bekannt für seinen Anbau in Badewannenform und Werke von Mondrian.

attractions.name: NEMO Science Museum
attractions.description: Copper-green ship-prow building designed by Renzo Piano over the IJ tunnel offering five floors of interactive science and a stepped rooftop plaza.

attractions.name: A'DAM Lookout
attractions.description: 20th-floor 360-degree sky deck atop the former Shell Tower in Amsterdam-Noord overlooking the IJ waterfront and historic canal center.

attractions.name: Rembrandt House Museum (Museum Het Rembrandthuis)
attractions.description: Restored 1606 mansion on Jodenbreestraat where Rembrandt van Rijn lived, painted, and etched between 1639 and 1658.

attractions.name: Het Scheepvaartmuseum (National Maritime Museum)
attractions.description: 1656 Admiralty Arsenal storehouse on the Oosterdok featuring a glass-domed courtyard and the full-scale 1749 East Indiaman ship replica 'Amsterdam'.

attractions.name: Moco Museum Amsterdam
attractions.description: Villa Alsberg on Museumplein exhibiting iconic street, pop, and digital art by Banksy, Andy Warhol, Keith Haring, and Kusama.

attractions.name: Westerkerk
attractions.description: 1631 Dutch Renaissance Protestant church beside the Prinsengracht crowned by an 85-meter tower topped with Emperor Maximilian's imperial crown.

attractions.name: Oude Kerk (Old Church)
attractions.description: Amsterdam's oldest building and parish church (consecrated 1306), featuring a medieval wooden barrel vault and contemporary art installations.

attractions.name: Museum Ons' Lieve Heer op Solder (Our Lord in the Attic)
attractions.description: 1663 canal house preserving a clandestine three-story Catholic church built into the top attic floors during the Reformation.

attractions.name: Begijnhof
attractions.description: Tranquil medieval enclosed courtyard founded in the 14th century for the Catholic sisterhood of Beguines, containing Amsterdam's oldest wooden house (1528).

attractions.name: Jordaan Historic District & Brouwersgracht
attractions.description: Early 17th-century neighborhood of narrow canals, hidden almshouse courtyards (hofjes), and converted brick breweries.

attractions.name: Bloemenmarkt (Floating Flower Market)
attractions.description: The world's only floating flower market, operating since 1862 on houseboats moored along the Singel canal.

attractions.name: Magere Brug (Skinny Bridge)
attractions.description: Iconic white-painted wooden double-leaf Dutch drawbridge spanning the Amstel River, illuminated by 1,200 lightbulbs at night.

attractions.name: Negen Straatjes (The Nine Streets)
attractions.description: Picturesque grid of nine cobble-paved cross-streets connecting the main Golden Age canals.

attractions.name: ARTIS Amsterdam Royal Zoo & Micropia
attractions.description: The oldest zoo in the Netherlands (founded 1838) with historic 19th-century pavilions, a planetarium, and the world's first museum of microbes.

attractions.name: Hortus Botanicus Amsterdam
attractions.description: One of the world's oldest botanical gardens (founded 1638 as an herb garden for doctors) with a 1912 Palm House and Three-Climate Greenhouse.

attractions.name: Eye Filmmuseum
attractions.description: Faceted white geometric building on the northern bank of the IJ dedicated to Dutch and international cinema history.

attractions.name: Straat Museum (NDSM Wharf)
attractions.description: The world's largest museum for street art and graffiti, housed inside a cavernous 8,000-square-meter former shipbuilding warehouse in Noord.

attractions.name: NDSM Werf Cultural Precinct
attractions.description: Post-industrial shipyard on the IJ waterfront featuring giant historic cranes, submarine hangar, and outdoor public art.

attractions.name: H'ART Museum (formerly Hermitage Amsterdam)
attractions.description: Monumental 1682 Amstelhof nursing home on the Amstel River hosting international art exhibitions in collaboration with major global museums.

attractions.name: Wereldmuseum Amsterdam (formerly Tropenmuseum)
attractions.description: Ornate 1926 brick museum beside Oosterpark exploring global ethnographic cultures and colonial history.

attractions.name: Jewish Cultural Quarter & Portuguese Synagogue
attractions.description: Includes the monumental 1675 Esnoga illuminated by 1,000 candles, the Jewish Museum, and the National Holocaust Museum.

attractions.name: Nieuwe Kerk (New Church)
attractions.description: Fifteenth-century Gothic basilica on Dam Square used for Dutch royal investitures and major cultural exhibitions.
attractions.descriptionDe: Gotische Basilika aus dem 15. Jahrhundert am Dam, Ort niederländischer Königskrönungen und großer Ausstellungen.

attractions.name: Basilica of Saint Nicholas
attractions.description: 1887 Neo-Baroque and Neo-Renaissance Catholic basilica facing the waterfront opposite Amsterdam Centraal Station.

attractions.name: Amsterdam Centraal Station
attractions.description: 1889 Neo-Gothic red-brick railway terminal built on three artificial islands by Pierre Cuypers (architect of the Rijksmuseum).

attractions.name: Museum Van Loon
attractions.description: 1672 double-wide patrician canal house on the Keizersgracht designed by Adriaan Dortsman with a formal garden and coach house.

attractions.name: Museum Willet-Holthuysen
attractions.description: 1687 UNESCO-listed Golden Age canal mansion on the Herengracht gifted to the city in 1895 with its intact 19th-century French-style interiors.

attractions.name: Grachtenmuseum (Museum of the Canals)
attractions.description: Interactive multimedia museum inside a 1665 Herengracht house explaining how Amsterdam's 17th-century canal ring was engineered.

attractions.name: FOAM Fotografiemuseum Amsterdam
attractions.description: International photography museum housed across three connected canal buildings on the Keizersgracht.
attractions.descriptionDe: Internationales Fotografiemuseum in drei verbundenen Grachtenhäusern an der Keizersgracht.

attractions.name: Huis Marseille, Museum for Photography
attractions.description: Amsterdam's oldest photography museum, set inside two monumental 1665 classicist merchant houses on the Keizersgracht.

attractions.name: Allard Pierson Museum
attractions.description: Archaeological and cultural collections museum of the University of Amsterdam on the Oude Turfmarkt spanning ancient Egypt, Greece, and Rome.
attractions.descriptionDe: Archäologisches Museum der Universität Amsterdam mit Sammlungen aus dem alten Ägypten, Griechenland und Rom.

attractions.name: Verzetsmuseum (Dutch Resistance Museum)
attractions.description: Museum in the Plantage district chronicling how Dutch citizens endured and resisted Nazi occupation during World War II.

attractions.name: Westergas & Westerpark
attractions.description: Sprawling green park and cultural village built inside the restored 19th-century red-brick Imperial Continental Gas Association complex.

attractions.name: Oosterpark
attractions.description: The first large public park laid out by the Municipality of Amsterdam (1891) in English landscape style by Leonard Springer.
attractions.descriptionDe: Der erste große öffentliche Park der Stadt Amsterdam (1891), von Leonard Springer im englischen Landschaftsstil angelegt.

attractions.name: Sarphatipark
attractions.description: Charming 1885 verdant oasis in the heart of the vibrant De Pijp neighborhood.

attractions.name: Amsterdamse Bos (Amsterdam Forest)
attractions.description: Man-made 1,000-hectare woodland and rowing park three times the size of Central Park on the southern border of the city.

attractions.name: Amstelpark
attractions.description: 1972 Floriade horticultural exhibition park along the Amstel featuring a rhododendron valley, rose garden, maze, and the 1636 Rieker Windmill.

attractions.name: De Gooyer Windmill
attractions.description: The tallest wooden windmill in the Netherlands (1725), a National Monument standing beside the Singelgracht in the Oostelijk Havengebied.

attractions.name: Molen van Sloten (Sloten Windmill)
attractions.description: Working 1847 thatched octagonal drainage polder mill open to visitors on the western edge of Amsterdam.
attractions.descriptionDe: Funktionierende achteckige Poldermühle von 1847 mit Reetdach am westlichen Stadtrand, für Besucher geöffnet.

attractions.name: Het Schip (Museum of the Amsterdam School)
attractions.description: 1919 Expressionist brick social housing masterpiece designed by Michel de Klerk celebrating the Amsterdam School architectural movement.

attractions.name: Royal Concertgebouw
attractions.description: 1888 Neoclassical concert hall on Museumplein considered one of the three most acoustically finest symphony halls in the world.

attractions.name: Montelbaanstoren
attractions.description: 1516 medieval defensive brick watchtower on the Oudeschans canal topped with a 1606 decorative wooden spire by Hendrick de Keyser.

attractions.name: De Waag (The Weigh House)
attractions.description: 1488 turreted medieval city gate (Sint Antoniespoort) on Nieuwmarkt where Rembrandt painted 'The Anatomy Lesson of Dr. Nicolaes Tulp'.

cities.name: Vienna
cities.source_note: Estimate: Vienna Tourist Board 2024 (about 8.2M arrivals, ~82% international, so roughly 6.7M international arrivals); Euromonitor's 2017 figure was about 6M.

attractions.name: Schönbrunn Palace
attractions.description: Baroque imperial summer residence of the Habsburgs with 1,441 rooms, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

attractions.name: St. Stephen's Cathedral (Stephansdom)
attractions.description: Gothic cathedral at the heart of Vienna, known for its patterned tile roof and South Tower.

attractions.name: Hofburg Palace
attractions.description: Former imperial palace complex housing the Imperial Apartments, Sisi Museum and Silver Collection.

attractions.name: Belvedere Palace
attractions.description: Baroque palace complex with the Upper and Lower Belvedere, home to Klimt's The Kiss.
attractions.descriptionDe: Barocke Schlossanlage aus Oberem und Unterem Belvedere, Heimat von Klimts „Der Kuss“.

attractions.name: Kunsthistorisches Museum
attractions.description: Fine arts museum with Habsburg collections including major works by Bruegel, Raphael and Vermeer.

attractions.name: Albertina
attractions.description: Museum with a large graphic arts collection and an impressionist and modern art display in Habsburg state rooms.

attractions.name: Vienna State Opera (Wiener Staatsoper)
attractions.description: Neo-Renaissance opera house on the Ringstrasse, one of the world's leading opera venues.

attractions.name: Schönbrunn Palace Gardens
attractions.description: Baroque palace park with the Gloriette, fountains, maze and formal gardens.

attractions.name: Karlskirche
attractions.description: Baroque church on Karlsplatz with a large dome and twin columns, completed in 1737.

attractions.name: Naturhistorisches Museum
attractions.description: Natural history museum opposite the Kunsthistorisches Museum, known for the Venus of Willendorf and meteorite hall.

attractions.name: Leopold Museum
attractions.description: Museum in the MuseumsQuartier with the world's largest Egon Schiele collection.

attractions.name: Austrian National Library State Hall (Prunksaal)
attractions.description: Baroque library hall from the 1720s holding around 200,000 historic volumes.

attractions.name: Imperial Treasury (Schatzkammer)
attractions.description: Museum in the Hofburg displaying the Habsburg imperial regalia and the Holy Roman Empire crown.

attractions.name: Imperial Crypt (Kapuzinergruft)
attractions.description: Burial vault beneath the Capuchin Church holding Habsburg emperors and empresses.

attractions.name: Hundertwasserhaus
attractions.description: Colorful apartment building by Friedensreich Hundertwasser known for its irregular facade.

attractions.name: Vienna City Hall (Rathaus)
attractions.description: Neo-Gothic city hall on the Ringstrasse, completed in 1883 with a tall central tower.

attractions.name: Austrian Parliament Building
attractions.description: Neoclassical parliament on the Ringstrasse with the Athena fountain, reopened after renovation in 2023.

attractions.name: Volksgarten
attractions.description: Public garden near the Hofburg known for its rose beds and Theseus Temple.

attractions.name: Burggarten
attractions.description: Former imperial garden by the Hofburg, with the Mozart monument and the Palmenhaus.

attractions.name: Stadtpark
attractions.description: Landscaped city park on the Ring with the gilded Johann Strauss monument.

attractions.name: Heldenplatz
attractions.description: Large square in front of the Hofburg with equestrian statues of Prince Eugene and Archduke Charles.

attractions.name: Spanish Riding School
attractions.description: Historic riding academy performing classical Lipizzaner horse training in a Baroque hall.

attractions.name: Mozarthaus Vienna
attractions.description: Museum in the apartment where Mozart lived from 1784 to 1787.

attractions.name: Haus der Musik
attractions.description: Interactive sound and music museum in the former home of the Vienna Philharmonic's founder.

attractions.name: Technisches Museum Wien
attractions.description: Museum of technology and industry with collections on transport, energy and science.

attractions.name: Weltmuseum Wien
attractions.description: Ethnographic museum in the Neue Burg of the Hofburg with collections from Africa, Asia, the Americas and Oceania.

attractions.name: House of Austrian History (Haus der Geschichte Österreich)
attractions.description: Museum of Austria's history since 1918 in the Neue Burg on Heldenplatz.

attractions.name: Gloriette
attractions.description: Neoclassical pavilion on the hill above Schönbrunn offering panoramic views over the palace and city.

attractions.name: Danube Tower (Donauturm)
attractions.description: 252-metre observation tower in Donaupark with a revolving restaurant and city views.

attractions.name: Kahlenberg
attractions.description: Hill in the Vienna Woods with a popular lookout over the city and the Danube.

attractions.name: Upper Belvedere Gardens
attractions.description: Baroque terraced gardens between the Upper and Lower Belvedere with fountains and statuary.
attractions.descriptionDe: Barocke Terrassengärten zwischen Oberem und Unterem Belvedere mit Brunnen und Skulpturen.

attractions.name: Vienna Woods (Wienerwald)
attractions.description: Forested hills on the western edge of Vienna with walking trails and vineyards.

attractions.name: Danube Island (Donauinsel)
attractions.description: Long artificial island on the Danube used for walking, cycling and swimming.

attractions.name: Lainzer Tiergarten
attractions.description: Large nature reserve and former imperial hunting ground on the city's western edge.

attractions.name: Peterskirche
attractions.description: Baroque church near the Graben with an ornate dome and interior.

attractions.name: Minoritenkirche
attractions.description: Gothic friary church in the Innere Stadt with a mosaic copy of The Last Supper.

attractions.name: Votivkirche
attractions.description: Neo-Gothic twin-spired church on the Ringstrasse built in thanks for Emperor Franz Joseph's survival.

attractions.name: Augustinerkirche
attractions.description: Gothic court parish church of the Habsburgs in the Hofburg, holding the Heart Crypt (Herzgruft) with Habsburg hearts in the Loreto Chapel.

attractions.name: Kirche am Steinhof (Otto Wagner Church)
attractions.description: Art Nouveau church with a gilded dome designed by Otto Wagner and completed in 1907.
attractions.descriptionDe: Jugendstilkirche mit vergoldeter Kuppel, entworfen von Otto Wagner und 1907 vollendet.

attractions.name: Vienna Secession Building
attractions.description: Art Nouveau exhibition hall topped with a golden dome, housing Klimt's Beethoven Frieze.

attractions.name: MAK Museum of Applied Arts
attractions.description: Museum of applied arts, design and contemporary art on the Ringstrasse.

attractions.name: Museum of Military History (Heeresgeschichtliches Museum)
attractions.description: Museum of Austrian military history in the Arsenal complex, opened in 1891.

attractions.name: Wagenburg Imperial Carriage Museum
attractions.description: Museum at Schönbrunn displaying imperial carriages, including Empress Elisabeth's coaches.

attractions.name: Jewish Museum Vienna
attractions.description: Museum covering the history and culture of Jews in Vienna, located in Palais Eskeles.

attractions.name: Sigmund Freud Museum
attractions.description: Museum in the Berggasse apartment where Sigmund Freud lived and worked for 47 years.

attractions.name: Central Cemetery (Zentralfriedhof)
attractions.description: Large cemetery with honorary graves of Beethoven, Schubert, Brahms and many other composers.

attractions.name: Plague Column (Pestsäule)
attractions.description: Baroque votive column on the Graben, erected between 1679 and 1693 in thanks for the end of the 1679 plague epidemic.

attractions.name: Mumok Museum of Modern Art
attractions.description: Austria's largest museum of modern and contemporary art, in the MuseumsQuartier.

attractions.name: Kunst Haus Wien
attractions.description: Museum in a Hundertwasser-designed building showing contemporary art and the artist's work.

attractions.name: Vienna Museum (Wien Museum)
attractions.description: City history museum on Karlsplatz reopened in 2023 with collections spanning prehistory to the present.

cities.name: Prague
cities.source_note: Czech Statistical Office (CZSO), Prague City Tourism, & Euromonitor Top 100 City Destinations Index

attractions.name: Prague Castle (Pražský hrad)
attractions.description: The largest coherent ancient castle complex in the world according to Guinness World Records, seat of Bohemian kings and Czech presidents since the 9th century.

attractions.name: Charles Bridge (Karlův most)
attractions.description: 1357 medieval stone Gothic arch bridge across the Vltava River lined with 30 Baroque statues of saints and fortified bridge towers.

attractions.name: Old Town Square (Staroměstské náměstí)
attractions.description: Twelfth-century historic marketplace plaza surrounded by Romanesque, Gothic, Renaissance, and Baroque facades.

attractions.name: Prague Astronomical Clock & Old Town Hall Tower
attractions.description: 1410 medieval astronomical clock (Orloj) featuring the hourly Procession of the Twelve Apostles and a 70-meter Gothic viewing tower.

attractions.name: St. Vitus Cathedral (Katedrála svatého Víta)
attractions.description: Monumental Gothic cathedral inside Prague Castle containing the tombs of Bohemian kings, the St. Wenceslas Crown Jewels chapel, and Alfons Mucha stained glass.

attractions.name: Golden Lane (Zlatá ulička)
attractions.description: Sixteenth-century row of tiny colorful mannerist houses built into the northern fortification arches of Prague Castle, where Franz Kafka lived at No. 22.

attractions.name: Basilica of St. George (Bazilika svatého Jiří)
attractions.description: Founded in 920 AD inside Prague Castle, the oldest surviving church building in the castle complex with a red Baroque facade and austere Romanesque interior.
attractions.descriptionDe: 920 auf der Prager Burg gegründet, der älteste erhaltene Kirchenbau der Burganlage, mit roter Barockfassade und schlichtem romanischem Innenraum.

attractions.name: Old Royal Palace & Vladislav Hall
attractions.description: Medieval seat of Bohemian princes featuring the 1500 Late Gothic Vladislav Hall with its swirling rib-vaulted ceiling.

attractions.name: Lesser Town (Malá Strana)
attractions.description: Baroque hillside quarter beneath Prague Castle filled with noble palaces, terraced gardens, and cobblestone squares.

attractions.name: St. Nicholas Church (Malá Strana)
attractions.description: Masterpiece of Czech High Baroque architecture (1704–1755) by Kilian Ignaz Dientzenhofer crowned by a 74-meter green copper dome and belfry.

attractions.name: Petřín Lookout Tower & Petřín Hill
attractions.description: 63.5-meter steel framework observation tower built in 1891 atop Petřín Hill (modeled on the Eiffel Tower) accessed by a funicular railway.

attractions.name: Strahov Monastery & Baroque Library
attractions.description: 1143 Premonstratensian abbey housing the breathtaking frescoed Theological and Philosophical Halls.

attractions.name: Vyšehrad Historic Fort & Basilica of St. Peter and St. Paul
attractions.description: Tenth-century rocky promontory fortress above the Vltava containing a Neo-Gothic twin-spired basilica and the Vyšehrad National Cemetery (Slavín).

attractions.name: Jewish Quarter (Josefov) & Old Jewish Cemetery
attractions.description: Preserved Jewish ghetto containing Europe's oldest active synagogue (Old-New Synagogue, 1270) and 12,000 layered Renaissance tombstones.

attractions.name: Spanish Synagogue
attractions.description: 1868 synagogue in Josefov renowned for its dazzling gilded Moorish Revival arabesque interior modeled on the Alhambra.

attractions.name: Church of Our Lady before Týn (Chrám Matky Boží před Týnem)
attractions.description: Fourteenth-century Gothic church dominating Old Town Square with its twin 80-meter multi-spired towers and tomb of astronomer Tycho Brahe.

attractions.name: Powder Tower (Prašná brána)
attractions.description: 1475 Late Gothic monumental city gate separating the Old Town from the New Town, start of the Royal Coronation Route.

attractions.name: Municipal House (Obecní dům)
attractions.description: 1912 civic palace of Czech Art Nouveau architecture featuring Smetana Hall and decorative works by Alfons Mucha.

attractions.name: Wenceslas Square (Václavské náměstí)
attractions.description: 750-meter historic boulevard in the New Town, site of key 20th-century Czech historical events and the bronze equestrian statue of St. Wenceslas.

attractions.name: National Museum (Národní muzeum)
attractions.description: 1891 Neo-Renaissance pantheon palace at the top of Wenceslas Square displaying Czech history, mineralogy, and zoology.

attractions.name: National Theatre (Národní divadlo)
attractions.description: 1881 Neo-Renaissance riverside opera and drama monument crowned with a golden roof crown symbolizing the Czech National Revival.
attractions.descriptionDe: Neorenaissance-Bau von 1881 am Moldauufer für Oper und Schauspiel, mit goldener Dachkrone als Symbol der tschechischen Nationalen Wiedergeburt.

attractions.name: Dancing House (Tančící dům)
attractions.description: 1996 deconstructivist 'Fred and Ginger' glass-and-concrete building designed by Frank Gehry and Vlado Milunić on the Vltava embankment.

attractions.name: Klementinum (Baroque Library & Astronomical Tower)
attractions.description: Vast historic Jesuit college complex next to Charles Bridge featuring a 1722 Baroque library hall of historic globes and a 68-meter viewing tower.

attractions.name: Wallenstein Palace & Gardens (Valdštejnská zahrada)
attractions.description: 1623 Early Baroque palace (now the Czech Senate) accompanied by a geometric Italianate garden with bronze statues, white peacocks, and a stalactite grotto wall.
attractions.descriptionDe: Frühbarockes Palais von 1623 (heute Sitz des tschechischen Senats) mit geometrischem italienischem Garten, Bronzestatuen, weißen Pfauen und Tropfsteinwand.

attractions.name: Vrtba Garden (Vrtbovská zahrada)
attractions.description: 1720 terraced Italian Baroque hillside garden on the slope of Petřín offering framed rooftop views over Malá Strana.

attractions.name: Letná Park (Letenské sady) & Prague Metronome
attractions.description: Elevated plateau park above the Vltava River famous for its giant 23-meter red swinging Metronome and postcard view of Prague's consecutive bridges.
attractions.descriptionDe: Parkplateau über der Moldau, bekannt für das 23 Meter hohe rote Metronom und den Postkartenblick auf die Prager Brücken.

attractions.name: Kampa Island & Kampa Park
attractions.description: Romantic island separated from Malá Strana by the Čertovka ('Devil's Stream') mill race, featuring waterwheels and David Černý's giant bronze Babies.

attractions.name: Museum Kampa
attractions.description: Modern European art museum in the restored Sova's Mills on the Vltava, housing pioneer abstract works by František Kupka and sculptures by Otto Gutfreund.

attractions.name: John Lennon Wall
attractions.description: Colorful freedom-of-speech mural wall on Velkopřevorské náměstí covered since the 1980s in Beatles lyrics and peace art.

attractions.name: Lobkowicz Palace
attractions.description: The only privately owned palace inside Prague Castle, displaying original Beethoven and Mozart manuscripts and paintings by Bruegel the Elder and Canaletto.

attractions.name: National Gallery Prague — Trade Fair Palace (Veletržní palác)
attractions.description: Monumental 1928 Functionalist palace housing Czech and international 19th- to 21st-century art, including Alfons Mucha's monumental 20-canvas 'Slav Epic'.

attractions.name: National Gallery Prague — Sternberg Palace
attractions.description: 1698 High Baroque palace on Hradčany Square exhibiting European Old Masters from antiquity to the end of the Baroque era.

attractions.name: National Gallery Prague — Convent of St. Agnes of Bohemia
attractions.description: Founded in 1231, Prague's earliest Gothic brick building housing medieval Bohemian and Central European panel paintings and sculptures.

attractions.name: Loreta Prague (Pražská Loreta)
attractions.description: 1626 Baroque pilgrimage sanctuary in Hradčany famous for its 30-bell carillon, Santa Casa replica, and the Diamond Monstrance containing 6,222 diamonds.

attractions.name: Royal Garden of Prague Castle & Queen Anne's Summer Palace
attractions.description: 1534 Renaissance royal garden featuring the 'Singing Fountain' and the purest Italian Renaissance belvedere architecture north of the Alps.

attractions.name: Deer Moat (Jelení příkop)
attractions.description: Forested natural ravine bordering the northern walls of Prague Castle connected byJosef Pleskot's modern brick pedestrian tunnel.

attractions.name: Riegrovy sady (Rieger Gardens)
attractions.description: 1904 classicist park in Vinohrady whose western grassy meadow offers one of the city's most famous sunset views of Prague Castle.
attractions.descriptionDe: Klassizistischer Park von 1904 in Vinohrady, dessen Westwiese einen der bekanntesten Sonnenuntergangsblicke auf die Prager Burg bietet.

attractions.name: Havlíčkovy sady (Grébovka)
attractions.description: Neo-Renaissance park in Vinohrady inspired by the Italian Renaissance, featuring a historic terraced vineyard, wooden gazebo, and artificial grotto.

attractions.name: Stromovka (Royal Game Preserve)
attractions.description: Prague's largest park (235 acres), founded in 1268 as a royal hunting ground by King Ottokar II with ponds and landscaped meadows.
attractions.descriptionDe: Prags größter Park, 1268 von König Ottokar II. als königliches Jagdgebiet angelegt, mit Teichen und Wiesen.

attractions.name: Prague Zoo (Zoologická zahrada hl. m. Prahy)
attractions.description: World-ranked 143-acre zoological park built across dramatic rocky cliffs and river lowlands in Troja, famous for Przewalski's horse conservation.

attractions.name: Troja Chateau (Trojský zámek)
attractions.description: Seventeenth-century red-and-white Roman-style Baroque summer villa surrounded by French geometric gardens and vineyards.

attractions.name: Prague Botanical Garden & Fata Morgana Greenhouse
attractions.description: Hillside botanical garden in Troja featuring a 130-meter S-shaped tropical glasshouse and a serene Japanese garden.

attractions.name: DOX Centre for Contemporary Art
attractions.description: Avant-garde contemporary art center in Holešovice crowned by the 42-meter wooden Gulliver Airship suspended over the courtyard.

attractions.name: National Technical Museum (Národní technické muzeum)
attractions.description: Extensive museum beside Letná Park exhibiting historic Czech aircraft, Tatra automobiles, locomotives, photography, and astronomy.
attractions.descriptionDe: Großes Museum am Letná-Park mit historischen tschechischen Flugzeugen, Tatra-Autos, Lokomotiven, Fotografie und Astronomie.

attractions.name: Franz Kafka Museum & Rotating Head Statue
attractions.description: Immersive museum at the Hergetova Cihelna brickworks alongside David Černý's 11-meter kinetic 42-layer stainless-steel head of Franz Kafka at Národní.

attractions.name: Mucha Museum
attractions.description: Baroque Kaunický Palace museum dedicated to the life, lithographs, and decorative designs of Art Nouveau master Alfons Mucha.

attractions.name: Speculum Alchemiae (Museum of Alchemy)
attractions.description: Preserved 16th-century subterranean alchemical laboratories discovered behind secret bookshelves in one of Prague's oldest houses.
attractions.descriptionDe: Erhaltene unterirdische Alchemielabore aus dem 16. Jahrhundert, entdeckt hinter Geheimregalen in einem der ältesten Häuser Prags.

attractions.name: bethlehem Chapel (Betlémská kaple)
attractions.description: Reconstructed 1391 medieval hall church in the Old Town where Protestant reformer Jan Hus preached in the Czech language.
attractions.descriptionDe: Rekonstruierte mittelalterliche Hallenkirche von 1391 in der Altstadt, in der der Reformator Jan Hus auf Tschechisch predigte.

attractions.name: Church of Our Lady Victorious (Infant Jesus of Prague)
attractions.description: 1613 Early Baroque Carmelite church in Malá Strana housing the world-famous 16th-century wax-coated wooden statue of the Infant Jesus of Prague.

attractions.name: Žižkov Television Tower
attractions.description: 216-meter high-tech structuralist transmitter tower built between 1985 and 1992 with a 93-meter observation cabin and climbing fiberglass baby sculptures.

cities.name: Los Angeles
cities.source_note: Los Angeles Tourism & Convention Board (Discover Los Angeles): 6.4 million international visitors to LA in 2025 (49.5M total).

attractions.name: Griffith Observatory
attractions.description: Art Deco observatory on Mount Hollywood with free public telescopes and panoramic views of the city and Hollywood Sign.

attractions.name: Getty Center
attractions.description: Hilltop art museum designed by Richard Meier, with European masterpieces, gardens and sweeping views over Los Angeles.

attractions.name: Hollywood Walk of Fame
attractions.description: Sidewalk along Hollywood Boulevard embedded with more than 2,700 brass stars honoring entertainment figures.

attractions.name: Hollywood Sign
attractions.description: Iconic 45-foot white letters on Mount Lee, visible across Los Angeles and best reached via nearby trails.

attractions.name: LACMA (Los Angeles County Museum of Art)
attractions.description: Largest art museum in the western United States, home to Urban Light and encyclopedic collections.

attractions.name: Santa Monica Pier
attractions.description: Historic 1909 pier with a Ferris wheel, carousel and ocean views at the end of Route 66.

attractions.name: Venice Beach
attractions.description: Wide Pacific beach known for its boardwalk, Muscle Beach, skate park and street performers.

attractions.name: The Broad
attractions.description: Free downtown museum of postwar and contemporary art, including Yayoi Kusama's Infinity Mirrored Room.

attractions.name: Griffith Park
attractions.description: One of the largest urban parks in the US, with hiking trails, the observatory and Los Angeles Zoo nearby.

attractions.name: Santa Monica Beach
attractions.description: Broad sandy beach along Santa Monica Bay, popular for swimming, cycling and sunsets.
attractions.descriptionDe: Breiter Sandstrand an der Santa Monica Bay, beliebt zum Schwimmen, Radfahren und für Sonnenuntergänge.

attractions.name: Walt Disney Concert Hall
attractions.description: Frank Gehry's stainless-steel concert hall, home of the LA Philharmonic, known for its sculptural design.

attractions.name: Academy Museum of Motion Pictures
attractions.description: Museum of film history and Oscars memorabilia in the former May Company building on Wilshire Boulevard.

attractions.name: Petersen Automotive Museum
attractions.description: Museum on Museum Row displaying over 100 historic and exotic vehicles in a striking ribbon-clad building.

attractions.name: Natural History Museum of Los Angeles County
attractions.description: Museum with dinosaur fossils, gems, North American mammals and a nature garden in Exposition Park.

attractions.name: La Brea Tar Pits and Museum
attractions.description: Active Ice Age fossil site with asphalt seeps, mammoth statues and a paleontology museum.

attractions.name: Getty Villa
attractions.description: Seaside villa in Pacific Palisades housing Greek, Roman and Etruscan antiquities amid Mediterranean gardens.

attractions.name: California Science Center
attractions.description: Free science museum in Exposition Park, home to the Space Shuttle Endeavour.

attractions.name: TCL Chinese Theatre
attractions.description: 1927 Hollywood movie palace famed for its pagoda facade and celebrity hand and footprints in the forecourt.

attractions.name: Runyon Canyon Park
attractions.description: Popular Hollywood Hills park with steep trails, city views and an off-leash dog area.
attractions.descriptionDe: Beliebter Park in den Hollywood Hills mit steilen Wegen, Stadtblick und Freilauffläche für Hunde.

attractions.name: Hollywood Forever Cemetery
attractions.description: Historic cemetery with the graves of many film stars, hosting summer outdoor screenings.

attractions.name: El Pueblo de Los Angeles Historical Monument
attractions.description: Historic district where Los Angeles was founded in 1781, with the Avila Adobe, the Old Plaza Church and Olvera Street.
attractions.descriptionDe: Historisches Viertel, in dem Los Angeles 1781 gegründet wurde, mit dem Avila Adobe, der Old Plaza Church und der Olvera Street.

attractions.name: Los Angeles Union Station
attractions.description: 1939 Mission Revival and Art Deco railway station, one of the last great American train terminals.

attractions.name: Los Angeles City Hall
attractions.description: 1928 Art Deco civic tower with a free observation deck offering views over downtown.

attractions.name: The Huntington Library, Art Museum and Botanical Gardens
attractions.description: San Marino estate with 120 acres of themed gardens, a major library and art collections.

attractions.name: Descanso Gardens
attractions.description: 150-acre botanical garden in La Cañada Flintridge known for camellias, roses and a Japanese garden.
attractions.descriptionDe: Botanischer Garten in La Cañada Flintridge, bekannt für Kamelien, Rosen und einen japanischen Garten.

attractions.name: Los Angeles County Arboretum and Botanic Garden
attractions.description: Botanical garden in Arcadia with diverse plant collections and historic Queen Anne cottage.
attractions.descriptionDe: Botanischer Garten in Arcadia mit vielfältigen Pflanzensammlungen und einem historischen Queen-Anne-Cottage.

attractions.name: Zuma Beach
attractions.description: Long wide Malibu beach with strong surf, popular for swimming and sunbathing.

attractions.name: Point Dume
attractions.description: Malibu headland with cliff trails, whale-watching views and coves including Westward Beach.

attractions.name: Venice Canals
attractions.description: Historic residential canals built in 1905, lined with footbridges and gardens.

attractions.name: The Geffen Contemporary at MOCA
attractions.description: Museum of Contemporary Art's downtown venues showing postwar and contemporary art.
attractions.descriptionDe: Standort des Museum of Contemporary Art in Downtown mit Kunst der Nachkriegszeit und Gegenwart.

attractions.name: Museum of Jurassic Technology
attractions.description: Quirky Culver City museum of eccentric exhibits blending art, science and fiction.

attractions.name: Autry Museum of the American West
attractions.description: Griffith Park museum exploring the history, art and cultures of the American West.
attractions.descriptionDe: Museum im Griffith Park über Geschichte, Kunst und Kulturen des amerikanischen Westens.

attractions.name: Skirball Cultural Center
attractions.description: Museum of Jewish heritage and American democratic ideals in the Santa Monica Mountains.
attractions.descriptionDe: Museum für jüdisches Erbe und amerikanische demokratische Ideale in den Santa Monica Mountains.

attractions.name: Norton Simon Museum
attractions.description: Pasadena art museum with European masters from Rembrandt to Picasso and Asian sculpture.

attractions.name: Gamble House
attractions.description: 1908 Pasadena Arts and Crafts masterpiece by Greene and Greene, open for guided tours.
attractions.descriptionDe: Meisterwerk des Arts and Crafts von Greene and Greene aus dem Jahr 1908 in Pasadena, mit Führungen.

attractions.name: Watts Towers
attractions.description: Folk-art sculptures of steel and mosaic built by Simon Rodia over 33 years.

attractions.name: Cathedral of Our Lady of the Angels
attractions.description: Rafael Moneo-designed downtown cathedral of the Archdiocese of Los Angeles, with tapestries and a large organ.

attractions.name: Bradbury Building
attractions.description: 1893 downtown building famed for its ornate Victorian atrium with iron staircases and glass-roofed light court.

attractions.name: Angels Flight
attractions.description: Historic 1901 funicular railway on Bunker Hill, billed as the world's shortest railway.

attractions.name: Hammer Museum
attractions.description: UCLA's art museum in Westwood with free admission and works from old masters to contemporary artists.

attractions.name: GRAMMY Museum
attractions.description: L.A. Live museum with interactive exhibits on the history and artists of recorded music.
attractions.descriptionDe: Museum am L.A. Live mit interaktiven Ausstellungen zur Geschichte und zu den Stars der Musikaufnahme.

attractions.name: Museum of Tolerance
attractions.description: Simon Wiesenthal Center museum exploring the Holocaust and human rights issues.

attractions.name: Mission San Gabriel Arcángel
attractions.description: Spanish mission founded in 1771 in San Gabriel, with its historic church, museum and gardens.

attractions.name: Point Vicente Lighthouse
attractions.description: 1926 lighthouse and interpretive center on Rancho Palos Verdes cliffs with whale-watching views.
attractions.descriptionDe: Leuchtturm von 1926 mit Besucherzentrum auf den Klippen von Rancho Palos Verdes, mit Blick zum Walebeobachten.

attractions.name: Palisades Park
attractions.description: Clifftop park in Santa Monica with ocean views, palm trees and sunset promenade.
attractions.descriptionDe: Park auf den Klippen von Santa Monica mit Meerblick, Palmen und Promenade für den Sonnenuntergang.

attractions.name: Elysian Park
attractions.description: Los Angeles' oldest public park, with hiking trails and views next to Dodger Stadium.

attractions.name: Echo Park Lake
attractions.description: Urban lake park with paddle boats, lotus beds and views of the downtown skyline.
attractions.descriptionDe: Stadtpark am See mit Tretbooten, Lotusbeeten und Blick auf die Skyline von Downtown.

attractions.name: Mulholland Drive Overlook
attractions.description: Hollywood Hills lookout with sweeping views over the San Fernando Valley and the Los Angeles basin.

attractions.name: Self-Realization Fellowship Lake Shrine
attractions.description: Tranquil lakeside meditation garden in Pacific Palisades with a Gandhi World Peace Memorial.
attractions.descriptionDe: Ruhiger Meditationsgarten an einem See in Pacific Palisades mit einem Gandhi-Weltfriedensdenkmal.

attractions.name: RMS Queen Mary
attractions.description: Historic 1936 ocean liner permanently moored in Long Beach, open for tours.

cities.name: Lisbon
cities.source_note: Derived from INE (Statistics Portugal) 2024: Lisbon municipality had 23.9% of Portugal's 56.4M non-resident overnight stays (about 13.5M); divided by an average stay of about 2.3 nights (INE, Lisbon H1 2025: 7.5M nights / 3.3M guests) gives about 5.9M foreign guests in tourist accommodation. Estimate; excludes stays outside registered accommodation.

attractions.name: Belém Tower (Torre de Belém)
attractions.description: 16th-century fortified tower on the Tagus, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and symbol of the Age of Discovery.

attractions.name: Jerónimos Monastery (Mosteiro dos Jerónimos)
attractions.description: Manueline monastery in Belém, UNESCO-listed, housing the tomb of Vasco da Gama.

attractions.name: São Jorge Castle (Castelo de São Jorge)
attractions.description: Moorish hilltop castle with ramparts and sweeping views over Lisbon and the Tagus.

attractions.name: Alfama
attractions.description: Lisbon's oldest district, a maze of medieval lanes, fado houses and tiled façades.

attractions.name: Monument to the Discoveries (Padrão dos Descobrimentos)
attractions.description: Riverside monument in Belém honouring Portugal's explorers of the Age of Discovery.

attractions.name: Praça do Comércio
attractions.description: Grand waterfront square framed by yellow arcades and the triumphal Rua Augusta Arch (with its viewing platform), rebuilt after the 1755 earthquake.

attractions.name: Lisbon Cathedral (Sé de Lisboa)
attractions.description: Romanesque cathedral dating from 1147, the city's oldest church.

attractions.name: São Roque Church (Igreja de São Roque)
attractions.description: Early Jesuit church in Chiado with a plain façade, a richly decorated interior and the lavish Chapel of St John the Baptist, with an adjoining museum of sacred art.

attractions.name: Miradouro da Senhora do Monte
attractions.description: Highest of Lisbon's viewpoints, with panoramic views of the castle and river.
attractions.descriptionDe: Der höchste Aussichtspunkt Lissabons mit Panoramablick auf die Burg und den Fluss.

attractions.name: Miradouro de Santa Luzia
attractions.description: Terrace viewpoint over Alfama's rooftops, decorated with azulejo panels.
attractions.descriptionDe: Aussichtsterrasse über den Dächern der Alfama, geschmückt mit Azulejo-Bildern.

attractions.name: Miradouro das Portas do Sol
attractions.description: Popular Alfama terrace overlooking red rooftops, the Tagus and the São Vicente church.
attractions.descriptionDe: Beliebte Terrasse in der Alfama mit Blick auf rote Dächer, den Tejo und die Kirche São Vicente.

attractions.name: Carmo Convent (Convento do Carmo)
attractions.description: Gothic convent ruins left roofless by the 1755 earthquake, now home to the Carmo Archaeological Museum.
attractions.descriptionDe: Gotische Klosterruine, seit dem Erdbeben von 1755 ohne Dach, heute Sitz des Archäologischen Museums do Carmo.

attractions.name: Parque das Nações
attractions.description: Modern riverside district built for Expo 98 with promenades, gardens and public art.

attractions.name: Calouste Gulbenkian Museum
attractions.description: Museum holding the Armenian oil magnate's art collection from antiquity to the early 20th century.

attractions.name: MAAT (Museum of Art, Architecture and Technology)
attractions.description: Riverside museum with a curved, walkable roof, devoted to contemporary art and architecture.

attractions.name: Rossio Square (Praça Dom Pedro IV)
attractions.description: Lisbon's historic central square with wave-patterned pavement, fountains and the National Theatre.

attractions.name: Bairro Alto
attractions.description: Historic Lisbon quarter of narrow streets and old townhouses in a grid layout.

attractions.name: Chiado
attractions.description: Elegant historic district known for literary cafés, theatres and the Carmo ruins nearby.

attractions.name: Estrela Basilica (Basílica da Estrela)
attractions.description: Late 18th-century baroque and neoclassical basilica with a large dome.

attractions.name: Estrela Garden (Jardim da Estrela)
attractions.description: Romantic 19th-century public garden opposite the Estrela Basilica.
attractions.descriptionDe: Romantischer öffentlicher Garten aus dem 19. Jahrhundert gegenüber der Estrela-Basilika.

attractions.name: Eduardo VII Park (Parque Eduardo VII)
attractions.description: Large hillside park with formal gardens, a greenhouse and views down to the river.

attractions.name: Estufa Fria
attractions.description: Botanical greenhouse in Eduardo VII Park with tropical and subtropical plants.

attractions.name: Monsanto Forest Park (Parque Florestal de Monsanto)
attractions.description: Large forested park west of the city with trails and viewpoints.

attractions.name: Pantheon (National Pantheon)
attractions.description: Baroque church of Santa Engrácia, now a national pantheon with a rooftop terrace.

attractions.name: São Vicente de Fora Monastery
attractions.description: 16th-century monastery with azulejo-decorated cloisters and the Braganza royal pantheon.

attractions.name: Fado Museum (Museu do Fado)
attractions.description: Museum in Alfama on the history of fado, the Portuguese song tradition inscribed on UNESCO's Intangible Heritage list.

attractions.name: National Museum of Ancient Art (Museu Nacional de Arte Antiga)
attractions.description: Portugal's main museum of old master art, including Bosch's Temptations of Saint Anthony; closed for restoration and due to reopen on 21 November 2026.

attractions.name: National Coach Museum (Museu Nacional dos Coches)
attractions.description: One of the world's finest collections of royal carriages from the 16th to 19th centuries.

attractions.name: Casa dos Bicos
attractions.description: 16th-century house near the Tagus with a distinctive diamond-point façade, now home to the José Saramago Foundation.
attractions.descriptionDe: Haus aus dem 16. Jahrhundert nahe dem Tejo mit markanter Diamantquader-Fassade, heute Sitz der José-Saramago-Stiftung.

attractions.name: Museum of Lisbon (Museu de Lisboa)
attractions.description: City museum covering Lisbon's history, set in the Pimenta Palace.
attractions.descriptionDe: Stadtmuseum über die Geschichte Lissabons im Palácio Pimenta.

attractions.name: MAC/CCB (Museu de Arte Contemporânea / CCB)
attractions.description: Contemporary art museum at the Belém Cultural Centre, opened in 2023 as successor to the Berardo Collection museum and showing the Berardo and Ellipse collections.

attractions.name: Maritime Museum (Museu de Marinha)
attractions.description: Museum of Portuguese naval history housed in part of Jerónimos Monastery.

attractions.name: Ajuda National Palace (Palácio Nacional da Ajuda)
attractions.description: 19th-century neoclassical royal palace, still furnished as a royal residence.

attractions.name: National Museum of Contemporary Art (MNAC Chiado)
attractions.description: Portuguese national art museum in Chiado showing Portuguese art from 1850 to the present.

attractions.name: Ajuda Botanical Garden (Jardim Botânico da Ajuda)
attractions.description: One of Europe's oldest botanical gardens, founded in 1768.
attractions.descriptionDe: Einer der ältesten botanischen Gärten Europas, gegründet 1768.

attractions.name: Lisbon Botanical Garden (Jardim Botânico de Lisboa)
attractions.description: 19th-century botanical garden with palms, ponds and rare plants near Príncipe Real.
attractions.descriptionDe: Botanischer Garten aus dem 19. Jahrhundert mit Palmen, Teichen und seltenen Pflanzen nahe dem Príncipe Real.

attractions.name: Aqueduto das Águas Livres
attractions.description: 18th-century aqueduct whose Alcântara arches span a valley and survived the 1755 earthquake.

attractions.name: 25 de Abril Bridge (Ponte 25 de Abril)
attractions.description: Red suspension bridge over the Tagus, resembling San Francisco's Golden Gate Bridge.

attractions.name: Prazeres Cemetery (Cemitério dos Prazeres)
attractions.description: Romantic 19th-century cemetery with monumental mausoleums, an open-air museum of funerary architecture where Fernando Pessoa is buried.

attractions.name: Cristo Rei
attractions.description: Large statue of Christ with open arms on the south bank, with a viewing platform.

attractions.name: Fronteira Palace (Palácio dos Marqueses de Fronteira)
attractions.description: 17th-century palace in Benfica known for its Baroque gardens decorated with azulejo panels.

attractions.name: Gulbenkian Garden
attractions.description: Landscaped modernist garden surrounding the Gulbenkian Foundation.

attractions.name: Church of Saint Anthony (Igreja de Santo António)
attractions.description: Church said to be built on the birthplace of Saint Anthony of Padua.

attractions.name: Mãe d'Água Reservoir (Reservatório da Mãe d'Água)
attractions.description: 18th-century stone reservoir at the end of the Águas Livres Aqueduct, now part of the Museu da Água.
attractions.descriptionDe: Steinerner Wasserspeicher aus dem 18. Jahrhundert am Ende des Aquädukts Águas Livres, heute Teil des Wassermuseums.

attractions.name: Graça Viewpoint (Miradouro da Graça)
attractions.description: Pine-shaded terrace with panoramic views over the castle, Baixa and the river.
attractions.descriptionDe: Von Pinien beschattete Terrasse mit Panoramablick auf Burg, Baixa und Fluss.

attractions.name: São Pedro de Alcântara Viewpoint (Miradouro de São Pedro de Alcântara)
attractions.description: Terraced garden viewpoint in Bairro Alto facing the castle.
attractions.descriptionDe: Terrassengarten mit Aussichtspunkt im Bairro Alto, gegenüber der Burg.

attractions.name: Miradouro de Santa Catarina (Adamastor)
attractions.description: Popular sunset terrace above the river, topped with a statue of Adamastor.

attractions.name: Tagus Riverfront Promenade
attractions.description: Riverfront promenade along the Tagus with open views and evening sunsets.

attractions.name: Ribeira das Naus Promenade
attractions.description: Revitalised riverside promenade with steps down to the Tagus.

attractions.name: Museu do Oriente (Orient Museum)
attractions.description: Museum in a former Alcântara warehouse showcasing Portugal's historic ties with Asia through art and artefacts.
attractions.descriptionDe: Museum in einem ehemaligen Lagerhaus in Alcântara über Portugals historische Verbindungen zu Asien.

cities.name: Berlin
cities.source_note: 4.7 million international (foreign) guests in Berlin accommodation establishments in 2024 per visitBerlin / Statistical Office Berlin-Brandenburg; counts only registered accommodation guests, so true international visitors (day trips, private stays) are higher.

attractions.name: Brandenburg Gate (Brandenburger Tor)
attractions.description: Neoclassical 18th-century city gate topped by the Quadriga, the enduring symbol of Berlin and German reunification.

attractions.name: Reichstag Building
attractions.description: Seat of the German parliament, famed for its glass dome with panoramic views over the city.

attractions.name: Museum Island (Museumsinsel)
attractions.description: UNESCO World Heritage complex of five major museums on an island in the Spree.

attractions.name: Berlin Wall Memorial (Gedenkstätte Berliner Mauer)
attractions.description: Memorial on Bernauer Strasse preserving a section of the border strip with documentation and a viewing tower.

attractions.name: East Side Gallery
attractions.description: Open-air gallery of murals painted on a 1.3 km surviving stretch of the Berlin Wall.

attractions.name: Memorial to the Murdered Jews of Europe
attractions.description: Field of 2,711 concrete slabs designed by Peter Eisenman, with an underground information centre.

attractions.name: Neue Nationalgalerie
attractions.description: Mies van der Rohe's glass-and-steel temple of 20th-century art at the Kulturforum, Berlin's most visited art museum in 2025.

attractions.name: Checkpoint Charlie
attractions.description: Former Cold War crossing point between East and West Berlin, now a landmark with exhibitions.

attractions.name: Berlin Cathedral (Berliner Dom)
attractions.description: Ornate Protestant cathedral with a large dome, imperial crypt and a viewing gallery.

attractions.name: Berlin TV Tower (Fernsehturm)
attractions.description: 368-metre tower at Alexanderplatz with an observation deck and revolving restaurant.

attractions.name: Charlottenburg Palace (Schloss Charlottenburg)
attractions.description: Largest surviving Hohenzollern palace in Berlin, with baroque apartments and extensive gardens.

attractions.name: Topography of Terror
attractions.description: Documentation centre on the former Gestapo and SS headquarters site, with an outdoor exhibition.

attractions.name: Tiergarten
attractions.description: Berlin's large central park of lawns, lakes and paths, once a royal hunting ground.

attractions.name: Gendarmenmarkt
attractions.description: Elegant 18th-century square framed by the Konzerthaus and the French and German cathedrals.

attractions.name: Jewish Museum Berlin
attractions.description: Museum of German-Jewish history in a striking zigzag building by Daniel Libeskind.

attractions.name: Sanssouci Palace (Schloss Sanssouci)
attractions.description: Frederick the Great's rococo summer palace in Potsdam, set in a UNESCO-listed park.

attractions.name: Deutsches Technikmuseum
attractions.description: Large museum of technology history with historic locomotives, ships and aircraft, plus the hands-on Science Center Spectrum.

attractions.name: Victory Column (Siegessäule)
attractions.description: 67-metre column crowned by a golden Victoria statue, with a viewing platform in the Tiergarten.

attractions.name: Tempelhofer Feld
attractions.description: Vast public park on the former Tempelhof airport airfield, used for cycling, skating and picnics.

attractions.name: Humboldt Forum
attractions.description: Cultural centre in the rebuilt Berlin Palace housing ethnological collections and a rooftop terrace.

attractions.name: Museum Barberini
attractions.description: Rebuilt baroque palace in Potsdam housing a major Impressionist collection that includes dozens of works by Monet.

attractions.name: Haus der Wannsee-Konferenz
attractions.description: Lakeside villa where the 1942 Wannsee Conference on the Holocaust took place, now a memorial and education centre.
attractions.descriptionDe: Villa am Wannsee, in der 1942 die Wannseekonferenz zum Holocaust stattfand, heute Gedenk- und Bildungsstätte.

attractions.name: Berlin-Hohenschönhausen Memorial
attractions.description: Former Stasi remand prison in East Berlin, now a memorial with guided tours led by ex-inmates.

attractions.name: Soviet War Memorial (Treptower Park)
