attractions.description: Vast Soviet memorial and cemetery in Treptower Park honouring Red Army soldiers killed in 1945.

attractions.name: Hamburger Bahnhof
attractions.description: Contemporary art museum in a former railway station.

attractions.name: Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church
attractions.description: Ruined Neo-Romanesque church left as a war memorial beside a modern blue-glass church.

attractions.name: Berlin Botanic Garden (Botanischer Garten)
attractions.description: Large botanical garden and museum in Dahlem with historic glasshouses and themed plant collections.

attractions.name: Museum für Naturkunde
attractions.description: Natural history museum known for its dinosaur skeletons, including a giant Brachiosaurus.

attractions.name: Berlinische Galerie
attractions.description: Museum of Berlin art, photography and architecture from 1870 to today in a former glass warehouse in Kreuzberg.

attractions.name: Stasi Museum
attractions.description: Museum in the former East German secret police headquarters, preserving the offices of Erich Mielke.

attractions.name: DDR Museum
attractions.description: Interactive museum on everyday life in East Germany, beside the River Spree.

attractions.name: Gemäldegalerie
attractions.description: Gallery of European painting from the 13th to 18th centuries at the Kulturforum.

attractions.name: Gedenkstätte Deutscher Widerstand
attractions.description: Memorial in the Bendlerblock where the 20 July 1944 plot against Hitler failed, with an exhibition on resistance to National Socialism.

attractions.name: Unter den Linden
attractions.description: Grand lime-tree boulevard running from the Brandenburg Gate past major historic buildings.

attractions.name: Nikolaiviertel
attractions.description: Reconstructed medieval quarter on the site of Berlin's oldest settlement.

attractions.name: St. Mary's Church (Marienkirche)
attractions.description: Gothic 13th-century parish church near Alexanderplatz with a medieval Dance of Death fresco.

attractions.name: Käthe Kollwitz Museum
attractions.description: Museum in Charlottenburg dedicated to the graphic art and sculpture of Käthe Kollwitz.

attractions.name: Mauerpark
attractions.description: Park on the former Wall death strip, known for its Sunday flea market and karaoke.

attractions.name: Gardens of the World (Gärten der Welt)
attractions.description: Park in Marzahn with themed international gardens including Chinese, Japanese and Balinese.

attractions.name: Spandau Citadel (Zitadelle Spandau)
attractions.description: Well-preserved Renaissance fortress at the confluence of the Spree and Havel.

attractions.name: Teufelsberg
attractions.description: Former US listening station on an artificial hill, now with street art and city views.

attractions.name: Peacock Island (Pfaueninsel)
attractions.description: Havel island with a romantic white castle folly, landscaped gardens and free-roaming peacocks.

attractions.name: Oberbaum Bridge
attractions.description: Double-deck brick Gothic-style bridge over the Spree linking Kreuzberg and Friedrichshain.

attractions.name: New Synagogue (Neue Synagoge)
attractions.description: Moorish-style synagogue with a golden dome on Oranienburger Strasse, now a Jewish cultural centre.

attractions.name: St. Hedwig's Cathedral
attractions.description: Catholic cathedral with a domed, Pantheon-inspired rotunda on Bebelplatz.

attractions.name: Cecilienhof Palace (Schloss Cecilienhof)
attractions.description: Tudor-style palace in Potsdam where the 1945 Potsdam Conference took place.

attractions.name: Glienicke Bridge
attractions.description: Havel bridge between Berlin and Potsdam famed as the Cold War Bridge of Spies.

attractions.name: Viktoriapark
attractions.description: Hillside park in Kreuzberg with a waterfall, vineyard and the National Monument memorial.

attractions.name: Müggelsee
attractions.description: Berlin's largest lake, ringed by forest, beaches and walking trails in the southeast.

attractions.name: Grunewald Forest (Grunewald)
attractions.description: Large woodland in southwest Berlin with lakes, beaches and walking and cycling trails.

cities.name: Munich
cities.source_note: ESTIMATE (2024): no direct official figure found. Munich Tourismus reports 9.28M guest arrivals in 2024 (all origins); ~3.47M international travellers cited for 2023 (GoWithGuide), grown ~10% for 2024.

attractions.name: Marienplatz
attractions.description: Munich's central square, dominated by the neo-Gothic New Town Hall and its Glockenspiel.

attractions.name: English Garden (Englischer Garten)
attractions.description: One of the world's largest urban parks, with beer gardens, the Eisbach and the Chinese Tower.

attractions.name: Nymphenburg Palace (Schloss Nymphenburg)
attractions.description: Baroque summer residence of Bavarian rulers with a carriage museum and large palace park.

attractions.name: Munich Residence (Residenz)
attractions.description: Former royal palace of the Bavarian monarchs with opulent rooms, a treasury and the Cuvilliés Theatre.

attractions.name: Deutsches Museum
attractions.description: One of the world's largest science and technology museums, from aviation to physics.

attractions.name: BMW Museum
attractions.description: Museum tracing the history of BMW cars, motorcycles and engines.

attractions.name: Frauenkirche (Church of Our Lady)
attractions.description: Late-Gothic cathedral with twin onion-domed towers and a Munich landmark.

attractions.name: Olympiapark
attractions.description: Park built for the 1972 Olympics, with a tent-roof complex, the 291-metre Olympic Tower with its viewing platform, and the rubble-built Olympiaberg hill with city views.

attractions.name: Alte Pinakothek
attractions.description: Major gallery of Old Master paintings from the 14th to 18th centuries.

attractions.name: Pinakothek der Moderne
attractions.description: Large museum combining modern art, design, architecture and graphic art.

attractions.name: Asamkirche (Asam Church)
attractions.description: Lavish late-Baroque church built by the Asam brothers as their private chapel.

attractions.name: St. Peter's Church (Peterskirche)
attractions.description: Munich's oldest parish church, with a tower climbable for views over the old town.

attractions.name: Königsplatz
attractions.description: Neoclassical square flanked by the Glyptothek, the Antiquities Collections and the Propylaea.

attractions.name: Glyptothek
attractions.description: Neoclassical museum of ancient Greek and Roman sculpture on Königsplatz.

attractions.name: Lenbachhaus
attractions.description: Gallery in a Florentine-style villa famed for its Blue Rider collection.

attractions.name: Museum Brandhorst
attractions.description: Contemporary art museum with works by Cy Twombly and Andy Warhol.

attractions.name: Hofgarten
attractions.description: Renaissance court garden next to the Residence with a central pavilion and arcades.

attractions.name: Theatinerkirche (Theatine Church)
attractions.description: Italian High Baroque church with a yellow facade, dome and Wittelsbach crypt.

attractions.name: St. Michael's Church (Michaelskirche)
attractions.description: Renaissance church with a huge barrel vault and the crypt of Bavarian kings.

attractions.name: Deutsches Museum Verkehrszentrum (Transport Centre)
attractions.description: Branch of the Deutsches Museum in three historic exhibition halls on the Theresienhöhe, showing road, rail and urban mobility since 2003.

attractions.name: Siegestor (Victory Gate)
attractions.description: Three-arched triumphal arch of 1852 on Ludwigstraße, designed by Friedrich von Gärtner for Ludwig I and crowned by a lion-drawn Bavaria quadriga.

attractions.name: Isartor
attractions.description: Medieval city gate on the eastern edge of the old town.

attractions.name: Karlstor and Karlsplatz (Stachus)
attractions.description: Historic city gate and busy plaza at the western end of the pedestrian zone.

attractions.name: Sendlinger Tor
attractions.description: Gothic city gate on the southern side of Munich's old town.

attractions.name: Friedensengel (Angel of Peace)
attractions.description: Gilded angel monument above the Isar commemorating 25 years of peace after 1871.

attractions.name: Bavarian National Museum (Bayerisches Nationalmuseum)
attractions.description: Museum of European art and Bavarian cultural history, from medieval sculpture to decorative arts.

attractions.name: Museum Fünf Kontinente
attractions.description: Ethnological museum with collections from Africa, Asia, Oceania and the Americas.

attractions.name: NS-Documentation Centre (NS-Dokumentationszentrum)
attractions.description: Museum on the former Nazi party headquarters site documenting Munich's role in National Socialism.

attractions.name: Jewish Museum Munich
attractions.description: Museum exploring Jewish life and history in Munich, on St.-Jakobs-Platz.

attractions.name: Ohel Jakob Synagogue
attractions.description: Modern main synagogue of Munich, opened in 2006 near St.-Jakobs-Platz.

attractions.name: Botanical Garden Munich-Nymphenburg
attractions.description: Large botanical garden with greenhouses and thousands of plant species.

attractions.name: Hirschgarten
attractions.description: Large park with a beer garden and a deer enclosure, once a royal hunting ground.

attractions.name: Westpark
attractions.description: Landscaped park with Asian gardens, a Thai Sala and a rose garden.

attractions.name: Isar River Banks (Isarauen)
attractions.description: Restored riverbanks along the Isar, popular for walking, sunbathing and swimming.
attractions.descriptionDe: Renaturierte Isarufer, beliebt zum Spazierengehen, Sonnenbaden und Schwimmen.

attractions.name: Schleissheim Palace (Schloss Schleißheim)
attractions.description: Baroque palace complex with formal gardens and a gallery on Munich's northern edge.

attractions.name: Blutenburg Castle (Schloss Blutenburg)
attractions.description: Late-Gothic moated castle with a chapel in western Munich.

attractions.name: Bavaria Statue and Ruhmeshalle
attractions.description: Monumental bronze statue of Bavaria and neoclassical Hall of Fame above Theresienwiese.

attractions.name: Villa Stuck
attractions.description: Art nouveau villa of painter Franz von Stuck, now a museum and exhibition venue.

attractions.name: Feldherrnhalle
attractions.description: Loggia monument on Odeonsplatz modeled on the Loggia dei Lanzi in Florence.

attractions.name: Museum Mensch und Natur
attractions.description: Natural history museum at Nymphenburg covering fossils, evolution and ecosystems.

attractions.name: Haus der Kunst
attractions.description: Landmark 1937 building on the English Garden hosting major international contemporary art exhibitions.

attractions.name: State Museum of Egyptian Art (Staatliches Museum Ägyptischer Kunst)
attractions.description: Museum of ancient Egyptian art and artefacts in underground galleries in the Kunstareal.

attractions.name: Alter Botanischer Garten
attractions.description: Historic city-centre garden near Karlsplatz with lawns, pond and mature trees, on the grounds of the former iron-and-glass Glaspalast that burned down in 1931.

attractions.name: Staatliche Antikensammlungen (State Collections of Antiquities)
attractions.description: Museum on Königsplatz known for Greek vases, Etruscan bronzes and ancient gold jewellery.

attractions.name: Ludwigskirche (St. Louis Church)
attractions.description: Neo-Romanesque church on Ludwigstraße built 1829-1844 by Friedrich von Gärtner, with Peter von Cornelius's huge Last Judgment fresco.

attractions.name: Sammlung Schack (Schack Gallery)
attractions.description: Gallery on Prinzregentenstraße with German Romantic paintings by Spitzweg, Schwind, Böcklin and Feuerbach.

attractions.name: Bürgersaalkirche
attractions.description: Baroque church on Neuhauser Straße with a lower church holding the grave of Father Rupert Mayer.

attractions.name: Alter Südfriedhof
attractions.description: Munich's oldest central cemetery, founded in 1563 as a plague cemetery and now a park-like monument with graves of Klenze, Spitzweg and Gärtner.

attractions.name: Palaeontological Museum Munich (Paläontologisches Museum)
attractions.description: Free state museum on Richard-Wagner-Straße with fossils and dinosaur skeletons; open weekdays and on the first Sunday of the month.

attractions.name: Heilig-Geist-Kirche (Church of the Holy Spirit)
attractions.description: Gothic hall church near Viktualienmarkt, remodelled 1724-30 with Rococo frescoes by the Asam brothers and rebuilt after World War II.

cities.name: Copenhagen
cities.source_note: Euromonitor International arrivals for Copenhagen, 2018 (3,069,700), as listed on Wikipedia; dated figure, likely understated for 2024 (Mastercard GDCI 2016 gave 1.63M). No current official city-level international figure found.

attractions.name: Nyhavn
attractions.description: Colorful 17th-century waterfront district with a canal, historic wooden ships and gabled townhouses.

attractions.name: Amalienborg Palace
attractions.description: Four rococo palaces around an octagonal square, the winter residence of the Danish royal family.

attractions.name: The Little Mermaid (Den lille Havfrue)
attractions.description: Bronze statue from 1913 on the Langelinie promenade inspired by Hans Christian Andersen's fairy tale.

attractions.name: Rosenborg Castle
attractions.description: Renaissance castle from 1606 housing the Danish crown jewels and royal regalia.

attractions.name: Christiansborg Palace
attractions.description: Seat of the Danish Parliament, with royal reception rooms, medieval ruins and a tower viewpoint.

attractions.name: Round Tower (Rundetaarn)
attractions.description: 17th-century observatory tower with a spiral ramp and panoramic views over the old town.

attractions.name: Church of Our Saviour (Vor Frelsers Kirke)
attractions.description: Baroque church with an external spiral staircase up the spire offering city views.

attractions.name: Frederik's Church (Marble Church)
attractions.description: Rococo church with one of Northern Europe's largest domes, completed in 1894.

attractions.name: Ny Carlsberg Glyptotek
attractions.description: Art museum with ancient Mediterranean sculpture, French Impressionist works and a winter garden.

attractions.name: National Museum of Denmark (Nationalmuseet)
attractions.description: Denmark's largest cultural history museum, covering prehistory to the present.

attractions.name: Statens Museum for Kunst (National Gallery of Denmark)
attractions.description: Denmark's national art museum with works from the 14th century to today.

attractions.name: The King's Garden (Kongens Have)
attractions.description: Copenhagen's oldest and most visited park, laid out in the early 17th century around Rosenborg Castle.

attractions.name: Copenhagen Botanical Garden
attractions.description: University botanical garden with a historic palm house and thousands of plant species.

attractions.name: Freetown Christiania
attractions.description: Self-governing alternative neighborhood in former military barracks, known for street art and counterculture.

attractions.name: Designmuseum Danmark
attractions.description: Museum of Danish and international design in a rococo former hospital.

attractions.name: Kastellet
attractions.description: Well-preserved 17th-century star-shaped fortress with ramparts, a windmill and park paths.

attractions.name: Copenhagen Cathedral (Vor Frue Kirke)
attractions.description: Neoclassical cathedral with Thorvaldsen's statues of Christ and the apostles.

attractions.name: Copenhagen City Hall (Rådhuset)
attractions.description: National Romantic brick city hall from 1905 with a 106-meter tower open to visitors.

attractions.name: Thorvaldsens Museum
attractions.description: Museum dedicated to the neoclassical sculptor Bertel Thorvaldsen, in a colorful 1848 building.

attractions.name: Danish Jewish Museum
attractions.description: Museum designed by Daniel Libeskind presenting the history of Jews in Denmark.

attractions.name: Workers Museum (Arbejdermuseet)
attractions.description: Museum of Danish labour history and working-class life in Copenhagen, with period homes and a restored 1892 beer hall.

attractions.name: Assistens Cemetery (Assistens Kirkegård)
attractions.description: Historic cemetery and popular park, burial place of Hans Christian Andersen and Søren Kierkegaard.

attractions.name: Copenhagen Contemporary
attractions.description: Large contemporary art center in a former welding hall on Refshaleøen.
attractions.descriptionDe: Großes Zentrum für zeitgenössische Kunst in einer ehemaligen Schweißhalle auf Refshaleøen.

attractions.name: Frilandsmuseet (Open-Air Museum)
attractions.description: Open-air museum in Lyngby with over 100 historic rural buildings moved from across Denmark, set in 40 hectares of gardens and mills.

attractions.name: Frederiksberg Gardens (Frederiksberg Have)
attractions.description: Romantic landscape park with canals, lakes and a Chinese pavilion beside Frederiksberg Palace.
attractions.descriptionDe: Romantischer Landschaftspark mit Kanälen, Seen und chinesischem Pavillon neben Schloss Frederiksberg.

attractions.name: Frederiksberg Palace
attractions.description: Baroque hilltop palace in Frederiksberg, now used by the Royal Danish Military Academy.

attractions.name: Christianshavn Canals
attractions.description: Canal-lined historic district with Dutch-style architecture, built in the early 17th century.

attractions.name: The David Collection (Davids Samling)
attractions.description: Museum of European 18th-century art, Islamic art and early Danish art in a historic townhouse.
attractions.descriptionDe: Museum für europäische Kunst des 18. Jahrhunderts, islamische Kunst und frühe dänische Kunst in einem historischen Stadthaus.

attractions.name: Museum of Copenhagen (Københavns Museum)
attractions.description: City history museum covering Copenhagen's development from its origins to the present.
attractions.descriptionDe: Stadtgeschichtliches Museum über Kopenhagens Entwicklung von den Anfängen bis heute.

attractions.name: Danish Architecture Centre (DAC)
attractions.description: Architecture center with exhibitions on Danish and international building and urban design, on the waterfront.
attractions.descriptionDe: Architekturzentrum am Hafen mit Ausstellungen zu dänischer und internationaler Architektur und Stadtplanung.

attractions.name: Superkilen
attractions.description: Award-winning urban park in Nørrebro with objects and design elements from over 50 countries.

attractions.name: Amager Strandpark
attractions.description: Artificial island beach park with a long sandy shoreline and views across the Øresund.

attractions.name: Ørstedsparken
attractions.description: Landscaped 19th-century park with a lake and winding paths close to the old town.

attractions.name: Fælledparken
attractions.description: Copenhagen's largest city park, with wide lawns, sports fields and walking paths.

attractions.name: The Lakes (Søerne)
attractions.description: Chain of three artificial lakes ringing the old town, popular for walking and cycling.

attractions.name: Holmen Church (Holmens Kirke)
attractions.description: 17th-century church on the canal, known for its royal weddings and baroque interior.

attractions.name: Grundtvig's Church (Grundtvigs Kirke)
attractions.description: Expressionist church of yellow brick completed in 1940, with a striking organ-pipe-like façade.

attractions.name: Kunsthal Charlottenborg
attractions.description: Contemporary art exhibition hall of the Royal Danish Academy of Art, in a building from 1883 beside Nyhavn.
attractions.descriptionDe: Ausstellungshalle der Königlich Dänischen Kunstakademie für zeitgenössische Kunst, in einem Gebäude von 1883 am Nyhavn.

attractions.name: Nyboder
attractions.description: Historic district of yellow row houses built in the 17th century for naval personnel.
attractions.descriptionDe: Historisches Viertel mit gelben Reihenhäusern, im 17. Jahrhundert für Marineangehörige gebaut.

attractions.name: Arken Museum of Modern Art
attractions.description: Contemporary art museum in a ship-like building on the coast at Ishøj, south of the city.

attractions.name: Hirschsprung Collection
attractions.description: Museum of Danish Golden Age art housed in a neoclassical building next to Østre Anlæg park.

attractions.name: The Royal Library Garden (Det Kongelige Biblioteks Have)
attractions.description: Quiet garden courtyard with a pond and statue of Søren Kierkegaard, a central city refuge.
attractions.descriptionDe: Ruhiger Gartenhof mit Teich und Statue von Søren Kierkegaard, ein Rückzugsort mitten in der Stadt.

attractions.name: Cisternerne (The Cisterns)
attractions.description: Former underground water reservoir in Søndermarken converted into an exhibition space for contemporary art.
attractions.descriptionDe: Ehemaliger unterirdischer Wasserspeicher im Søndermarken, heute Ausstellungsraum für zeitgenössische Kunst.

attractions.name: Museum of Danish Resistance (Frihedsmuseet)
attractions.description: Museum on the Danish resistance movement during the German occupation of 1940 to 1945.
attractions.descriptionDe: Museum über den dänischen Widerstand während der deutschen Besatzung von 1940 bis 1945.

attractions.name: Danish War Museum (Krigsmuseet)
attractions.description: Museum of Danish war history and weapons in Christian IV's arsenal, built 1593-1604.

attractions.name: Dyrehaven (Deer Park)
attractions.description: Former royal hunting ground north of the city with wild deer, forest and the Eremitage hunting lodge.

attractions.name: Gefion Fountain (Gefionspringvandet)
attractions.description: Large early 20th-century fountain depicting the Norse goddess Gefion driving oxen, beside Kastellet.

attractions.name: Kongens Nytorv
attractions.description: Copenhagen's largest old town square, bordered by the Royal Danish Theatre and Charlottenborg Palace.

attractions.name: Ordrupgaard
attractions.description: Museum of French Impressionist and Danish Golden Age art in a former private villa north of the city.

attractions.name: STORM (Storm P. Museum)
attractions.description: Museum of Danish humour, satire and cartoonist Storm P., beside the Frederiksberg Runddel.
attractions.descriptionDe: Museum für dänischen Humor, Satire und den Zeichner Storm P., an der Frederiksberg Runddel.

cities.name: San Francisco
cities.source_note: International visitors ~2.35M for 2024 per San Francisco Travel Association forecast (2023 actual just over 2.0M); no confirmed 2024 actual found, so this is an estimate.

attractions.name: Golden Gate Bridge
attractions.description: Iconic 1937 suspension bridge spanning the Golden Gate strait, with walkways and viewpoints at both ends.

attractions.name: Alcatraz Island
attractions.description: Former federal penitentiary on an island in San Francisco Bay, reached by ferry, now a national park site.

attractions.name: Golden Gate Park
attractions.description: Vast 1,017-acre urban park with museums, gardens, lakes and trails on the city's west side.

attractions.name: Palace of Fine Arts
attractions.description: Rotunda and lagoon built for the 1915 Panama-Pacific Exposition in the Marina District.

attractions.name: Presidio of San Francisco
attractions.description: Former military post turned national park with forests, trails, beaches and bay views.

attractions.name: Twin Peaks
attractions.description: Two hills near the city's center offering panoramic views of San Francisco and the bay.

attractions.name: Painted Ladies (Alamo Square)
attractions.description: Row of colorful Victorian houses facing Alamo Square Park, with a skyline backdrop.
attractions.descriptionDe: Reihe bunter viktorianischer Häuser am Alamo Square Park vor der Kulisse der Skyline.

attractions.name: Coit Tower
attractions.description: 1933 Art Deco tower on Telegraph Hill with Depression-era murals and 360-degree city views.

attractions.name: California Academy of Sciences
attractions.description: Natural history museum in Golden Gate Park with a planetarium, aquarium and rainforest dome.
attractions.descriptionDe: Naturkundemuseum im Golden Gate Park mit Planetarium, Aquarium und Regenwaldkuppel.

attractions.name: San Francisco Museum of Modern Art (SFMOMA)
attractions.description: One of the largest modern and contemporary art museums in the United States.

attractions.name: Exploratorium
attractions.description: Hands-on science and perception museum on the Embarcadero at Pier 15.

attractions.name: de Young Museum
attractions.description: Fine arts museum in Golden Gate Park with American, Oceanic and African collections and a tower view.

attractions.name: Legion of Honor
attractions.description: Fine arts museum in Lincoln Park with European art and Rodin sculptures, overlooking the Golden Gate.

attractions.name: Walt Disney Family Museum
attractions.description: Museum in the Presidio chronicling the life and work of Walt Disney.

attractions.name: Japanese Tea Garden
attractions.description: Historic Japanese garden in Golden Gate Park with a pagoda, koi ponds and a tea house.
attractions.descriptionDe: Historischer japanischer Garten im Golden Gate Park mit Pagode, Koiteichen und Teehaus.

attractions.name: Conservatory of Flowers
attractions.description: 1879 Victorian greenhouse in Golden Gate Park housing tropical and rare plants.
attractions.descriptionDe: Viktorianisches Gewächshaus von 1879 im Golden Gate Park mit tropischen und seltenen Pflanzen.

attractions.name: San Francisco Botanical Garden
attractions.description: 55-acre garden in Golden Gate Park with over 9,000 plant types from around the world.
attractions.descriptionDe: 22 Hektar großer Garten im Golden Gate Park mit über 9.000 Pflanzenarten aus aller Welt.

attractions.name: Lands End
attractions.description: Rugged coastal trail with cliffs, labyrinth and views of the Golden Gate Bridge.

attractions.name: Sutro Baths
attractions.description: Ruins of a huge 1896 public bathhouse on the coast near Cliff House.

attractions.name: Ocean Beach
attractions.description: Long Pacific beach on San Francisco's western edge, popular for walks and sunsets.
attractions.descriptionDe: Langer Pazifikstrand am Westrand von San Francisco, beliebt für Spaziergänge und Sonnenuntergänge.

attractions.name: Crissy Field
attractions.description: Restored waterfront marsh and promenade in the Presidio with views of the Golden Gate Bridge.

attractions.name: Fort Point National Historic Site
attractions.description: Civil War-era brick fort sitting directly beneath the Golden Gate Bridge.

attractions.name: Battery Spencer
attractions.description: Marin Headlands overlook offering classic head-on views of the Golden Gate Bridge and city skyline.

attractions.name: Dragon's Gate (Chinatown Gate)
attractions.description: Ornate gateway at Grant Avenue and Bush Street marking the entrance to Chinatown.

attractions.name: Old St. Mary's Cathedral
attractions.description: 1854 Catholic church in Chinatown, the city's first cathedral.

attractions.name: San Francisco City Hall
attractions.description: 1915 Beaux-Arts civic landmark by Arthur Brown Jr. whose gilded dome rises higher than the US Capitol's.

attractions.name: Grace Cathedral
attractions.description: Gothic Revival Episcopal cathedral on Nob Hill with a labyrinth and stained glass.
attractions.descriptionDe: Neugotische Bischofskirche auf dem Nob Hill mit Labyrinth und Buntglasfenstern.

attractions.name: Mission Dolores
attractions.description: 1791 Spanish mission chapel, the oldest surviving building in San Francisco.

attractions.name: Cathedral of Saint Mary of the Assumption
attractions.description: Modernist Catholic cathedral with a distinctive hyperbolic paraboloid roof and cross-shaped skylights.

attractions.name: Angel Island State Park
attractions.description: Bay island park with hiking trails, panoramic views and a historic immigration station.
attractions.descriptionDe: Inselpark in der Bucht mit Wanderwegen, Panoramablick und einer historischen Einwanderungsstation.

attractions.name: Muir Woods National Monument
attractions.description: Old-growth coast redwood forest in Marin County, about 12 miles north of the city.

attractions.name: Marin Headlands
attractions.description: Rugged coastal hills and beaches across the Golden Gate Bridge with trails and old military batteries.

attractions.name: Dolores Park
attractions.description: Sunny hillside park in the Mission District with city views and a lively local scene.
attractions.descriptionDe: Sonniger Hangpark im Mission District mit Stadtblick und lebhafter Atmosphäre.

attractions.name: Buena Vista Park
attractions.description: Hilltop park in Haight-Ashbury with wooded trails and views over the city.
attractions.descriptionDe: Park auf einem Hügel in Haight-Ashbury mit bewaldeten Wegen und Blick über die Stadt.

attractions.name: Asian Art Museum
attractions.description: Museum with one of the largest collections of Asian art outside Asia, near Civic Center.

attractions.name: Contemporary Jewish Museum
attractions.description: Museum in a Daniel Libeskind-designed building showing Jewish culture and contemporary art.

attractions.name: Museum of the African Diaspora
attractions.description: Museum in SoMa exploring the art, history and culture of the African diaspora.

attractions.name: Chinese Historical Society of America Museum
attractions.description: Chinatown museum documenting the history of Chinese Americans, housed in a 1932 building designed by Julia Morgan.

attractions.name: San Francisco Maritime National Historical Park (Hyde Street Pier)
attractions.description: Historic ships and a maritime museum at Aquatic Park near Fisherman's Wharf.
attractions.descriptionDe: Historische Schiffe und ein Schifffahrtsmuseum am Aquatic Park nahe der Fisherman's Wharf.

attractions.name: Wave Organ
attractions.description: Acoustic sculpture of pipes and stone on the bay shore that amplifies the sounds of waves.
attractions.descriptionDe: Klangskulptur aus Rohren und Steinen am Ufer der Bucht, die das Rauschen der Wellen verstärkt.

attractions.name: Mount Davidson
attractions.description: The city's highest natural point at 928 feet, topped with a large concrete cross and views.
attractions.descriptionDe: Der höchste natürliche Punkt der Stadt (283 Meter) mit einem großen Betonkreuz und Aussicht.

attractions.name: Fort Mason
attractions.description: Former military post on the waterfront with gardens, bay views and arts venues.

attractions.name: Yerba Buena Gardens
attractions.description: Downtown urban park with lawns, a memorial and waterfall near SFMOMA and Moscone Center.

attractions.name: Salesforce Park
attractions.description: 5.4-acre rooftop park above the Salesforce Transit Center with gardens and an urban walking trail.
attractions.descriptionDe: 2,2 Hektar großer Dachpark über dem Salesforce Transit Center mit Gärten und Spazierweg.

attractions.name: Stow Lake
attractions.description: Man-made lake in Golden Gate Park with boat rentals, a waterfall and Strawberry Hill viewpoint.
attractions.descriptionDe: Künstlicher See im Golden Gate Park mit Bootsverleih, Wasserfall und Aussichtspunkt auf dem Strawberry Hill.

attractions.name: Fort Funston
attractions.description: Coastal sand dunes and cliffs on the city's southwest edge, popular for hang gliding and dog walking.
attractions.descriptionDe: Dünen und Klippen am Südwestrand der Stadt, beliebt bei Drachenfliegern und Hundebesitzern.

attractions.name: Lyon Street Steps
attractions.description: Long staircase in Pacific Heights with panoramic views of the Presidio and the bay.

attractions.name: Cable Car Museum
attractions.description: Free museum and working powerhouse showing the machinery that drives San Francisco's cable cars.
attractions.descriptionDe: Kostenloses Museum in einem aktiven Maschinenhaus, das die Antriebe der Cable Cars zeigt.

attractions.name: Haas-Lilienthal House
attractions.description: 1886 Queen Anne-style Victorian house museum in Pacific Heights, one of the few mansions of its era to survive the 1906 earthquake and fire.
attractions.descriptionDe: Viktorianisches Haus im Queen-Anne-Stil von 1886 in Pacific Heights, eine der wenigen Villen, die das Erdbeben und Feuer von 1906 überstanden.

attractions.name: Baker Beach
attractions.description: Sandy beach in the Presidio with views of the Golden Gate Bridge.
attractions.descriptionDe: Sandstrand im Presidio mit Blick auf die Golden Gate Bridge.

cities.name: Zurich
cities.source_note: ESTIMATE (2024): no official international-visitor count found; derived from Zurich Tourism's 7.3M regional overnight stays (about 62% foreign, ~2 nights average stay).

attractions.name: Grossmünster
attractions.description: Romanesque Protestant church with twin towers, tied to Zwingli and the Reformation, with a climbable tower.

attractions.name: Lake Zurich (Zürichsee)
attractions.description: Large alpine lake beside the old town, with promenades, swimming spots and boat trips.

attractions.name: Old Town (Altstadt)
attractions.description: Medieval quarter of narrow lanes, guild houses and fountains on both banks of the Limmat, including the Niederdorf and the riverside Schipfe.

attractions.name: Kunsthaus Zürich
attractions.description: Switzerland's largest art museum, with works by Giacometti, Monet, Picasso and Munch.

attractions.name: Swiss National Museum (Landesmuseum)
attractions.description: Castle-like museum presenting Swiss cultural history from prehistory to the present.

attractions.name: Fraumünster
attractions.description: Gothic former abbey church known for stained-glass windows by Marc Chagall.

attractions.name: Lindenhof
attractions.description: Tree-shaded hilltop square on a former Roman fort site, overlooking the old town and river.

attractions.name: Uetliberg
attractions.description: Zurich's local mountain, reached by train, with a lookout tower and views of city, lake and Alps.

attractions.name: St. Peter's Church (St. Peterskirche)
attractions.description: Oldest parish church in Zurich, with the largest church clock face in Europe.

attractions.name: Zürich Botanical Garden
attractions.description: University botanical garden with greenhouses and thousands of plant species near the lake.

attractions.name: Chinese Garden (Chinagarten)
attractions.description: Lakeside garden gifted by partner city Kunming, with pavilions, ponds and a bridge.

attractions.name: Rietberg Museum
attractions.description: Museum of non-European art set in a park with villas, holding Asian, African and American collections.

attractions.name: Lake Promenade (Seepromenade)
attractions.description: Lakeside walk from Bürkliplatz to Zürichhorn with benches, lawns and views toward the Alps.

attractions.name: Zürichhorn Park
attractions.description: Lakeside park on a small peninsula with lawns, sculptures and swimming access.

attractions.name: Lindt Home of Chocolate
attractions.description: Chocolate museum in Kilchberg with a giant chocolate fountain and exhibition on cocoa and chocolate history.

attractions.name: FIFA World Football Museum
attractions.description: Museum on the history of football, with the World Cup trophy and interactive exhibits.

attractions.name: Natural History Museum of the University of Zurich
attractions.description: University museum, opened in 2024 in the Karl-Schmid-Strasse building, merging the former zoological, paleontological, anthropological and botanical museums with dinosaurs, mounted animals and human-evolution exhibits.

attractions.name: Museum of Design (Museum für Gestaltung)
attractions.description: Design museum with collections of posters, graphic design and applied arts.

attractions.name: Migros Museum of Contemporary Art
attractions.description: Contemporary art museum in the former Löwenbräu brewery complex.

attractions.name: Kunsthalle Zürich
attractions.description: Contemporary art space showing international exhibitions in the Löwenbräu complex.

attractions.name: Cabaret Voltaire
attractions.description: Birthplace of the Dada movement, founded in 1916 by Hugo Ball at Spiegelgasse 1, now a museum, exhibition space and cafe.

attractions.name: Polyterrasse
attractions.description: University terrace above the Limmat with a panoramic view over the old town to the lake and Alps.

attractions.name: Zurich Town Hall (Rathaus)
attractions.description: Baroque-era town hall of 1698 on the Limmat, seat of the cantonal parliament.

attractions.name: Schanzengraben
attractions.description: Moat and promenade preserving part of Zurich's Baroque fortifications of the 17th century, running from the main station to the lake.

attractions.name: Wasserkirche
attractions.description: Late Gothic church standing on the Limmat beside the Helmhaus, once on an island.

attractions.name: Helmhaus Zürich
attractions.description: Free municipal exhibition space for Swiss contemporary art on the Limmat, beside the Wasserkirche.

attractions.name: Predigerkirche
attractions.description: Medieval Dominican church in the Niederdorf with a tall neo-Gothic tower added in 1900.

attractions.name: Villa Patumbah (Heimatschutzzentrum)
attractions.description: Late-19th-century villa with an ornate exotic interior and garden, now the Swiss Heritage Society's centre for building culture.

attractions.name: Liebfrauenkirche
attractions.description: Neo-Romanesque Catholic church with a notable mosaic and colorful interior near the main station.

attractions.name: Old Botanical Garden (Alter Botanischer Garten)
attractions.description: Former botanical garden turned public park, with old trees and a historic pavilion near the Sihl.

attractions.name: Arboretum Zürich
attractions.description: Lakeside landscaped park from the 1880s with mature trees and quiet paths.

attractions.name: Rieterpark
attractions.description: Park around Villa Wesendonck and Rietberg Museum, with old trees and lawns.

attractions.name: Platzspitz
attractions.description: Historic baroque park at the confluence of the Sihl and Limmat beside the Swiss National Museum.

attractions.name: Irchelpark
attractions.description: Zurich's largest public park, laid out 1979-86 beside the university campus with an artificial lake, streams, hills and meadows.

attractions.name: Zürichberg
attractions.description: Wooded hill above the city with forest trails, lookout spots and views of the lake.

attractions.name: Pavillon Le Corbusier
attractions.description: Colorful steel and glass pavilion built in 1967 by Le Corbusier showing his art, furniture and architecture, open seasonally from May to November.

attractions.name: Fluntern Cemetery
attractions.description: Tree-lined cemetery on the Zürichberg where James Joyce and Elias Canetti are buried.

attractions.name: Graphische Sammlung ETH Zürich
attractions.description: Free ETH collection of prints, drawings and photographs with changing exhibitions in the university main building.

attractions.name: Zürich Succulent Collection (Sukkulenten-Sammlung)
attractions.description: Municipal collection of succulent plants in a greenhouse complex on the lake side.

attractions.name: Museum Bärengasse
attractions.description: Museum in a historic townhouse showing Zurich's urban history and daily life.

attractions.name: Photobastei
attractions.description: Photography exhibition space in a former warehouse on the Sihlquai near the main station.

attractions.name: Museum Haus Konstruktiv
attractions.description: Museum of constructivist, concrete and conceptual art in a former power substation.

attractions.name: Tram Museum Zürich
attractions.description: Museum of historic trams in a restored depot, with rides on vintage cars.

attractions.name: Sihlwald
attractions.description: Near-natural beech forest and wilderness park with trails, a short train ride from the city.

attractions.name: Katzensee
attractions.description: Small nature-reserve lakes and woods north of the city for walks and swimming.

attractions.name: Limmat River
attractions.description: River flowing from the lake through the city, with promenades, bridges and river baths.

attractions.name: Mühlerama
attractions.description: Museum in a former mill showing the history of milling and food production.

attractions.name: Moulagen Museum
attractions.description: University museum of detailed wax models of skin diseases, a medical-history curiosity.

attractions.name: Belvoirpark
attractions.description: Lakeside park around Villa Belvoir with rose gardens, lawns and lake views.

attractions.name: Pestalozzi Park
attractions.description: Central city park with lawns and trees, close to Bahnhofstrasse and the old town.

cities.name: Hamburg
cities.source_note: Estimate (2024): Statistikamt Nord/Hamburg Tourismus report ~7.6m guests and 16.1m overnight stays, ~23% foreign by overnight stays; Jan-Jul 2024 had 918k foreign arrivals, extrapolated to ~1.7m for the full year. No official full-year foreign-arrivals figure was found.

attractions.name: Miniatur Wunderland
attractions.description: World's largest model railway exhibition in the Speicherstadt, with detailed miniature landscapes and airports.

attractions.name: Elbphilharmonie Plaza
attractions.description: Public plaza atop the HafenCity concert hall offering panoramic views over the harbour and city.

attractions.name: Speicherstadt
attractions.description: UNESCO-listed warehouse district of red-brick buildings along canals, built from the 1880s.

attractions.name: Hamburg Town Hall (Rathaus)
attractions.description: Neo-Renaissance city hall completed in 1897, seat of the Hamburg Parliament and Senate.

attractions.name: St. Michael's Church (Michel)
attractions.description: Hamburg's best-known Baroque church, with a tower viewing platform and a crypt.

attractions.name: Old Elbe Tunnel (Alter Elbtunnel)
attractions.description: Tunnel under the Elbe opened in 1911 for pedestrians and vehicles, linking St. Pauli and Steinwerder.

attractions.name: Planten un Blomen
attractions.description: Central park with gardens, water features, a Japanese garden and evening water-light concerts.

attractions.name: Hamburger Kunsthalle
attractions.description: Hamburg's main art museum, with European paintings from the Middle Ages to contemporary art.

attractions.name: Binnenalster
attractions.description: Small central lake in the heart of the city, framed by promenades and the Jungfernstieg.

attractions.name: Außenalster
attractions.description: Large artificial lake north of the city centre, popular for walking, sailing and boat trips.

attractions.name: St. Nikolai Memorial
attractions.description: Ruined Gothic church tower preserved as a war memorial, with a glass lift and viewing platform.

attractions.name: Landungsbrücken
attractions.description: Floating landing stages on the Elbe, the main hub for harbour ferries and boat tours.

attractions.name: International Maritime Museum Hamburg
attractions.description: Large maritime collection spread over ten decks of a historic warehouse in HafenCity.

attractions.name: Bunker St. Pauli Rooftop Garden
attractions.description: Public rooftop garden at 58 m on the former Flak Tower IV, reached by a planted spiral path, with panoramic views over St. Pauli and the harbour.

attractions.name: Chilehaus
attractions.description: Expressionist brick office building from 1924, shaped like a ship's prow, in the Kontorhaus district.

attractions.name: Museum of Arts and Crafts (MKG)
attractions.description: Museum of applied arts with design, fashion, photography and decorative arts collections.

attractions.name: Rickmer Rickmers
attractions.description: Three-masted museum ship from 1896 moored at the Landungsbrücken.

attractions.name: Cap San Diego
attractions.description: Historic cargo ship from 1962 serving as a floating maritime museum on the Elbe.

attractions.name: Stadtpark
attractions.description: Large early-20th-century landscape park in Winterhude with lawns, a lake and an open-air stage.

attractions.name: Deichtorhallen
attractions.description: Former market halls near the main station hosting major photography and contemporary art exhibitions.

attractions.name: Jenischpark
attractions.description: Landscaped park on the Elbe slope with the Jenisch House museum and old trees.

attractions.name: Ohlsdorf Cemetery
attractions.description: One of the world's largest park cemeteries, with woodland paths, ponds and notable memorials.

attractions.name: St. Jacobi Church
attractions.description: Medieval Gothic church in the city centre famed for its Arp Schnitger baroque organ.

attractions.name: St. Katharinen Church
attractions.description: Gothic brick church in the Old Town with a distinctive Baroque tower.

attractions.name: St. Petri Church
attractions.description: Hamburg's oldest parish church site, with a tower viewing platform in the city centre.

attractions.name: Blankenese
attractions.description: Elbe-side village with a hillside Treppenviertel of stepped lanes, villas and river views.

attractions.name: Övelgönne Beach and Museum Harbour
attractions.description: Sandy Elbe beach with a row of old captains' houses and historic ships in the museum harbour.

attractions.name: Altonaer Balkon
attractions.description: Clifftop promenade in Altona with wide views over the Elbe and the harbour.

attractions.name: BallinStadt Emigration Museum
attractions.description: Museum on Veddel recreating the emigrant halls from which millions left Europe for America.

attractions.name: Bucerius Kunst Forum
attractions.description: Gallery near the Rathaus presenting changing exhibitions of art from antiquity to modern times.

attractions.name: MARKK Museum am Rothenbaum
attractions.description: Ethnological museum with large collections from Africa, Asia, Oceania and the Americas.

attractions.name: Speicherstadt Museum
attractions.description: Small museum inside a historic warehouse explaining life and work in the Speicherstadt.

attractions.name: German Customs Museum (Deutsches Zollmuseum)
attractions.description: Museum in the Speicherstadt covering the history of customs, smuggling and trade.

attractions.name: Spicy's Spice Museum
attractions.description: Museum in a Speicherstadt warehouse displaying spices and the history of the spice trade.

attractions.name: Hamburg Port Museum (Hafenmuseum)
attractions.description: Maritime industrial museum on the Elbe's Grasbrook shore with historic cranes and port equipment.

attractions.name: Museum of Work (Museum der Arbeit)
attractions.description: Museum in Barmbek's former rubber factory documenting working life and industrial history.

attractions.name: Altona Museum
attractions.description: Regional museum covering North German history, fishing and the art of the Elbe region.

attractions.name: Lohsepark
attractions.description: HafenCity park with a memorial to deported Jews, Roma and Sinti at the former Hannover station.

attractions.name: Loki Schmidt Garden (Botanical Garden)
attractions.description: Botanical garden in Klein Flottbek with themed plant collections and greenhouses.

attractions.name: Dockland
attractions.description: Parallelogram-shaped office building in Altona with a public rooftop staircase overlooking the harbour.

attractions.name: Bismarck Monument
attractions.description: Giant 1906 granite statue of Otto von Bismarck overlooking the harbour from the St. Pauli hill.

attractions.name: Hamburger Kunstverein
attractions.description: Contemporary art gallery near the main station showing changing international exhibitions.

attractions.name: Alsterarkaden
attractions.description: Venetian-style arcades from the 1840s along the Kleine Alster, lined with shops and cafes.

attractions.name: Gängeviertel
attractions.description: Rare surviving 19th-century working-class quarter of narrow courtyards, now an artists' initiative.

attractions.name: Krameramtsstuben
attractions.description: Hamburg's last surviving 17th-century courtyard of small alms houses near St. Michael's.

attractions.name: Hirschpark
attractions.description: Landscaped park on the Elbchaussee with ancient trees, a deer enclosure and views toward the river.

attractions.name: Neuengamme Concentration Camp Memorial
attractions.description: Memorial and museum on the grounds of the former Neuengamme concentration camp in Bergedorf.

attractions.name: Brahms Museum
attractions.description: Small museum in the Composers' Quarter on Peterstrasse devoted to Johannes Brahms, who was born in Hamburg in 1833.

attractions.name: Ernst Barlach Haus
attractions.description: Art museum in the Jenischpark housing the sculptures and drawings of Ernst Barlach alongside changing modern art exhibitions.

attractions.name: Museum für Bergedorf und die Vierlande
attractions.description: Local-history museum in the medieval Bergedorf Castle, covering the history of Bergedorf and the Vierlande countryside.

cities.name: Cologne
cities.source_note: ESTIMATE for 2025: KölnTourismus reports ~4.25M guests and ~37% of overnight stays from abroad (Germany 62.6%); no official absolute foreign-arrival figure found, so ~1.5M international arrivals is derived.

attractions.name: Cologne Cathedral (Kölner Dom)
attractions.description: Gothic cathedral begun in 1248 and a UNESCO World Heritage Site, with twin spires and the Shrine of the Three Kings.

attractions.name: Hohenzollern Bridge
attractions.description: Iconic 1911 railway bridge over the Rhine, famous for thousands of love-lock padlocks on its fences.

attractions.name: Cologne Old Town (Altstadt)
attractions.description: Reconstructed historic quarter of narrow lanes and colourful gabled houses between the cathedral and the Rhine.

attractions.name: Great St. Martin Church (Groß St. Martin)
attractions.description: Romanesque church with a distinctive tower that dominates the Old Town skyline along the Rhine.

attractions.name: Cologne Town Hall (Historisches Rathaus)
attractions.description: Germany's oldest town hall site, with a Renaissance loggia and a Gothic tower dating to the 15th century.

attractions.name: Museum Ludwig
attractions.description: Major modern art museum with large Picasso and pop art collections, next to the cathedral.

attractions.name: Wallraf-Richartz Museum
attractions.description: Museum of European painting from the medieval period to the early 20th century, including Rubens and Impressionists.

attractions.name: Chocolate Museum (Schokoladenmuseum)
attractions.description: Museum on the Rhine tracing the history of cocoa and chocolate, with a working production line and chocolate fountain.

attractions.name: KölnTriangle Panorama
attractions.description: Rooftop viewing platform on the Deutz bank of the Rhine with a classic view of the cathedral and skyline.

attractions.name: Rheinpark
attractions.description: Landscaped riverside park in Deutz with gardens, lawns and open views of the Cologne skyline.

attractions.name: Flora and Botanical Garden (Flora und Botanischer Garten)
attractions.description: Historic botanical garden in Riehl with greenhouses, themed gardens and a Victorian-style Flora building.

attractions.name: Rheingarten
attractions.description: Riverside promenade and lawns along the Rhine below the Old Town, popular for strolling and sunsets.

attractions.name: St. Gereon's Basilica (Basilika St. Gereon)
attractions.description: Early Christian Romanesque church with a unique decagonal nave and decorated crypt, dating to the Roman era.

attractions.name: St. Ursula's Church (St. Ursula)
attractions.description: Romanesque church known for its Golden Chamber of relics linked to the legend of Saint Ursula.

attractions.name: Church of St. Maria im Kapitol
attractions.description: Romanesque church built over a Roman temple, with a trefoil east end and a wooden door dating to about 1065.

attractions.name: Church of St. Pantaleon
attractions.description: Ottonian-era Romanesque abbey church with a mighty westwork and the tomb of Empress Theophanu.

attractions.name: Church of St. Severin (St. Severin)
attractions.description: Medieval church in the Severinsviertel with a tall Gothic tower and an early Christian burial site below.

attractions.name: Church of St. Aposteln
attractions.description: Romanesque church on the Neumarkt with a distinctive trefoil apse and a landmark roof ridge.

attractions.name: Church of St. Kunibert
attractions.description: Late Romanesque church on the Rhine known for its stained-glass windows and tall tower.

attractions.name: Church of St. Andreas
attractions.description: Romanesque-Gothic basilica a few minutes from the cathedral, holding the sarcophagus of Albertus Magnus in its crypt.

attractions.name: Church of St. Maria in Lyskirchen
attractions.description: Small Romanesque church near the Rhine, built around 1200-1225 and notable for its largely preserved 13th-century vault frescoes.

attractions.name: Church of St. Georg
attractions.description: Romanesque basilica begun in 1059, nicknamed 'Ravenna on the Rhine' for its basilica-style interior.

attractions.name: Antoniterkirche
attractions.description: 14th-century Gothic Protestant church on Schildergasse, home to Ernst Barlach's hanging angel sculpture Der Schwebende.

attractions.name: Museum Schnütgen
attractions.description: Medieval art museum housed in the Romanesque St. Cecilia church, with sculpture, ivories and goldsmith work.

attractions.name: Hahnentorburg (Hahnentor)
attractions.description: Monumental 13th-century medieval city gate on Hahnenstraße, one of the surviving gates of Cologne's city wall.

attractions.name: Severinstorburg
attractions.description: Well-preserved medieval city gate at the southern end of the Severinsviertel, part of the 13th-century wall.

attractions.name: Eigelstein Gate (Eigelsteintorburg)
attractions.description: Medieval city gate in the northern city wall, one of the best-preserved gates in Cologne.

attractions.name: Roman Tower and Ancient Wall
attractions.description: Section of the Roman city wall featuring the Roman Northwest Tower with its decorative masonry.

attractions.name: Ubiermonument
attractions.description: Remains of the oldest known stone city wall of Cologne, a Roman-era monument near the Roman-Germanic Museum.

attractions.name: Melaten Cemetery (Melaten-Friedhof)
attractions.description: Cologne's largest cemetery, consecrated in 1810, a park-like ground with the Grim Reaper statue and graves of many notable figures.

attractions.name: NS-Documentation Centre (EL-DE House)
attractions.description: Former Gestapo headquarters now documenting Nazi-era persecution in Cologne, with preserved prison cells.

attractions.name: Museum for Applied Arts (MAKK)
attractions.description: Museum of European design and applied arts; currently only the design collection and special exhibitions are open.

attractions.name: Museum of East Asian Art (Museum für Ostasiatische Kunst)
attractions.description: Specialised museum of Chinese, Japanese and Korean art set beside a Japanese-style garden.

attractions.name: Kolumba
attractions.description: Art museum of the Archdiocese of Cologne, designed by Peter Zumthor over the ruins of a Gothic church.

attractions.name: Museum of Ethnology (Rautenstrauch-Joest-Museum)
attractions.description: Museum of world cultures with ethnographic collections from Africa, Asia, Oceania and the Americas.

attractions.name: Perfume Museum Farina
attractions.description: Museum in the original house of Farina, producer of Eau de Cologne since 1709.

attractions.name: Cathedral Treasury (Domschatzkammer)
attractions.description: Treasury beneath the cathedral displaying medieval reliquaries, liturgical vestments and precious gold objects.

attractions.name: Cologne City Museum (Kölnisches Stadtmuseum)
attractions.description: City history museum covering Cologne's past and Carnival traditions, in an interim home at Minoritenstraße 13 (former Sauer department store) while the Zeughaus remains closed.

attractions.name: German Sport and Olympic Museum (Deutsches Sport & Olympia Museum)
attractions.description: Museum in the Rheinauhafen devoted to the history of sport and the Olympic Games.

attractions.name: Käthe Kollwitz Museum
attractions.description: Museum holding a large collection of prints, drawings and sculptures by the German artist Käthe Kollwitz.

attractions.name: Photographische Sammlung / SK Stiftung Kultur
attractions.description: Gallery with rotating photography exhibitions and a significant historic photographic archive.

attractions.name: Kölnischer Kunstverein
attractions.description: Non-profit contemporary art association founded in 1839, showing exhibitions in the Riphahn-designed 'Die Brücke' building on Hahnenstraße.

attractions.name: Stadtgarten
attractions.description: Park with a tree-lined beer garden, a jazz club and shaded lawns close to the city centre.

attractions.name: Volksgarten
attractions.description: Large park south of the Old Town with lawns, a pond and a popular summer atmosphere.

attractions.name: Aachener Weiher
attractions.description: Lakeside park in the Belgian Quarter area with a long lakeside promenade, next to the Museum of East Asian Art and its Japanese garden.

attractions.name: Forstbotanischer Garten and Arboretum
attractions.description: Large arboretum and botanical garden in Rodenkirchen with a diverse collection of trees and shrubs.

attractions.name: Königsforst
attractions.description: Large woodland on the eastern edge of the city, popular for hiking, cycling and quiet forest walks.

attractions.name: Grüngürtel (Cologne Green Belt)
attractions.description: Wide green belt ringing the city's inner districts with parks, lakes and paths laid out in the 1920s.

attractions.name: Skulpturenpark Köln
attractions.description: Open-air sculpture park beside the zoo and Rhine, showing contemporary works by international artists in a landscaped setting.

attractions.name: Fühlinger See
attractions.description: Large lake in northern Cologne's Fühlingen district, surrounded by woodland and lawns, popular for walking, swimming and relaxing.
